Title: Senior Program Manager - End to End
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting, Telecommunications, and Wireless Services
Description:
**Req Id:**
433622
  
  
Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.
  
  
We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.
  
  
On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.
  
  
At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.
  
  
**Summary**
Bell AI Fabric is seeking a Senior Program Manager with proven data centre experience to act as the single accountable person for a data centre project or cluster of projects, from site identification through handover to Operations. The Senior Program Manager is the mesh between departments: connecting Business, Legal, Finance, Land and Regulatory, Power / IPP, Design, Procurement and Strategic Supply, Construction, Commissioning, Networking and Security, and Operations around one integrated plan.
  
  
The role owns the integrated plan, gate readiness, the cross-department interface log, RFS feasibility and recovery plans, and the weekly core team meeting. It coordinates and does not direct: functional leads keep their technical decisions, and contract and commercial approvals stay with Legal, Finance and the existing delegation of authority.
  
  
In the initial phase, one Senior Program Manager per project covers both the Integrated PM and Commercial PM responsibilities, and is the single point of contact for the client across all phases. Program Controls assures each gate independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Integrated Planning & Gate Readiness
  
  

* Own the integrated plan and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for the project, bringing together land, permit, power, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and operational readiness milestones.
* Manage the project through its full lifecycle, from site identification to handover to Operations: run kickoffs, hold readiness reviews about two weeks before each key decision point, and bring each one to a decision.
* Ensure each exit is met with evidence, and work with Program Controls, which assures every gate independently.
* Join early, at site identification, to frame the project plan and collect inputs from Land, Power, Design and Construction.

Cross-Functional Integration & Interface Management
  
  

* Maintain the interface log across departments, with clear owners, dates and closure evidence.
* Chair the weekly core team meeting and ensure decisions, actions and dependencies are tracked to closure.
* Ensure design and scope changes are communicated and assessed with all affected departments, Operations included, before they are decided.
* Surface gaps in ownership early, including OFCI versus CFCI scope, and escalate where functional teams are not aligned.

RFS Feasibility & Recovery
  
  

* Test RFS feasibility with Program Controls and subject-matter experts from Design, Power, Construction and Operations before dates are committed.
* Own recovery plans when external dependencies, such as power, OFCI delivery or utility schedules, threaten RFS dates.
* Size credit and penalty exposure from RFS delays together with Legal and Finance, and report it clearly to leadership.
* Define and run the communication of RFS delays to all team members and departments.

Client & Commercial Alignment
  
  

* Act as the single point of contact for the client in all phases, with weekly client meetings and structured updates.
* Confirm the RFS date is achievable before it is committed in customer agreements; work with the Commercial team on terms, SLA and acceptance criteria.
* Lead client design sign-off and drive client acceptance at RFS.
* Support management of contract notices, claims and change requests with Legal and Finance, without taking over their approval authority.

Procurement, Construction & Commissioning Delivery
  
  

* Align contract awards and OFCI delivery to project need dates; link the shipping and customs plan to the integrated schedule and report gaps with Program Controls.
* Manage construction interfaces and changes, and lead recovery plans with Construction.
* Sequence commissioning and energization; confirm networking, security and operations teams are ready to accept the facility.
* Collect turnover documents and as-builts as part of commissioning exit.

Governance, Reporting & Escalation
  
  

* Prepare concise executive reporting on schedule, RFS status, risks, interfaces, changes and decisions required.
* Present at the monthly governance forum, and escalate with clarity using agreed triggers.
* Feed accurate project data into Program Controls trackers and the portfolio milestone tracker so leadership has a single source of truth.
* Apply Program Controls standards, templates and the handbook consistently across the project.

Readiness, Closeout & Lessons Learned
  
  

* Confirm operational readiness evidence at the gate, including operations hiring and billing readiness.
* Run handover to Asset Management and complete the handover tracker.
* Close final cost with Program Controls and ensure asset acceptance.
* Capture lessons learned and feed them into standards for later phases and sites.

**Critical Qualifications**

* Must have direct data centre experience: proven delivery of data centre (mission-critical or hyperscale) projects, from site identification through commissioning and handover to Operations.
* Progressive experience leading complex, multi-disciplinary capital projects or programs through multiple lifecycle phases.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate schedule, cost, risk, change and interface information into one project view.
* Experience coordinating internal teams, consultants, contractors and vendors without direct authority.
* Strong understanding of stage-gate or phase-gate delivery, readiness reviews and handover processes.
* Experience managing schedule recovery, escalation and stakeholder expectations on delayed or constrained projects.
* Working knowledge of contract structures, procurement strategies and owner-furnished equipment (OFCI) coordination.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools and familiarity with project controls and reporting systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with hyperscale or large-scale cloud and AI customer projects, and with telecommunications or other mission-critical infrastructure.
* Knowledge of mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls, network and security systems, including power and utility interconnection.
* Experience managing customer commitments such as RFS dates, SLAs and associated credits or penalties.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint or similar platforms.
* PMP, PgMP, PSP, or equivalent professional certification.

**Additional Requirements**

* Influence and leadership across functions without direct authority.
* End-to-end systems thinking and dependency management.
* Ownership, follow-through and attention to detail.
* Sound judgment under schedule and commercial pressure.
* Ability to challenge constructively and escalate with clarity.
* Executive communication and data-driven storytelling.

Title: Principal Technical Program Manager - FDE
Description:
**Overview**
In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.
  
  
We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs, owning the full customer journey from problem definition through delivery and driving measurable business outcomes. You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside engineers, data scientists, and designers, operating with high autonomy to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions.
  
  
Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.
  
  
**This Role Offers The Opportunity To**

* Lead complex technical programs from problem definition through to delivered outcomes
* Drive decisions that directly influence business strategy and customer outcomes
* Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries
* Apply the latest advancements in AI and engineering workflows to deliver value at scale

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs with high autonomy, aligning business needs with engineering solutions across AI, cloud, and data. Take ownership of the customer journey end-to-end, from problem definition through co-engineering delivery to measurable business outcomes.
* Apply AI assisted engineering practices as a daily operating mode: use AI tools across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate requirements-to-specs, generate high-quality engineering artifacts from customer context, and drive continuous flow of value from business need to production.
* Operate fluently in engineering tooling (e.g., VS Code, GitHub, AI agents) as primary work surfaces for planning, documentation, and technical program leadership. Validate AI-generated outputs with domain expertise to maintain quality at speed.
* Navigate ambiguity in customer environments with self-direction and high ownership. Make technical and program decisions with incomplete information, proactively identify opportunities and manage risks, providing data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.
* Champion and cultivate reusable solution patterns, open-source assets, and engineering playbooks that scale impact beyond individual engagements. Contribute to the broader engineering community through knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Partner with multi-disciplinary engineering teams (software engineers, data scientists, designers) to evaluate, design, and deliver AI-powered cloud solutions side-by-side with customer engineers. Give key stakeholders data-driven recommendations based on identified risks and tradeoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
* Or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Title: Solution Delivery Manager
Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada | Brampton, Ontario, Canada

Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
We are seeking a Solution Delivery Manager reporting to the Senior Manager, Residential Solution Delivery. In this role as Solution Delivery Manager, you will provide end-to-end leadership for the planning, solutioning, sequencing, and delivery of initiatives within an assigned workstream, squad, or program. You will establish trusted relationships with Product, Business, Architecture, Delivery, Security, Quality Assurance, and domain teams, translating product roadmaps and project requirements into aligned, executable delivery plans.
  
  
You will balance business outcomes, technical feasibility, risk, capacity, and release constraints. The role is accountable for driving clarity across scope, solution, estimates, dependencies, approvals, quality, and timelines while supporting teams through execution and issue resolution.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Stakeholder Partnership and Roadmap Alignment
  
  

* Build and sustain trusted relationships with Product and Business stakeholders, creating transparency on priorities, trade-offs, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Develop a detailed understanding of the product roadmap for the assigned workstream, squad, or program and translate it into actionable delivery priorities.
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to shape the backlog, negotiate priorities, clarify acceptance outcomes, and maintain alignment to business value.
* Represent Solution Delivery in cross-functional discussions and ensure decisions, dependencies, and commitments are documented and communicated.

Requirements, Scope, and Solution Leadership
  
  

* Read and understand project requirements; challenge assumptions, identify gaps and dependencies, provide feedback, and sign off on the scope committed for delivery.
* Provide direction and guidance to the Business Analyst throughout project execution, including requirements clarification, dependency management, decision tracking, and issue resolution.
* Work closely with the Solution Architect to finalize the end-to-end solution, ensuring alignment across business requirements, architecture, integration, data, operations, security, and support considerations.
* Coordinate solution reviews with domain teams and Business stakeholders and obtain the required sign-offs before delivery proceeds.
* Work closely with the Cyber Security prime and the Business Systems Analyst to close security requirements, risks, assessments, and required approvals.

Integrated Planning and Delivery Management
  
  

* Work with domain leads and the Project Manager to sequence deliveries and formulate the Plan of Intent and Plan of Release in alignment with business goals, dependencies, team capacity, and release windows.
* Negotiate delivery timelines with domain teams, release dates, and other delivery commitments, while clearly identifying prerequisites and trade-offs.
* Obtain and consolidate estimates from all contributing teams; validate assumptions, dependencies, and resource needs to support an achievable integrated plan.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, scope gaps, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies, and drive timely mitigation or escalation.
* Maintain clear delivery governance, decision records, status reporting, and accountability across the end-to-end lifecycle.

Facilitation, Decisions, and Governance
  
  

* Schedule and lead Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions with domain teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure every JAD session and key delivery meeting has a clear agenda, required pre-work, appropriate decision-makers, and a specific outcome to be achieved.
* Drive timely decisions and sign-offs by surfacing options, impacts, risks, and recommendations in a concise and fact-based manner.
* Promote collaborative ways of working across Business and Technology teams, resolving conflict constructively and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.

Quality Assurance and Delivery Support
  
  

* Ensure the QA Test Plan and Test Cases fully cover the approved project scope and end-to-end solution and align with expected business and technical results.
* Provide technical or process support during QA to help resolve defects, clarify intended behaviour, remove major blockers, and coordinate the appropriate domain expertise.
* Validate readiness for release by confirming scope completion, solution and security sign-offs, test evidence, operational readiness, dependencies, and outstanding risks.
* Support post-release reviews and continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and strengthening delivery practices.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, solution delivery, program delivery, systems implementation, or a related discipline, including demonstrated leadership across complex initiatives.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional delivery involving Product, Business, Architecture, Engineering, Security, Quality Assurance, Operations, vendors, and multiple technology domains.
* Strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, requirements practices, solution design, estimation, release planning, testing, defect management, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to understand technical and business requirements, evaluate end-to-end impacts, and make sound scope and delivery decisions.
* Experience facilitating JAD or solution-design sessions and driving groups toward clear, documented decisions and accountabilities.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, capacity constraints, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills; able to communicate complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and a bias for action.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and governance requirements within enterprise technology delivery.
* Experience working in Agile, hybrid, and project-based delivery models; familiarity with backlog management and iterative planning practices.
* A collaborative leadership style that builds trust, protects sustainable team capacity, and creates accountability without compromising quality.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders have a shared understanding of scope, solution, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and decisions.
* Delivery plans are integrated, realistic, and aligned to roadmap outcomes, team capacity, security obligations, and release constraints.
* JAD and governance forums produce clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Quality plans provide full coverage of the committed scope and defects are resolved through coordinated, timely support.
* Risks and blockers are identified early, managed transparently, and escalated with options and recommended actions.
* Teams deliver sustainable outcomes through clear roles, practical processes, and trusted cross-functional relationships.

**What’s in it for you?**

Title: Assistant Service Delivery Manager, Aspire Lifestyles
Description:
**About The Role**
About Aspire Lifestyles
  
  
Aspire Lifestyles is a global provider of premium lifestyle management and concierge services, delivering personalised experiences to affluent and high-net-worth (HNW) customers worldwide. The company partners with leading banks, private banking institutions, credit card providers, insurance organisations, telecommunications companies, airlines, hospitality brands and premium retailers to provide bespoke services and exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
With a focus on service excellence, personalised solutions and operational efficiency, Aspire Lifestyles aims to exceed customer expectations through high-touch, seamless and reliable service delivery.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Assistant Service Delivery Manager will oversee the day-to-day management of service delivery operations, ensuring the effective fulfilment of customer requests and the delivery of exceptional concierge experiences. The role involves leading and developing the Lifestyle Concierge team, managing operational performance, maintaining client relationships and ensuring compliance with contractual service commitments, KPIs and SLAs.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for driving a culture of service excellence, operational efficiency and continuous improvement while ensuring that affluent and high-net-worth customers receive personalised, high-quality and seamless service across all communication channels.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery and Client Management**

* Manage daily service delivery across phone, email, chat, web and other channels, ensuring timely, accurate and personalised handling of customer requests.
* Understand client contracts and translate requirements into clear procedures, workflows and standards.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs and operational performance, taking action to address gaps and improve service delivery cost-effectively.
* Build strong working relationships with client contacts and collaborate with Sales and Marketing on client retention, proposals, renewals and RFPs.
* Support and lead programme implementations and operational workflows as required.

**Quality And Customer Experience**

* Ensure consistent, high-quality service and compliance with client and Group standards, including Concierge Standards, PCI-DSS and ISO.
* Manage customer complaints and escalations promptly, ensuring effective resolution.
* Work with Partnerships to operationalise offers and benefits, and with QA and Training teams to conduct call and case reviews.
* Promote a resourceful, customer-focused culture that improves customer experience.

**People and Resource Management**

* Identify staffing and resource requirements and support recruitment.
* Lead, coach and motivate team members; set clear objectives, monitor performance and address development needs.
* Ensure employees understand and follow company policies, procedures and standards.
* Prepare monthly rosters that reflect business needs, coverage requirements and employee skill sets.
* Contribute to reward and recognition initiatives that encourage strong performance.

**Operational Risk, Audit and Compliance**

* Coordinate preparations for internal and external service delivery audits and maintain required standards.
* Ensure Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) procedures are followed during disruptions and escalate risks promptly.
* Promote compliance with company policies, values and occupational health and safety requirements.

**Financial and Business Performance**

* Improve processes and workflows to increase productivity and profitability.
* Manage staffing and operating costs, use resources effectively and support new programmes and services.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and customer value.

**Communication and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Maintain regular communication so the team understands priorities and performance expectations.
* Present departmental performance updates to senior management and clients when required.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Sales, Finance, Partnerships, QA, Training, HR, Recruitment and IT, to coordinate resources and meet business objectives.
* Participate in team meetings and cross-functional initiatives.

**Projects And Other Responsibilities**

* Support technology and transformation initiatives, including digital channels, CRM enhancements and change management.
* Undertake projects and other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Aspire Lifestyles Operations.

**Required Experience, Skills And Qualification**
Required Experience & Qualifications
  
  

* Minimum 5 years of management-level experience.
* Experience in a management role within a lifestyle management or concierge environment.
* Experience managing an operational department with a minimum team size of 15 employees.
* Strong experience in call centre and customer service operations.
* Previous experience in client account management and managing service delivery commitments.
* Demonstrated business acumen and understanding of operational performance and cost management.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Visio.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience in banking, private banking, hospitality, travel, airlines or other premium customer service industries.
* Exposure to managing high-net-worth and affluent customer segments.
* Experience supporting new client implementations, operational transitions and service improvement projects.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Leadership & People Management: Ability to lead, motivate, coach and develop teams while maintaining accountability and high performance.
* Customer Service Excellence: Strong customer-centric mindset with the ability to anticipate customer needs and deliver personalised service experiences.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage challenging conversations and influence stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Ability to assess complex situations, manage escalations and implement effective solutions.
* Drive for Results: Strong focus on achieving operational targets, improving service standards and delivering measurable results.
* Business Acumen: Understanding of operational costs, resource allocation, financial efficiency and opportunities for business improvement.
* Teamwork & Collaboration: Ability to build effective relationships and coordinate with internal, regional and global stakeholders.
* Coaching & Development: Ability to identify development needs, provide constructive feedback and encourage continuous learning.

**Additional Requirements & Conditions**
Language Requirements
  
  

* Excellent spoken and written English and Arabic.
* Additional languages will be considered an advantage.

Working Hours & Flexibility
  
  

* Flexibility to work varying shifts between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, including weekends, depending on operational requirements.
* Willingness to support business requirements and operational priorities as needed.

Travel Requirements
  
  

* Minimal travel, as required.

Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help customers and partners use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster , at lower cost? At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we’re hiring a technical Engagement Manager to lead AWS consultants, partners and client teams. These professional services engagements focus on the full platform of AWS customer solutions to help our customers and partners remove constraints and accelerate their journey to AWS.

As Engagement Manager you will manage projects independently and also deliver as part of larger teams.

* Perform strategic planning and develop near-term, mid-term, and long-term implementation roadmaps.
* Utilize the ServiceNow ticketing platform to efficiently manage, track, and route incoming work requests and operational issues.
* Process contract transition workflows from legacy agreements (e.g., Networx) to the new Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) contract.

The mission of the Cornerstone - Design, Build, and Operations (DBO) Team to own and drive strategic, operational and tactical initiatives that improve US Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) operations by planning, designing, operating, and managing Remote Management Facilities (RMFs). Our team is looking for an experienced Secure Facility Operations Manager (SFOM). SFOM's lead daily facility operations, security, and continuity of operations (COOP). This role requires someone with strong relationship building skills. Someone who will work with stakeholders on strategic planning/projects.  
  
The SFOM will develop mechanisms to work across various organizations. The SFOM will define and execute plans for facility maintenance of critical infrastructure and other operational components. The SFOM will play a critical role in partnering with a group of diverse teams to meet team and business level objectives. The ideal SFOM will have facility operations, critical infrastructure, and process improvement experience.
  
  
You must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams. Have the ability to hold technical discussions to troubleshoot project management issues. Be willing to find ways to remove barriers to project success. This position is essential and SFOM's have after hours on-call responsibilities.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Manage daily facility operations and customer requests  
Prioritize and execute tasks  
Document writing and presentations up to the director level  
Serve as Facility Manager responsible for developing plans and programs  
Support and develop budgetary requirements for the operation and maintenance of the facility  
Ensure maintenance, alterations and repairs of the facility are complete and correct  
Maintain alternate work location facilities with other SFOM's  
Serve as the primary coordinator of secured facility emergency actions and planning  
Submit work orders, maintain area security, provide escorting when required
  
Develop and maintain facility operations, procedures, and blueprints  
Manage one or more functions for alternate work facilities. Acquisition, maintenance, and disposal phases in support of COOP  
  
A day in the life  
About AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Why AWS?  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Title: Director, Technology Operations
Description:
**Director, Technical Operations (Platform)**
**Job Type:**
Permanent Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Hybrid - Toronto, Ontario
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Chief Technology Officer
  
  
**Salary**
: $160,000 – $190,000 CAD
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Director, Technology Operations owns the operational health of the platforms Goway sells and services travel on: our reservations platform, the infrastructure it runs on, the supplier, air and distribution integrations it depends on, and the automation and data pipelines built around it.
  
  
This is a practice-building role. You will define and own Goway's technical operations discipline: service levels, incident management, change control, observability and operational readiness, and you will make them the standard across our technology organisation. You will work alongside other Technology leaders. You will own the technology operations of our platform. You will have the CTO's mandate and backing to build the practice.
  
  
**What will be your key responsibilities?**
Reliability and service management
  
  

* Define, publish and report service levels and service-level objectives for revenue-critical services, starting with quoting, booking, payment and traveller servicing.
* Own incident management end to end: severity definitions, escalation, incident command, communication during an incident, and post-incident review with corrective actions.
* Own RCA and problem management.
* Own change and release management as a company standard, balancing delivery throughput against change failure rate.
* Build observability sufficient to detect degradation.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity for platform services, tested and documented on a stated cadence.

Integration and supplier platform operations
  
  

* Monitoring of integration paths, error and failure-rate thresholds, and defined fallback behaviour when a partner degrades.
* Maintain a dependency map of the external platforms our revenue-generating flows rely on, with assessed operational risk and mitigation for each.
* Own operational readiness for new integrations and new product lines entering the platform.
* Own the operational reliability of automation and data pipelines in production.

Platform and cloud operations
  
  

* Day-to-day operation of the AWS and managed hosting infrastructure serving our platform estate: environments, provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
* Own hosting cost governance: visibility by service, a unit-cost measure, and an annual optimisation target.
* Lead capacity planning against forecast booking and travel volumes.
* Reduce manual, repeatable operational work through automation.
* Address seasonal capacity planning, change freezes and enhanced coverage aligned to our booking and departure peaks and to new product launches.

Vendors, partners and compliance
  
  

* Platform, hosting and integration partner relationships: SLA definition, enforcement and structured performance review.
* Reduce single points of dependency, whether on a vendor or an individual.
* Partner with security on vulnerability management, patch compliance, access control and audit readiness.

Practice leadership and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Build and maintain a multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned to Goway's growth plans.
* Report operational performance, risk and investment needs to the CTO and executive team in business terms.

**What are we looking for?**
**Required**

* 8 or more years in platform operations, technical operations, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, including 5 or more years in a lead or leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated accountability for the availability and performance of a revenue-critical transactional platform.
* Evidence of having built operational practice where little existed: SLOs, incident management, change control and observability introduced from the ground up, with measurable improvement to show for it.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, including cost management and multi-environment operation.
* Substantial experience operating and governing third-party platforms and integrations, including holding vendors to service levels.
* Ability to set standards and drive adoption across teams.
* Ability to communicate operational risk and performance.

**Preferred**

* Experience stabilising and operationalising new systems.
* Infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration experience.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate). Solutions Architect certifications are welcome, but less relevant to this role than the operations-focused ones.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or equivalent practical experience.

**What can you expect from Goway?**

* Imagine working for a company where your career feels like an adventure. At Goway, you’ll join a global community that supports one another:
* We offer a competitive salary accompanied by performance incentives, and we place real importance on time away from work, such as paid personal days for when life calls for them and your birthday off each year.
* Our commitment to professional growth means you’ll have access to continuous learning and industry-leading training that keeps you at the forefront of travel innovation.
* You’ll enjoy generous paid time off, including [three] weeks of vacation, [six] personal days, and a dedicated day off to celebrate your birthday.
* Travel is in our DNA, so you’ll enjoy exclusive perks and discounts on worldwide getaways.
* Since we operate across Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Manila, Sydney, and beyond, you’ll collaborate across cultures and shape a career path that reflects your ambitions.
* Goway is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate differences and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. We appreciate every applicant’s interest. Please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**How To Apply**
If this role feels like your next step, click "Apply Now" to create your profile, upload your CV, and share a few details about yourself. Our talent team reviews every application, and if your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out to set up the next step.
  
  
**AI Screening Disclosure**
To help us fairly and efficiently review applications, we use an automated screening process to assess responses to pre-determined questions. This initial step ensures all candidates are evaluated consistently. Qualified applicants will be reviewed by our recruitment team for further consideration.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Goway Travel Ltd will retain applications, notifications, and records related to this posting for three years, reflecting our commitment to fair and equitable hiring practices.
  
  
**Recruitment Scams & Fraud Warning**
Please be aware of any suspicious emails or WhatsApp activity from individuals pretending to be recruiters or senior personnel at Goway Travel. We will never ask you to install an app during the recruitment process. If you receive a message of this nature, please ignore it and report it to Goway.

Title: VP, IT Operations
Description:
Hybrid: Markham, Ontario
  
  
**Job Description**
**About Us**
Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Vice President, IT Operations is accountable for the reliable, secure, resilient and cost-effective operation of Pet Valu’s production technology environment across stores, distribution centres, corporate locations and cloud services. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this executive leads the functions responsible for cybersecurity and governance, infrastructure and platform operations, retail technology operations, service management, service desk, store technology readiness, database operations, network and telecommunications, Microsoft 365 operations, technology resilience, observability, and technology asset and licence management.
  
  
The role establishes a disciplined operating model that protects store uptime and employee productivity while enabling change at pace. The Vice President works closely with Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Architecture and BI, Retail Operations, Loss Prevention, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Internal Audit and external service providers. The role distinguishes platform and software ownership from operational ownership: Enterprise Applications owns business-platform roadmaps such as POS software, while IT Operations owns the reliability, support and hardware lifecycle required to run those platforms successfully.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Strategy**

* Develop and execute an IT Operations strategy aligned with Pet Valu’s business priorities, growth plans, store experience, risk appetite and technology roadmap.
* Establish clear accountability, decision rights, service ownership and operating rhythms across infrastructure, security, retail technology, support and service management.
* Partner with the CTO and peer technology leaders to translate enterprise priorities into capacity plans, operational roadmaps and measurable service commitments.

**Service Reliability, Incident and Change Management**

* Accountable for availability, performance and recoverability of production technology services, with particular attention to store and revenue-critical services.
* Establish enterprise service levels, operational health dashboards, alerting standards and executive reporting for availability, incidents, capacity, risk and customer experience.
* Provide executive leadership during major incidents, ensuring clear command, timely communication, business engagement, recovery focus and disciplined post-incident learning.
* Ensure mature incident, problem, change, service-level, knowledge and service-catalogue practices that reduce repeat failures and improve safe change velocity.
* Drive permanent corrective action through root-cause analysis, trend analysis, technical debt reduction and accountable remediation plans.

**Infrastructure and Platform Operations**

* Oversee cloud, compute, storage, backup, network, telecommunications, database, Microsoft 365, endpoint and platform-engineering operations.
* Ensure lifecycle plans exist for servers, network equipment, firewalls, wireless access points, store technology, endpoints, databases, operating systems and foundational platforms.
* Establish patching, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, capacity, configuration and observability standards, with evidence-based compliance reporting.
* Optimize platform cost and performance through capacity management, licence utilization, cloud financial management, vendor rationalization and automation.
* Clarify the boundary between developer-facing DevOps and release engineering led by Engineering and cloud/platform operations led by IT Operations.

**Retail Technology Operations**

* Own the end-to-end operational health of technology used in stores, ensuring that store outcomes are managed beyond individual support tickets.
* Oversee POS hardware, payment devices, store PCs, handhelds, scanners, printers, peripherals and other in-store technology through defined standards and refresh cycles.
* Own field-service and TechCare performance, vendor dispatch, repeat-visit reduction, store escalation management and cost per store supported.
* Ensure technology readiness for new stores, relocations, renovations, banner conversions and closures through integrated checklists, risk management, cutover and hypercare.
* Partner with Store Systems and Engineering so that POS and store-application releases are operationally ready, supportable and sustainable.

**Cybersecurity, Risk and Loss Prevention Technology**

* Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, vulnerability management, security engineering, governance, risk and compliance.
* Ensure security controls, incident response, privileged access, third-party risk, audit remediation, ICFR and regulatory obligations are integrated into operational practices.
* Partner with Loss Prevention and Retail Operations on enabling platforms, technical controls, and service performance for CCTV, alarm and physical access-control technology.
* Ensure material technology risks are identified, communicated, owned and remediated within agreed timelines, with risk acceptance escalated appropriately.

**Resilience and Disaster Recovery**

* Own technology resilience and disaster recovery governance for critical services, aligned to business impact, recovery time and recovery point requirements.
* Ensure recovery plans, dependency maps, crisis procedures and technical runbooks remain current and are tested regularly.
* Review exercise results and actual incidents, ensure gaps are prioritized, and provide transparent reporting on recovery readiness.

**Financial, Asset and Vendor Management**

* Own the IT Operations operating and capital budgets, forecasts, cost controls and investment proposals.
* Establish sound technology asset, software licence, SaaS and cloud-cost management practices covering inventory accuracy, warranty, refresh, reclamation and secure disposal.
* Lead operational vendor governance through clear service levels, scorecards, escalation paths, service-improvement plans, concentration-risk management and exit readiness.
* Negotiate and manage operational contracts in partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal and the CTO, balancing service quality, flexibility, risk and total cost.

**Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership**
Build a leadership team with appropriate spans of control, succession depth, technical capability and a culture of ownership, transparency, urgency and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Coach and develop leaders and technical teams, set clear performance expectations and create practical career paths across operations, security, service management and retail technology.
* Create a service culture that is responsive to stores and business teams, candid about risk and performance, and disciplined about commitments.
* Build trusted relationships with executive and functional leaders, explain operational risks in business terms, and make trade-offs visible before they become incidents.
* Partner with Architecture on standards and target-state designs, Engineering on release and production readiness, and Enterprise Applications on platform support models and lifecycle planning.

**Success Measures**

* Availability and performance of critical store, corporate and foundational technology services.
* Number and severity of priority incidents, mean time to detect, mean time to restore, repeat incidents and completion of permanent corrective actions.
* Change success rate, emergency change rate, rollback frequency and operational readiness of production releases.
* Store technology availability, POS hardware availability, store satisfaction, field-service SLA attainment, repeat visits and new-store readiness.
* Patch and vulnerability compliance, backup success, recovery-test achievement, audit findings and risk-remediation aging.
* Infrastructure, network, database, Microsoft 365 and endpoint service health, capacity and lifecycle compliance.
* Service Desk first-contact resolution, customer satisfaction, response time, backlog health, knowledge use and escalation quality.
* Budget performance, forecast accuracy, cloud-cost optimization, license utilization, asset-record accuracy and measurable vendor value.
* Leadership-team effectiveness, employee engagement, succession readiness, retention of critical skills and delivery of annual operating priorities.

**Skills, Experience, Education, Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 12 or more years of progressive technology leadership experience, including significant accountability for enterprise IT operations in a complex, distributed environment.
* Demonstrated success leading multi-disciplinary functions such as infrastructure, cloud, networks, database operations, service management, cybersecurity, end-user services or retail technology operations.
* Experience supporting a multi-site or multi-unit business. Retail experience, including store technology, POS, payment devices, field support and new-store readiness, is strongly preferred.
* Proven major-incident leadership and experience establishing measurable service management, problem management, change governance and operational reporting.
* Strong knowledge of hybrid infrastructure, cloud platforms, Microsoft 365, enterprise networking, databases, endpoint management, observability, backup and disaster recovery.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, identity, risk, privacy, audit, PCI-related operating controls and third-party risk management.
* Experience managing substantial operating and capital budgets, technology assets, software licences, cloud consumption and strategic vendors.
* Ability to communicate complex operational and technical matters clearly to executives, business leaders, technical teams and external partners.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong leaders, redesign operating models, manage through ambiguity and deliver measurable improvements without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* ITIL, cloud, security, business-continuity or related professional certifications are assets, but practical operating leadership and results are more important.

**Ready to join the team?**

If you’re energized by doing meaningful work, taking pride in what you deliver, and making a real impact for pets, people, and communities, you’ll feel right at home here. Join us and build a career where purpose, care, and excellence come together - because love lives here™.

At Pet Valu, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We’re passionate about creating an environment where you feel supported, included, and empowered to grow - both personally and professionally. Some of the perks of working with us include:

Title: Manager, Application Support
Description:

As a leading Canadian wealth management organization, Richardson Wealth offers the personal touch of a boutique firm while delivering big results. With offices across the country, we are home to some of Canada’s best investment advisors. We’ve embarked on an exciting growth phase – a multi-year transformational journey to enhance our entrepreneurial, high-performing, advisor-centric culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Application Support Manager leads the team responsible for the health and support of Richardson Wealth’s business applications. The role oversees complex application support, incidents, escalations, operational readiness, service performance, and vendor support. The Manager actively participates in incident triage and prioritization, presents service health, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders, and demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills. Tier 2 owns technical diagnosis and service restoration, while permanent changes are transitioned to the appropriate delivery, data, infrastructure, security, or vendor team. The Manager also develops team capability and uses knowledge, automation, and AI responsibly to improve service quality and efficiency.
  
  
*This is an existing vacancy*
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* People Leadership & Capability: Lead, coach, and develop Tier 2 analysts and specialists; set clear accountabilities, establish coverage and succession plans, manage performance, and build cross-platform expertise.
* Production Service Health & Supportability: Own the operational health, stability, and supportability of assigned applications, integrations, batch processes, data feeds, and operational services. Use monitoring, observability, alerting, logs, and service telemetry to identify risks, service degradation, and emerging issues proactively.
* Incident Management: Ensure complex incidents are triaged, prioritized, investigated, resolved, documented, and communicated in accordance with agreed service-management practices and business-impact considerations. Coordinate root cause analysis (RCA) for significant or recurring incidents, ensuring corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.
* Escalation Management: Lead the response to complex and high-impact issues by engaging and escalating to the appropriate vendors and internal teams. Ensure clear ownership, timely updates, effective hand-offs, and follow-through until service is restored and required corrective actions are completed.
* Operational Readiness: Assess the supportability of releases and production changes, confirming that monitoring, runbooks, support procedures, access, rollback plans, vendor contacts, knowledge transfer, and hypercare arrangements are in place before transition to operations. Delivery owns release content and implementation readiness; Tier 2 confirms operational readiness and ongoing supportability.

Use insights to drive decisions and continuous improvement.

* Risk, Controls & Compliance: Ensure support activities follow change, security, privacy, access, audit, record-keeping, and regulatory control requirements appropriate to a wealth-management environment. Escalate material operational risks and control gaps.

Promote responsible use of AI with appropriate human oversight, data protection, validation, auditability, and control.

* Strong technical knowledge of integrated enterprise application environments, including APIs, data feeds, batch processes, identity and access, databases, cloud or hosted services, and third-party platforms.
* Experience supporting operational readiness and production transitions, including monitoring, runbooks, rollback and hypercare planning, vendor coordination, and adherence to security, privacy, audit, resilience, and production-control requirements.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams on release planning, operational readiness, and continuous improvement.
* Strong people-management skills, including coaching, performance management, succession planning, and developing technical talent.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver concise incident updates and explain technical issues, risks, and trade-offs to business and executive stakeholders.
* Experience in wealth management, financial services, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accountability, sound judgement, customer focus, and attention to detail.

**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**

**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**

* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**

* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

  

**Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance**

* Oversee the governance function responsible for developing, maintaining and enforcing policies, standards, security architecture principles, exception management and industry frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, AI frameworks).
* Lead the third-party and partner risk management program (covering vendors and technology contracts) in close collaboration with the Legal Services and Procurement teams.
* Co-develop a governance, compliance and ethical framework for the enterprise-wide use of AI and generative AI, assessing specific risks throughout their life cycle.
* Ensure strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., Quebec’s Law 25, GDPR and sector-specific requirements).
* Drive a cybersecurity culture and awareness program focused on lasting behaviour change across the organization.

  

**Defence Operations, SOC and Crisis Management**

* Oversee the performance and modernization of the Security Operations Centre (SOC), advanced detection tools (SIEM, EDR/XDR, automation) and continuous threat monitoring.
* Direct major security incident response operations and lead technology crisis management, from detection to full business recovery.
* Oversee regular penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and cyberattack simulation exercises across IT, broadcast and distribution environments.

  

**Identity and End-User Technology**

* Guide the strategic vision for Identity and Access Management (IAM, PAM) to provide secure, simple and frictionless access for all staff and contractors.
* Collaborate closely with the End-User Technology teams to align security with a modern, efficient and intuitive employee experience.

  

**Financial Management and Team Engagement**

* Plan and optimize the cybersecurity department’s overall budget and partner with internal procurement teams to negotiate major technology contracts.
* Inspire, coach and develop a team of directors and senior managers — fostering excellence, innovation and cross-functional collaboration.
* Lead with the heart.

  

**Qualifications, Experience and Core Competencies**

**Education and Certifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, computer engineering, business administration (IT concentration) or a related field.
* At least one recognized executive-level professional certification: **CISSP, CISM, CCISO, CISA** or **CRISC**.

  

**Professional Experience**

* Seven to 10 years of experience managing professional teams or equivalent.
* Deep expertise in technology architecture, cloud security, network infrastructure, cryptography, and identity and access management (IAM).
* Ability to provide collaborative leadership within the organization to see complex, transformational initiatives through to completion.
* Demonstrated skills in planning, organizing and engaging teams.
* Proven ability and track record in leading cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work with cross-functional, agile teams or on projects that have multi-team dependencies.
* Ability to distil complex issues into clear, concise presentations and reports.
* Expertise in the various technologies typically used by journalists in a newsroom.
* Knowledge of business practices, including drafting plans and specifications, contracts, negotiation, finance, and IT management software.
* Knowledge of software development and the technology infrastructure required for product delivery.
* Knowledge of workflows for content acquisition, management and distribution, with a focus on storytelling.
* Innovative approach to technical and operational challenges, paired with sound judgment to protect CBC/Radio-Canada from legal liability and financial loss.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with an ability to engage and influence stakeholders and partners at every level of the organization.
* Excellent ability to listen to and communicate with people having different points of view or competing business objectives.
* Experience implementing product governance models.
* Ability to travel occasionally between Montreal and Toronto.
* Bilingualism (English and French), both spoken and written.

Title: Test Manager | National Digital Services Programme | Doha, Qatar
Description:
**Test Manager | National Digital Services Programme | Doha, Qatar**

6-month contract, then permanent | Onsite

A government ministry in Qatar is building a national citizen-facing super app. It brings services from many government and private-sector bodies into one mobile app. Each release is tested at several levels by different parties. We need one person to make those levels work as a single, joined-up process.

As Test Manager, you will own the test process for the app: the plan, the standards, the evidence and the reporting across all test levels. The delivery vendor runs unit, integration, end-to-end and regression testing, and you set what it must test and show. Your main focus is user acceptance testing (UAT) and the hand-over between levels, so that nothing is tested twice and nothing is missed. You will lead the client’s UAT testers and report to Programme Management.

**What you’ll do**

* Define the test levels, with entry and exit criteria, and keep one test plan per release
* Agree what the vendor tests and what evidence it hands over, review its results before UAT starts, and send work back when the evidence falls short
* Work with the vendor and the hosting team so test environments and masked or synthetic test data are ready on time
* Own the regression pack: decide what is automated and what is manual, keep it current, and make sure it runs before every release
* Make sure end-to-end tests cover complete user journeys, including payments and connections to partner systems
* Plan and lead UAT for each release, and support the representatives of partner organisations as they test and sign off their own services
* Run one defect process across all levels: severity definitions, triage with the vendor and Product Owner, and closure with evidence. Analyse defects that slipped through and tighten the tests.
* Report test status in plain figures, with a readiness recommendation for each service
* Give the Change and Release Manager the test evidence for each release
* Support go-live readiness and the first limited release to real users

**What you’ll bring**

* 7+ years in software testing, including at least 3 years as a test manager or test lead covering more than one test level, on a system delivered by two or more suppliers
* A strong record writing test strategies and plans, and judging when testing is complete enough
* Experience planning and leading UAT with business users who are not professional testers
* A sound grasp of test automation and CI/CD. You can judge a supplier’s automation; you don’t need to write the code.
* Testing experience with mobile apps (iOS and Android), web services and APIs
* Jira or a similar tool (Xray, Zephyr, Azure DevOps Test Plans)
* Experience leading testers and getting results from several suppliers and organisations with different priorities
* Clear written and spoken English, including reports for non-technical readers
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, engineering or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Testing government, regulated-sector or payment services
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Test Manager
* Arabic

* Onsite at the client’s premises in Doha
* Extended or weekend hours may be needed in the weeks before go-live
* The role involves confidential government test data

**What You'll Be Doing**
Nationwide CCTV Deployment Planning and Coordination
  
  

* Lead program level planning, mobilization, and delivery coordination for the nationwide CCTV deployment program within the agreed PMO scope.
* Develop and maintain the technical workstream delivery plan, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, costs, and benefits, and provide validated updates to the integrated program baseline maintained by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls.
* Coordinate technical workstreams covering CCTV infrastructure, command-and-control platforms, connectivity, data storage, monitoring, analytics, cybersecurity, and systems integration.
* Define deployment models, implementation phases, site prioritization criteria, rollout sequencing, and readiness requirements.

* Ensure alignment between technology deployment, operational processes, service requirements, and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Monitor implementation progress and take corrective action where there are schedule, cost, quality, resource, or technical risks.
* Coordinate delivery activities across internal teams, contractors, technology suppliers, government entities, and other external partners.
* Coordinate confirmation of technical standards, acceptance criteria, quality controls, and documentation requirements with the responsible technical and delivery owners, and monitor the associated assurance and readiness evidence.

Regulatory and Operational Framework Development
  
  

* Coordinate the development of regulatory compliance and operational frameworks required to support the CCTV program with the responsible client and specialist owners.
* Define policies, procedures, standards, controls, roles, responsibilities, and approval mechanisms for CCTV deployment and operation.
* Ensure that program activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, privacy requirements, data protection principles, cybersecurity standards, and government policies.
* Develop operating models covering surveillance operations, monitoring, incident management, access controls, data retention, evidence handling, system maintenance, and service support.
* Establish operational readiness criteria, service management processes, escalation routes, and performance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, data protection, law enforcement, and operational stakeholders.
* Support the development of regulatory submissions, technical standards, operating procedures, compliance controls, and assurance documentation.
* Establish mechanisms for ongoing compliance monitoring, audit readiness, risk management, and continuous improvement.

Technical Laboratory Establishment and Operational Readiness
  
  

* Lead program-level planning and coordination for establishing the client’s technical laboratory as an innovation, testing, demonstration, and operational readiness environment.
* Define the Lab’s purpose, scope, capabilities, governance model, operating procedures, and success measures.
* Develop requirements for Lab infrastructure, systems, equipment, connectivity, cybersecurity, data environments, and testing capabilities.
* Coordinate and monitor the program plans, interfaces, and readiness evidence for the design, procurement, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of Lab facilities and technology by the appointed delivery entities.
* Establish processes for proof-of-concept testing, solution validation, interoperability assessment, demonstrations, training, and technology evaluation.
* Develop the Lab operating model, including staffing, support, maintenance, access management, health and safety, and asset management.
* Coordinate operational readiness reviews, track readiness evidence and outstanding actions, and support formal acceptance of the Lab by the authorized client and operational owners before launch.
* Develop a roadmap for future Lab capabilities, innovation partnerships, vendor engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure that lessons learned and validated technical standards are incorporated into the wider CCTV deployment program

Procurement and Market Engagement
  
  

* activities, and market engagement.
* Coordinate the development and specialist review of technical requirements, statements of work, specifications, evaluation criteria, service levels, and acceptance criteria with the responsible technical owners.
* Support market sounding, supplier briefings, requests for information, requests for proposals, tenders, and competitive dialogue activities.
* Engage with technology vendors, system integrators, telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, consultants, and specialist service providers.
* Assess market capability, technology maturity, supplier capacity, delivery risks, and commercial models.
* Participate in supplier evaluation, clarification sessions, negotiations, due diligence, and recommendation processes.
* Ensure procurement packages are aligned with the program roadmap, regulatory framework, operating model, and commercial objectives.
* Support contract mobilization, supplier governance, performance management, change control, and issue resolution.
* Monitor supplier delivery against contractual requirements, milestones, quality standards, and key performance indicators

Program Governance, Controls, and Reporting
  
  

* Apply the program governance, controls, reporting, and escalation framework established by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls, and lead the corresponding technical assurance and operational readiness arrangements.
* Prepare technical delivery inputs to program board papers, steering committee materials, executive reports, dashboards, and delivery updates.
* Monitor program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, issues, dependencies, benefits, and operational readiness.
* Maintain technical workstream registers, including risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, changes, actions, and lessons learned, and provide updates to the consolidated program records.
* Lead technical and operational readiness reviews and provide the technical evidence and recommendations required for program stage gates, assurance reviews, and health checks.
* Ensure that decisions and actions are documented, assigned, tracked, and escalated where necessary.
* Provide clear recommendations to senior leadership on program priorities, risks, options, and corrective actions.
* Ensure program documentation is complete, accurate, current, and compliant with governance requirements.
* Distinguishes ownership of the PMO governance framework and integrated baseline from Technical Delivery’s technical assurance, readiness reviews, and delivery inputs.

Stakeholder and Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, regulators, internal business units, suppliers, technology partners, and operational teams.
* Lead cross-functional workshops and facilitate alignment between technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, and procurement stakeholders.
* Manage competing priorities and resolve complex program-level issues.
* Communicate technical and program information clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
* Support stakeholder engagement, change management, communications, training, and adoption activities.
* Represent the program at internal and external forums, industry events, supplier meetings, and governance committees.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, project management, telecommunications, business, or a related discipline.
* 20 experience managing complex technical programs, preferably involving large-scale technology deployment, security systems, smart infrastructure, telecommunications, or public-sector transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading nationwide, multi-site, or multi-stakeholder implementation programs.
* Experience developing technical and operational frameworks, governance models, standards, and operating procedures.
* Experience defining and commercializing technology-enabled services or service bundles.
* Experience establishing technical laboratories, innovation centers, testing environments, or operational readiness facilities.
* Strong understanding of procurement, supplier engagement, tendering, technical evaluation, and contract mobilization.
* Experience working with CCTV, video management systems, command-and-control platforms, IoT, analytics, artificial intelligence, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or related technologies.
* Proven experience managing program budgets, schedules, risks, dependencies, vendors, and delivery performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* Program or project management certification, such as PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent.
* Degree or professional qualification in engineering, technology, cybersecurity, telecommunications, or systems integration.
* Experience in physical security, surveillance, smart cities, critical infrastructure, public safety, or government technology programs.
* Experience with privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and information governance.
* Experience with commercialization, product management, service design, or business development.
* Experience managing major systems integrators and technology vendors.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, systems engineering, service management, and operational technology environments.
* Experience with Agile, waterfall, hybrid, or scaled program delivery methodologies.

* Establish clear objectives, expectations, and accountabilities aligned with department and business priorities.

* Build team capability through coaching, cross-training, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Ensure employees understand the Microsoft program requirements and internal controls applicable to their work.
* Manage staffing, workload allocation, scheduling, and coverage to support business volumes and service commitments.
* Foster a collaborative environment grounded in ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, and customer focus.
* Act as an escalation point for complex operational, customer, compliance, and people-related matters.

* Ensure transactions are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with Microsoft requirements, customer commitments, and internal standards.
* Establish clear priorities, workflows, ownership, and escalation paths across the business.
* Monitor operational performance through scorecards, service levels, productivity measures, quality results, and other relevant indicators.
* Identify trends, capacity risks, process gaps, and recurring issues, and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken.
* Provide leadership and direction during complex licensing scenarios, high-volume periods, and customer-impacting escalations.
* Maintain effective business rhythms that give leadership and stakeholders appropriate visibility into performance, risk, and required decisions.
* Microsoft Program and Transaction Compliance
* Partner with Microsoft to understand changes to licensing programs, operational requirements, transaction rules, and partner obligations.
* Translate Microsoft requirements into clear internal procedures, controls, training, and operational practices.
* Ensure Microsoft compliance requirements are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, and other teams to establish and manage controls that support both partner and organizational obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and evidence to support internal reviews, Microsoft assessments, audits, and other compliance activities.
* Conduct or oversee periodic reviews of transactions, processes, and controls to identify gaps and confirm adherence to established requirements.
* Ensure compliance findings, transaction exceptions, and control failures are documented, escalated, remediated, and monitored through completion.
* Promote a culture in which compliance is embedded into daily operations rather than treated as a separate review after the transaction is complete.
* Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and relevant internal policies.
