* Lead practical improvements to workflows, documentation, controls, reporting, and supporting tools.
* Use operational data, quality findings, audit results, and employee and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements.
* Partner with IT and operational improvement teams to define business requirements and support changes to systems and tools.
* Ensure process or system changes are tested, documented, communicated, and adopted effectively.
* Support automation where it improves accuracy, control, capacity, or customer experience without weakening operational oversight.
* Establish sustainable standard operating procedures and ensure they remain current as Microsoft requirements and internal business needs evolve.

Title: Manager, Operations Integration Subways
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
The Manager, Operations Integration – Subways plays a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of subway and LRT services. The position provides operational, technical and functional oversight of operator, maintainer and project agreements across the subway and LRT programs, supporting high-quality, customer-focused transportation services that are safe, timely and delivered in accordance with contractual requirements.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Oversee the planning, coordination and delivery of subway and LRT services, ensuring safe, effective and efficient customer movement, service levels, schedules and operational plans align with Metrolinx strategies and organizational objectives.
* Manage operator, contractor and maintainer performance against service level plans, contractual obligations and KPIs; identify non-compliance, implement mitigation and corrective action strategies, and ensure quality assurance and continuous service improvement.
* Lead the development, implementation and monitoring of operational plans, management programs, policies, procedures, workflows, SOPs and performance measures in consultation with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, regulatory, legal and contractual requirements through audits, monitoring, risk assessments and engagement with regulatory bodies, while incorporating industry best practices and emerging issues.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level reports, presentations and operational studies outlining service performance, KPIs, strategic directions, findings and improvement initiatives to Metrolinx leadership and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate operational activities across Metrolinx departments and business units, providing transportation expertise and input into major service improvement projects, service extensions, operational planning and negotiations with internal partners.
* Represent Metrolinx on contractual, operational and transportation development matters with service providers, contractors, consultants, industry associations, government representatives and other external partners.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partners, vendors and government representatives through ongoing communication, consultation, negotiation and issue resolution.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by researching, recommending and implementing new or revised standards, specifications, processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, customer service, design standards and safety.
* Manage departmental activities, service delivery objectives and budgetary requirements while providing leadership, guidance and constructive feedback to contractors, consultants and partners, ensuring appropriate resources, capabilities, performance standards and positive working relationships.

**What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?**

* Completion of a degree in Business, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Demonstrated years' of progressively responsible experience in the transportation and/or public transit sector, including leadership of frontline staff and/or project management, ideally within the public sector.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is considered an asset. A Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation is also an asset but not required.
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal competencies, including service-focused and transformational leadership, effective communication, sound decision-making, delivering results, building high-performance cultures, energizing teams, personal effectiveness and alignment with organizational values.
* Knowledge of applicable Human Resources legislation, including the Employment Standards Act and Occupational Health and Safety Act, as well as railway operating rules and legislation governing railway, environmental, public and employee safety.
* Strong knowledge of transportation, engineering and planning, including commuter rapid transit (subway, LRT and BRT) system planning, design and delivery, maintenance facilities, stations, storage yards and related infrastructure.
* Understanding of transit system functional requirements and technical components, including signalling and train control, SCADA, communications, trackwork, vehicle and wayside interfaces, traction power, power supply and distribution, mechanical systems, system and train simulation, tunnels, and fire and life safety systems.
* Knowledge of System Safety Certification processes and the ability to identify technical inadequacies, evaluate plans and apply appropriate rail transportation analytical tools.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing employees and contractors, applying collective agreement provisions, overseeing vendors and externally provided services, monitoring contractual performance, and understanding IT capabilities and budget planning and monitoring processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), with strong written, verbal, interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare reports and communicate operational studies, findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

**There will be multiple vacancies for this position, and the**
**recruitment for this requisition may be used to fill future permanent roles with substantially similar requirements.**
***This role requires the successful candidate to be at the office, f**
**ive days per week, with regular travel throughout the Toronto area (at least twice weekly), availability outside regular business hours to maintain relationships and address operational issues, and site visits to transit operating environments, including train facilities and above- and below-grade track alignments. Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required at worksites.***
**Don’t Meet Every Requirement?**
If you’re excited about working with Metrolinx but your past experience doesn’t quite align with every qualification of this posting, we encourage you to apply. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. We are always looking for great talent to join our team.
  
  
We invite all interested individuals to apply and encourage applications from members of equity-deserving communities, including those who identify as Indigenous, Black, racialized, women, people with disabilities, and people with diverse gender identities, expressions and sexual orientations.
  
  
**Accommodation**
Metrolinx is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are also committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants in accordance with applicable legislation. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point during the hiring process, please contact us at: 416-202-5601 or email hr.recruitment@metrolinx.com.

All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Metrolinx will be using email to communicate with you for all job competitions. It is your responsibility to include an updated email address that is checked daily and accepts emails from unknown users. As we send time-sensitive correspondence, we recommend that you check your email regularly. If no response is received, we will assume you are no longer interested in pursuing the opportunity. Please be advised that a Criminal Record Check may be required of the successful candidate.

Candidates must be in their current role for 12 months prior to applying for another role and each applicant must be in good standing (not participating in a Performance Improvement Plan). Please review all provisions of the policy before submitting your application.

**Description:**

  

The Risk Operations and Visibility Manager position is part of the Information Security Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) team and will focus on the Risk Operations and Visibility function. This position will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing findings from vulnerability management and attack surface management tools to identify, prioritize, and track information security exposures across the University's environment and consolidating findings from multiple technical sources into a unified risk view of the University's threat landscape.

  

The incumbent shall possess advance knowledge of IT security tools and technologies amidst a continually evolving threat landscape and to apply such knowledge in evaluating the performance of the operational security risks by producing clear, actionable reporting and risk narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including academic and administrative leadership. They will liaise with distributed IT teams across faculties and divisions to support timely remediation and closure of identified exposures and vulnerabilities while researching, recommending, and supporting the use of software and tools for vulnerability management, attack surface management, and risk reporting to build the internal expertise and function of risk operations and visibility management.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

EDUCATION:

  

* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information security, or equivalent combination of education and experience. A relevant certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, GIAC GSEC, CRISC, or equivalent) is an strong asset

  

EXPERIENCE:

  

* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in creating, implementing, and maintaining Information Security management programs with a broad range of platforms and technologies
* In-depth knowledge of Information Security controls applicable for web applications, cloud, IoT, mobile applications, networks, and servers
* Minimum 3 years experience performing security assessments of infrastructure (cloud and on-premises), applications and websites
* Minimum 3 years experience working with vulnerability management lifecycle concepts (discovery, scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking) and CVSS/exploitability-based scoring (e.g., EPSS); ability to interpret output from vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) and attack surface management / cyber security posture management tools (e.g. Falcon, etc.)
* Understanding of Information Security and Risk Management frameworks like ISO27001, ISO27005, NIST CSF and NIST 800-30
* Deep understanding of exposure management and external attack surface management processes
* Experience in grouping individual vulnerabilities and risks for overall reporting purposes
* Experience in threat monitoring and threat intelligence
* Familiarity with legal and regulatory requirements like PCI-DSS, PIPEDA, PHIPA, GDPR etc

  

SKILLS:

  

* Able to think strategically about change and new solutions
* Strong writing, communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to produce high quality, comprehensive communications materials and articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong leadership and problem-solving skills
* Ability to prioritize and reprioritize work as required
* Adept at conforming to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Proficiency with data analytics and data aggregation; experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and basic scripting (Python, PowerShell) is an asset
* Thirst for knowledge, self-education, and research
* Strong organizational skills in planning and task coordination

  

OTHER:

  

Ability to work under pressure of high volume and expectations, while meeting multiple deadlines for multiple projects; strong service orientation coupled with ability to recognize and assess the operational significance of a problem, control/mitigate the risk, and set priorities accordingly. Strong ability to assess risks and controls of computing systems and operations. Demonstrated broad knowledge of information technology, instructional technology, classroom technology, audiovisual technologies, digital signage, network technologies, databases, and application development. Strong ability and willingness to work effectively as a team leader and team member; must be able to collaborate and cooperate with team members, project sponsors, other stakeholders. Ability to lead team members of varying levels and skill sets including Professional/Managerial as well as staff. Must be able to deal calmly and effectively with a variety of people. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, tact, and diplomacy. Ability to effectively navigate a professional and political climate including assessing the requirement to escalate and issue to more senior levels of management or resources or bodies outside the Faculty; ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality. Ability and willingness to learn new systems, technologies and project management methods and tools.

Title: IT Project Manager
Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**IT Project Manager – ERP & E-Invoicing Implementation**

**Job Title:** IT Project Manager  
**Department:** Information Technology / Project Management  
**Location:** UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (preferred)  
**Reporting To:** Head of IT / Director / Management

**1. Job Purpose**

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and results-oriented IT Project Manager to plan, coordinate, execute, and deliver IT implementation projects, particularly in the areas of ERP systems, e-invoicing, ERP add-on solutions, business process automation, and other technology-driven initiatives.

The candidate will be responsible for managing projects from initiation through completion, acting as the primary coordination point between clients, management, functional consultants, technical teams, and external vendors.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent project management, client relationship management, communication, scheduling, and reporting skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning & Execution**

* Develop comprehensive project plans, implementation schedules, milestones, and delivery timelines.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, resource requirements, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate and manage end-to-end implementation projects, including ERP implementations, e-invoicing solutions, ERP add-ons, and system integrations.
* Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and ensure timely completion of milestones.
* Identify potential project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delays and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and utilization of project resources.
* Manage multiple client projects simultaneously.

**B. Client Coordination & Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct project kick-off meetings and coordinate discussions with client stakeholders.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with functional and technical teams to ensure proper execution.
* Schedule client meetings, workshops, review sessions, and follow-up discussions.
* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding project progress, pending activities, issues, and deliverables.
* Follow up with clients for data, documents, approvals, access credentials, and other implementation requirements.
* Manage client expectations and ensure a positive project delivery experience.

**C. ERP Implementation & System Integration**

* Coordinate ERP implementation, customization, enhancement, and integration projects.
* Work closely with functional consultants, developers, database administrators, and third-party vendors.
* Monitor requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, UAT, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate data migration, system integration, user training, and post-implementation support.
* Ensure proper documentation of business requirements, functional specifications, testing results, and project sign-offs.

**D. Meetings, Scheduling & Follow-ups**

* Organize and schedule internal and external project meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas and circulate them to relevant stakeholders.
* Record meeting minutes (MoM), action points, responsibilities, and target completion dates.
* Follow up with respective team members and clients to ensure closure of pending action items.
* Maintain project calendars and ensure that all important milestones and meetings are scheduled in advance.

**E. Project Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly project progress reports to management and clients.
* Maintain project trackers covering milestones, deliverables, pending tasks, dependencies, and completion status.
* Monitor project timelines and highlight delays or deviations.
* Prepare management dashboards highlighting project status, risks, issues, and resource utilization.
* Escalate critical issues and seek management intervention wherever necessary.
* Ensure timely submission and approval of project deliverables.

**F. Documentation & Quality Management**

* Maintain project documentation, including:
* Project Charter and Project Plan.
* Requirement Gathering Documents.
* Meeting Minutes and Action Trackers.
* Project Milestone and Progress Reports.
* Risk and Issue Registers.
* Testing and UAT Sign-off Documents.
* Go-Live and Project Closure Reports.
* Ensure proper documentation and handover of completed projects to support teams.
* Coordinate hypercare and post-go-live support activities.

**G. UAE E-Invoicing Project Management – (preferable)**

* Coordinate e-invoicing and similar implementation projects.
* Understand the overall e-invoicing framework, Peppol architecture, PINT AE specifications, and relevant FTA/MoF requirements.
* Coordinate with clients to understand their existing invoicing processes, ERP systems, and business requirements.
* Plan and monitor ERP integration, e-invoice configuration, testing, validation, and go-live activities.
* Coordinate with technical teams, ERP consultants, and Accredited Service Providers (ASPs), where applicable.
* Track implementation issues, functional gaps, testing results, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure that project deliverables are completed in accordance with agreed regulatory and implementation requirements.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in IT project management, ERP implementation, or IT consulting.
* Experience managing multiple client-facing implementation projects.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or other business management solutions.
* Exposure to e-invoicing implementation, system integration, or digital transformation projects will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of UAE VAT and the UAE e-invoicing framework will be an added advantage.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or other project management certifications will be preferred.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent project planning and execution skills.
* Strong client coordination and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong organizational, scheduling, and follow-up capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Strong reporting and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and MS Project or equivalent project management tools.
* Familiarity with Jira, Trello, Monday.com, Asana, or similar project tracking tools.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to project deadlines.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* **Project Delivery:** Percentage of projects completed within agreed timelines.
* **Milestone Achievement:** Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* **Client Satisfaction:** Client feedback and satisfaction levels.
* **Project Reporting:** Timely submission of project progress reports and status updates.
* **Issue Resolution:** Effective tracking and closure of project issues and action items.
* **Meeting Management:** Effective scheduling, documentation, and follow-up of meetings.
* **Project Documentation:** Completeness and accuracy of project documentation.
* **Resource Coordination:** Effective coordination and utilization of internal and external resources.
* **Go-Live Management:** Successful coordination of testing, deployment, and go-live activities.

**6. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on project manager who can independently manage day-to-day project activities without requiring continuous supervision.

The candidate must be comfortable interacting with senior client management, coordinating with technical and functional teams, managing implementation schedules, preparing progress reports, and ensuring that all stakeholders remain aligned with project objectives.

Experience in an IT consulting or software implementation company, particularly in ERP and e-invoicing projects, will be highly preferred.

Pay: AED5,900.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: IT Operations Lead
Description:
***About SJC***

*SJC*
stands as Canada’s largest privately owned communications company, distinguished by its portfolio of leading media brands, including Toronto Life, Chatelaine, and Maclean’s. ***About the Role***

Our IT team is seeking an IT Operations Lead to manage the people and systems that keep our infrastructure, network, and endpoints secure, reliable, and well maintained. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage and grow a small IT team while remaining hands-on as our Tier 3 escalation point for the more complex issues that come up day to day. The role touches on-prem server administration, networking, cloud infrastructure, and endpoint management, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity readiness—including planning and running tabletop exercises that stress-test our incident response. We're also looking for someone who brings an automation-first mindset, encouraging the use of AI tools and scripting to reduce manual toil across on-prem and cloud environments. You'll work closely with the Director, Engineering & Technology and other stakeholders across the business to set IT priorities, develop your team, and keep our people prepared for whatever comes next.

***What You'll Do in this Role:***

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small IT team, setting priorities, running performance and growth conversations, and building the team's on-call and incident response capabilities.
* Own Tier 3 escalations: stepping in on the trickier infrastructure, networking, and security issues that Tier 1/2 support can't resolve.
* Oversee on-prem server infrastructure, corporate networking, cloud infrastructure and identity, and endpoint management, ensuring these are reliable, secure, and well maintained (working with vendors or MSPs where deep specialist support is needed).
* Champion the organization's cybersecurity posture, including access management, patching cadence, and backup/recovery practices.
* Plan and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test and improve incident response readiness across IT and the broader business.
* Enforce support standards and processes and hold the team accountable to them.
* Assist the Director in evaluating external vendors and managed service providers.
* Encourage and guide the adoption of AI tools and automation/scripting to streamline IT operations, user management, and security monitoring.
* Collaborate with production, facilities, and business stakeholders to support office and infrastructure needs.
* Ensure documentation, systems, and runbooks are kept current to support consistency and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Experienced IT generalist with solid working knowledge of on-prem server environments and enterprise networks, and a genuine interest in staying hands-on with day-to-day technical problems.

* Enthusiastic about using AI tools and automation/scripting to make IT operations more efficient, even if not a deep scripting expert.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical risk and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
* Comfortable with balancing hands-on Tier 3 work with people management, planning, and strategic responsibilities.

* On-prem & networking: General comfort administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments and troubleshooting LAN/WAN, VPN, and firewall issues.
* Cloud & identity: Working knowledge of a major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and identity/access tools (e.g., Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO).
* Endpoint management: Familiarity with common endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, JAMF, SCCM) for provisioning and securing devices.

* AI & automation: Interest and some experience in using AI tools or scripting/automation platforms to streamline IT operations.
* Service management: Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools, SLA design, and Tier 1–3 support structures.

The Program Manager serves as the senior point of accountability and escalation for project delivery within the region. The role ensures that engagements are delivered to consistent Genesys standards, achieve the customer’s intended business outcomes, maintain strong customer and executive confidence, and meet Genesys revenue, margin and financial-performance objectives.
  
  
Working across Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, partners and customer leadership teams, the Program Manager creates the alignment, governance and executive focus required to deliver complex transformation programs successfully.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic and Mega-Engagement Leadership**

* Lead Genesys’ largest and most complex customer programs from initiation through deployment, adoption, value realization and transition to ongoing Customer Success.
* Establish the overall program vision, governance model, delivery strategy, integrated roadmap and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate multiple projects, workstreams, countries, partners and stakeholder groups as one integrated program.
* Ensure that scope, solution design, delivery plans and priorities remain aligned with the customer’s strategic and operational objectives.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with customer sponsors and provide clear, outcome-oriented program reporting.
* Drive timely decisions, remove cross-functional obstacles and maintain momentum across the entire engagement.
* Ensure effective transition from sales to delivery and from implementation to adoption and ongoing success.

**Regional Delivery Governance**

* Provide oversight of the regional project portfolio, with particular focus on strategic, high-value, high-risk or escalated engagements.
* Establish and enforce consistent delivery standards, governance practices, project controls and quality expectations.
* Conduct regular portfolio and project-health reviews covering scope, schedule, financials, staffing, dependencies, risks, customer sentiment and business outcomes.
* Ensure project teams maintain effective governance artifacts, including integrated plans, RAID logs, decision records, financial forecasts, status reports and escalation plans.
* Identify systemic delivery risks, capability gaps and recurring project issues, and lead regional improvement initiatives.
* Promote the consistent application and continuous improvement of Genesys delivery methodologies and best practices.
* Coach Project Managers, Delivery Managers and project leads on program governance, executive communication, risk management and customer engagement.

**Escalation and Risk Management**

* Act as the senior point of escalation for project-delivery issues across the region.
* Establish clear escalation paths, ownership, decision rights and recovery actions.
* Intervene early when project conditions could affect customer objectives, delivery commitments, revenue, margin or customer confidence.
* Lead recovery planning for critical projects, bringing together the appropriate Genesys, partner and customer stakeholders.
* Escalate product, support, resource or commercial dependencies to the relevant leadership teams and drive them through resolution.
* Ensure material risks and issues are communicated transparently, with clearly defined business impact, accountable owners and target resolution dates.
* Balance immediate issue resolution with protection of the long-term customer relationship.

**Customer Business-Value Realization**

* Translate customer strategic priorities into measurable program objectives, operational KPIs and value-realization plans.
* Ensure every strategic engagement has clearly defined success measures covering business outcomes, customer experience, operational performance, adoption and financial value.
* Maintain traceability between contracted deliverables, implementation outcomes and the customer’s business case.
* Work with Customer Success and account teams to monitor adoption, benefits realization and achievement of agreed outcomes following deployment.

Title: Cybersecurity Manager
Description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Cyber Security Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of information security controls across Daman Securities and Daman Investments. The role manages the relationship with the Group's managed security service provider, runs vulnerability management and incident response, maintains security policies and the risk register, and supports regulatory and audit requests. The Cyber Security Manager reports to the Group CIO and executes the Group's information security program rather than setting Group strategy.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Security Operations & Incident Response**

* Manage the day-to-day relationship with the managed SOC / MSSP, including alert triage, escalation, and tracking performance against SLA.
* Execute incident response playbooks, coordinate containment and recovery, and support post-incident review and regulatory notification under the Group CIO's direction.
* Run the vulnerability management programme and coordinate penetration testing, tracking findings through to remediation.

**Policy, Risk & Compliance Support**

* Maintain and update information security policies, standards, and procedures within the framework set by the Group CIO.
* Maintain the information security risk register and produce regular reporting on risk position and remediation status.
* Prepare evidence and coordinate responses for internal audit, external audit, and CMA regulatory requests on information security matters.
* Support responses to institutional due diligence reviews and client security questionnaires for Daman Securities and Daman Investments clients.

**Identity, Access & Data Security**

* Administer identity and access management processes, including joiner-mover-leaver workflows, privileged access, and periodic access recertification.
* Support data classification, data loss prevention, and encryption standards, and test backup and recovery restorability.
* Provide security input on change requests — new systems, integrations, and vendor onboarding — ahead of go-live.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

**Technical Competencies**

* Working knowledge of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and data protection.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 security tooling (Defender, Entra ID, Purview) and cloud security fundamentals.
* Experience working with a managed SOC or MSSP provider.
* Working knowledge of UAE information security expectations relevant to financial services (CMA, PDPL) is an advantage.

**Skills/Personal Attributes**

* Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to execute consistently against an established control framework.
* Good communicator, comfortable working across IT, trading, wealth management, and HR/EOS teams.
* High level of integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Arabic language skills are an advantage.

**Work Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in information security or IT risk, with hands-on exposure to SOC operations, vulnerability management, or identity and access management.
* Experience in financial services is preferred but not required.
* A relevant certification (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security+) is preferred, or a willingness to obtain one.

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night, consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and the shopping you do online. Chances are that many of those experiences were touched by an Adobe product.

This is one of Adobe Professional Services' most senior programme delivery roles. You will lead Adobe's largest, most strategic and complex customer programmes in the Middle East and act as the single point of accountability for everything Adobe delivers across the programme.
  
  
You will lead across Adobe's cross-functional organisation, bringing together our Customer Experience (CX) and Creative & Production teams as one integrated Adobe programme. * Coach project and programme managers across UKI and the Middle East, contribute reusable programme practices and lessons learned, and raise the standard of complex programme leadership across the region.

What you'll need to succeed
  
  

* Extensive experience leading large, strategic, multi-workstream transformation programmes in consulting, enterprise technology or professional services, typically gained over 12+ years in programme delivery and leadership roles.
* Demonstrable experience delivering successfully in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East, with a strong understanding of regional business culture, stakeholder expectations, relationship-led ways of working and the practical realities of mobilising teams in the region. An established local network is highly advantageous.
* A strong record of owning customer outcomes, programme health, predictable revenue, financial milestones, delivery forecasts and commercial performance across complex enterprise engagements.
* Exceptional executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships with customer directors, VPs and C-level stakeholders, including during major decisions, escalations and programme recovery.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary, geographically distributed and cross-functional teams across CX, Creative & Production, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, product, engineering and strategic partners, often through influence rather than direct authority.
* Deep programme management and commercial capability across mobilisation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, forecasting, resourcing, RAID, change control, milestone acceptance and executive reporting.
* Experience connecting enterprise technology delivery to adoption, operating-model change, measurable business outcomes and sustained value realisation. Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Firefly, Firefly Foundry or comparable enterprise platforms is advantageous.
* A calm, inclusive and decisive leadership style, with excellent written, verbal and presentation skills in English. Arabic language capability would be advantageous.
* A recognised programme or project management qualification such as MSP, PMI PgMP/PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent is desirable, together with substantial experience of Agile and hybrid delivery methods.

Minimum 5 years in SaaS solution environment

Title: AI Product and Delivery Manager (18-Month Contract)
Description:
Centennial College recognizes and affirms Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Indigenous ways of knowing as central to the vibrancy and uniqueness of its learning and working academic mission. We strongly encourage applications from members of Indigenous communities and all equity-deserving groups including Women, Racialized, Persons with Disabilities, and LGBTQ+ communities.

We recognize that First Peoples come from sovereign Nations and that part of understanding our responsibilities of residing on this territory are understanding the true history, circumstances and legacy of the Treaties signed here (such as the Toronto Purchase, Robinson-Huron Treaty and Williams Treaties) and including pre-contact Treaties and Agreements between sovereign Nations and that all peoples in this area are therefore Treaty people with obligations and responsibilities to all our relations.

**Position Summary**

**The future of artificial intelligence in higher education isn't something we're waiting for. It's something we're building.**

Centennial College is launching an ambitious AI Incubator to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence across teaching, learning, student services, and institutional operations. We're moving beyond experimentation to develop intelligent solutions that solve real problems, transform experiences, and deliver measurable outcomes.

We're looking for an exceptional **AI Product and Delivery Manager** to help turn that ambition into reality. This is a unique opportunity to join a newly established AI Incubator at a defining moment in the College's digital transformation. You'll help shape how AI opportunities are discovered, evaluated, prioritized, built, and deployed—working with a multidisciplinary engineering team, institutional leaders, and technology partners to move ideas from concept to production.

Imagine helping bring to life an AI-powered student concierge that supports students throughout their academic journey, intelligent service agents that transform how employees access support, or AI-enabled workflows that eliminate friction and create new possibilities across the institution. These are the kinds of opportunities the AI Incubator is being established to pursue.

Reporting directly to the Associate Vice President, Strategy, Innovation and Assurance, who establishes the College's institutional AI strategy and direction, you will lead the Incubator's product and delivery activities. You'll translate approved strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps, coordinate technical delivery, manage the Incubator's portfolio and budget, and work with functional-area product owners to ensure solutions deliver meaningful business value.

This isn't a role focused on producing AI strategy documents. It's about turning strategy into working solutions—and ensuring those solutions make a difference.

  

**Responsibilities**  
  
Shape the AI Opportunity Pipeline and Product Roadmap

* Lead the AI Incubator's opportunity intake, assessment, and prioritization processes across academic, student-service, and administrative areas.
* Partner with institutional leaders, faculty, staff, and service owners to identify high-value opportunities for AI Agents, generative AI, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies.
* Facilitate discovery sessions that translate real-world challenges into compelling product concepts, clear requirements, and measurable success criteria.
* Evaluate opportunities against strategic alignment, technical feasibility, data readiness, cost, risk, and anticipated value.
* Develop business cases, product roadmaps, delivery recommendations, and benefits hypotheses that support informed institutional decision-making.

  

Turn AI Concepts into Real-World Solutions

* Lead cross-functional delivery planning, translating approved initiatives into coordinated work plans, milestones, dependencies, and release schedules.
* Work closely with AI Development, Data, and Platform Engineers to assess technical approaches and coordinate the delivery of secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Facilitate product discovery, backlog refinement, prototype reviews, pilot planning, and release readiness activities.
* Evaluate engineering recommendations involving AI Agent architecture, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Coordinate testing, business acceptance, deployment readiness, and operational transition with functional-area product owners and IT teams.
* Identify delivery risks, competing priorities, and resource constraints, recommending practical solutions and escalating decisions where necessary.

  

Drive Adoption, Impact, and Continuous Improvement

* Partner with functional-area product owners to establish measurable outcomes, adoption targets, and benefits realization approaches.
* Coordinate demonstrations, pilots, user feedback, and change enablement activities to support successful adoption.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, task completion, service improvements, cost avoidance, and other indicators of realized value.
* Translate delivery progress and performance insights into executive-ready reports and recommendations.
* Help establish repeatable approaches for AI product discovery, evaluation, delivery, and continuous improvement

  

Champion Responsible and Sustainable AI

* Collaborate with cybersecurity, privacy, enterprise architecture, and data governance specialists to embed responsible AI principles throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure appropriate consideration of AI accuracy, groundedness, reliability, accessibility, human oversight, security, and operational readiness.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and delivery approaches, balancing innovation with institutional risk, cost, and sustainability.
* Manage the AI Incubator's approved budget and coordinate the work of external vendors and technology partners.
* Foster a collaborative, delivery-focused environment where experimentation, learning, accountability, and measurable results go hand in hand.

  

**Qualifications/Experience**

* A four-year degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Seven-years of progressive experience in digital product management, technology delivery, business transformation, or cross-functional program management, ideally involving AI, automation, cloud technologies, or enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of generative AI, AI Agents, large language models, RAG, enterprise integration, data architecture, and cloud-based AI platforms.
* Experience translating complex business challenges into product requirements, delivery roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical recommendations and trade-offs involving feasibility, security, scalability, performance, cost, and supportability.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams, business stakeholders, external vendors, and complex delivery dependencies.
* Knowledge of agile delivery, product lifecycle management, user acceptance testing, change enablement, and benefits realization.
* Strong financial, analytical, and organizational skills, including budget oversight, business case development, and executive reporting.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable enterprise AI platforms is an asset.
* Experience in higher education, the public sector, or another complex service-oriented organization is an asset.

  

**What will set you apart?**  
You're equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior executives and challenging technical assumptions with engineers. You understand that a successful AI initiative isn't measured by how impressive the demonstration looks, but by whether the solution works, is adopted, and delivers lasting value.  
  
You're curious, pragmatic, collaborative, and energized by the opportunity to build something new.

Title: Manager, Customer Success Technology
Description:
**Do you get energized by building the systems and AI-powered workflows that help a Customer Success team deliver exceptional service at scale?**
=================================================================================================================================================

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a **Manager, Customer Success Technology** to be part of our **Success Operations** department.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500 lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

**The team:**

The Success Operations team is the operational backbone of Jobber's Success organization, spanning three connected pillars: operations, technology, and workforce management. Together, the team equips Customer Success with the people, process, systems, and insights they need to make decisions, scale consistently, and deliver against their goals.

**The role:**

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Success Operations, the **Manager, Customer Success Technology** will own the technology that powers Customer Success teams. This is a hands-on people leader and problem solver who develops technical talent, balances competing priorities, and delivers scalable systems and AI-first solutions.

**The Manager, Customer Success Technology will:**

* Manage and develop a team of CS Tech Admins, building their skills and technical effectiveness.
* Champion automation and process improvement by identifying manual work to streamline and prioritizing changes that balance speed, experience, accuracy, and maintainability.
* Roll out and maintain AI tools and AI-enabled workflows, monitoring their performance and reliability and establishing governance and business continuity plans.
* Set the standard for intake, triage, and issue resolution, assessing requests for scope, priority, and business impact and resolving them quickly and effectively.
* Establish the KPIs and SLAs for CS Tech and hold the team accountable to clear, measurable outcomes.
* Guide the team's delivery, from configuration changes to minor builds to large transformations, in partnership with Success Operations, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Support complex technology projects from ideation to launch, surfacing technical risks, balancing business needs against technical constraints, and communicating trade-offs.
* Establish and maintain best practices for technical delivery that make the team's work repeatable and scalable.
* Own the health, performance, and roadmap of the Customer Success (CS) tech stack, and establish the frameworks and metrics to evaluate its ROI.
* Manage vendor relationships and licensing across the CS tech stack, making informed decisions that balance capability and cost.
* Build trusted partnerships with Success leaders, translating their needs into a coherent technology roadmap.

**To be successful, you should have:**

* Demonstrated people leadership experience, with a track record of developing technical talent and building high-performing teams.
* Experience working with or in a Customer Success organization, including a solid understanding of how Product Support and Onboarding teams operate and how technology helps them scale and deliver outcomes.
* Extensive experience with customer success tools such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Amazon Connect, Intercom, Assembled, ChiliPiper, Revenue.IO, or similar.
* Hands-on experience designing, building, and running AI-enabled workflows and agents, including monitoring their performance and reliability and establishing governance.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams on complex technology programs using Agile and Scrum methodologies, along with project and program best practices, tools, and techniques. Agile training and experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
* The ability to work on multiple projects at once, including establishing new processes and streamlining existing ones.
* Comfort with ambiguity and change. We're growing fast, and what worked yesterday might not work today.
* A bias toward action, with the judgment to make informed decisions, move work forward, and adapt as new information emerges.

**Compensation:**

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a **minimum annual salary of $120,870, a midpoint of $142,200, and a maximum salary of $163,530**, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

**Location:**

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: **Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.**

**What you can expect from Jobber:**

* A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
* A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
* A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
* To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh\*t about our customers.

*We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.*

**A bit more about us:**

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Title: Partner Portfolio Lead Architect
Description:
**THE ROLE: THE RIGHT PARTNER, ON THE RIGHT TERMS**
---------------------------------------------------

Reporting to the Head of Partner Strategy, you lead the decision on which partners are brought into Echelon’s portfolio and under what terms. Each recommendation goes to the leadership team after you apply four key tests: technology, industry, layer, and mutual fit. You collaborate with the CRO’s technical principal and our engineers for technical diligence, tap account teams for customer insight, and leverage Partner Sourcing and Intelligence to challenge and enhance recommendations. Then, you agree on the partnership model, contract framework, and commercial terms with Legal, Finance and the business, before handing each signed partner to Partner Development for activation.

**Your Mandate:**
-----------------

* **The right technology:** Collaborate with engineering leadership to assess candidates’ architecture, maturity, security, and deployability, considering engineering effort required.
* **The right industry:** Validate industry demand with account teams—sectors, use cases, and accounts—before committing.
* **The right layer:** Determine where the partner sits in the stack and if that layer needs filling, strengthening, or should remain open.
* **The right mutual fit:** Assess strategic intent, commercial ambition, ways of working, and appetite for joint investment, ensuring mutual commitment.
* **A portfolio that holds:** Evaluate each partner’s addition relative to our roadmap and signed partners, checking for gaps, overlaps, or competition, and ensuring a cohesive market offering.
* **The model and the terms:** Recommend a partnership model, negotiate terms—go-to-market, delivery, revenue share, exclusivity, liabilities, and exit—with leadership, Legal, Finance, and the business.
* **Build the recruitment model:** With leadership and Partner Sourcing and Intelligence, shape the partner profiles, assessment frameworks, recruitment process, and the operating model for smooth partner transition.

**WHERE WE ALIGN**
------------------

### **AI AND TECHNOLOGY FIRST**

* **Partnership record:** Experience assessing, structuring, and signing partnerships at a technology vendor, integrator, or in corporate development or consulting.
* **Technical judgement:** Comfortable engaging engineers on architecture, integration, and deployment; able to discern robust technology from demonstrations.
* **Industry sense:** Deep understanding of how sectors buy and run technology, with an ability to judge where value will (and won’t) be created.
* **Commercial structuring:** Designed channel/partnership models and negotiated revenue share or terms with larger counterparties.
* **Portfolio and fit judgement:** Credibility with founders, engineers, Legal, and Finance; able to assess how partners add to the whole.

### **STRONG ADVANTAGE**

* **Ecosystem background:** Experience in a technology vendor’s partner organisation or a cloud provider’s ecosystem team.
* **Deal experience:** Exposure to venture investment, M&A, or joint ventures, including diligence and documentation.
* **Sector knowledge:** Depth in sectors where Echelon leads (government, energy, financial services, healthcare).
* **Arabic:** Professional fluency in Arabic.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** Measured by customer outcomes; prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality:** Own outcomes end-to-end; fix what breaks or stalls.
* **Clear communicator:** Simplify complex systems; make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** Progress with partial data and unclear environments.
* **Long-term builder:** Invest in Echelon’s success; bring insight back to strategy and operations.
* **Builds others:** Measure success by the people and capabilities you develop.

**THE SEAT**
------------

* **Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* **Reports to:** Head of Partner Strategy
* **Travel:** Limited
* **Package:** Base salary plus housing, transport, education allowances, medical cover, and equity through our employee equity programme. Full terms shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the tool—and greet unclear briefs or broken environments with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** Always learning how work really happens on site and how the stack evolves.
* **Speed:** Move quickly from brief to working result; don’t wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** Test all claims against data; explain every decision.
* **Confidence & humility:** Challenge and be challenged; change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** Make decisions and organise work with incomplete information.
* **Resourcefulness:** Thrive with missing access, partial data, or unfamiliar organisations.
* **Situational leadership:** Lead or follow as the moment calls for it.
* **A force multiplier:** Your playbooks, reviews, and coaching make everyone faster.
* **AI-native depth:** AI tools are integral to how you research, assess, and negotiate—testing technology, markets, and deals faster than others.
* **Where you are:** A senior partnership builder, judging across technology, industry, and commerce—ready to shape Echelon’s partner portfolio and the model that supports it.

Title: IT Manager (Saudi Only)
Description:
**About The Role**
Lucidya is looking for a hands-on, forward-thinking IT Manager to own and modernize our internal technology ecosystem.
  
  
This is not a traditional IT support role, and it is not a role for someone whose first instinct is to buy another SaaS tool. Our default is to
**build before we buy**
: we want someone who uses agentic AI (AI coding agents, LLM-powered workflows, and autonomous agents) to design, build, and run internal tools that fit exactly how Lucidya works. We buy third-party software only when building clearly doesn't make sense.
  
  
You will lead a small IT team by example. You set the direction, but you are also the person who configures the firewall, writes the integration, and ships the internal tool yourself. You will work proactively with People (HR), Finance, Legal, and every other relevant department to find inefficiencies before anyone reports them, especially across onboarding, offboarding, and the full lifecycle of company assets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI and Internal Tooling**

* Lead the use of agentic AI and AI coding tools to build internal applications, automations, and integrations in place of new third-party subscriptions wherever practical
* Run a build-vs-buy assessment for every new tooling request and for existing SaaS renewals. Replace paid tools with internally built solutions where that reduces cost, complexity, or lock-in
* Design, deploy, and maintain AI agents and AI-powered workflows that remove repetitive work across IT, HR, Finance, and operations
* Treat internal tools as products: gather requirements from internal users, ship iteratively, document, monitor, and keep improving them
* Set standards for how internal AI-built tools are secured, reviewed, version-controlled, and maintained so they remain reliable as the company grows

**Asset Management**

* Own the full lifecycle of company assets (laptops, peripherals, network equipment, licenses, and other hardware and software) from procurement and receipt through assignment, maintenance, repair, recovery, and disposal
* Build and maintain a single, accurate source of truth for all assets, with clear ownership, location, condition, warranty, and assignment history
* Manage asset logistics for a fully remote, multi-country workforce, including shipping, collection, and secure recovery of devices from departing employees
* Work with Finance on asset purchasing, budgeting, capitalization, depreciation, and reconciliation, and run regular asset audits
* Manage device enrollment, configuration, and security through MDM, including remote lock and wipe when needed
* Track software licenses and SaaS seats, reclaim unused licenses, and eliminate waste

**Cross-Department Operational Efficiency**

* Proactively partner with People, Finance, Legal, Security, Engineering, and other teams to map their processes and identify opportunities for automation and simplification, without waiting to be asked
* Own an end-to-end, automated onboarding experience: account creation, access provisioning, device preparation and delivery, and day-one readiness, coordinated with HR and hiring managers
* Own a reliable, automated offboarding process: same-day access revocation, data handover, asset recovery, and license reclamation, coordinated with HR and Finance
* Automate approvals, reporting, procurement requests, and support workflows across departments
* Define and report on operational metrics (time to onboard, offboarding completion, asset recovery rate, SaaS spend, ticket volume) and use them to drive continuous improvement

**Infrastructure, Identity, and Security**

* Own and manage Lucidya's internal IT systems, SaaS applications, identity, access, networks, and technology operations
* Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot office network and internet infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Wi-Fi access points, and fiber connectivity
* Diagnose and resolve firewall, internet, fiber, LAN, DNS, DHCP, and Wi-Fi issues, coordinating with ISPs and vendors when required
* Manage identity and access practices, including SSO, MFA, RBAC, and automated provisioning and deprovisioning
* Work closely with Security and Data Protection to keep internal systems compliant with company policies and applicable regulations (such as Saudi PDPL)
* Maintain documentation, monitoring, and operational reliability across internal systems and office infrastructure

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow the IT team, setting clear priorities, standards, and accountability
* Lead by example: stay hands-on in day-to-day technical work, and model the automation-first, build-first mindset you expect from the team
* Upskill the team on agentic AI tools and modern automation practices

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of experience in IT, systems engineering, network administration, business systems, or a related technical role, including at least 2 years managing a team
* A track record of leading by example: you have managed people while remaining hands-on with infrastructure, scripting, and integrations
* Proven, hands-on experience in IT asset management, including lifecycle management, inventory systems, MDM, audits, license management, and coordination with Finance. Experience managing assets for remote or distributed teams is a strong plus
* Demonstrated experience using agentic AI or AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to build working internal tools, not just experimenting with them
* Experience with AI APIs, LLMs, and building AI agents or AI-powered workflows
* Examples of replacing or avoiding third-party tools by building internal solutions, with measurable cost or efficiency results
* Experience designing and running automated onboarding and offboarding processes in partnership with HR and Finance
* Strong scripting ability in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PowerShell, or similar
* Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, OAuth, SSO, and system integrations
* Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Workato
* Hands-on networking experience configuring and troubleshooting firewalls, routers, switches, Wi-Fi networks, and business internet and fiber connections
* Solid understanding of identity management, cybersecurity, and access controls
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders across departments

**Ideal Candidate**
You combine the mindset of an IT Manager, a Systems & Network Engineer, an AI-native builder, and an Internal Product Owner.
  
  
When someone asks for a new tool, your first question is:
  
  
**"Can we build this ourselves, quickly and securely, with AI?"**
When you see a manual process, you ask:
  
  
**"Why are we doing this by hand, and how do we automate it?"**
You don't wait for HR or Finance to come to you with a problem. You go to them with a better way of working.
  
  
You lead your team from the front. You can spend the morning planning next quarter's roadmap with the Finance team, the afternoon shipping an internal tool with an AI coding agent, and still be the one who figures out why the office Wi-Fi is down and gets everyone back online.
  
  
**Success in This Role**
Success will be measured by:
  
  

* Accurate, audit-ready asset records with high device recovery rates and minimal asset loss
* Fast, fully automated onboarding and offboarding, with access revoked on the last day without exception
* Reduced SaaS spend through internally built tools and reclaimed licenses
* Meaningful internal tools and AI agents in active use across departments
* Measurable efficiency gains for HR, Finance, and other teams from proactive process improvements
* Reliable and secure office network and internet connectivity
* Strong identity, access, and security governance across internal systems
* A capable, motivated IT team that shares the build-first, AI-first mindset

Title: IT Project Manager (Immediate Opening)
Description:
**Description**

  
  
  

IT Project Manager

Mission:

This position will lead projects for our Information Systems and IT Systems teams of engineers, system administrators and software developers. They will be responsible for all aspects of project delivery—ensuring we achieve the quality, schedule, and cost commitment of projects.
  
  
This position will manage a portfolio of technical projects with varied degrees of complexity and scope to achieve strategic business goals and operational objectives. They will serve as the primary interface to customers for projects. They will use established project management disciplines and processes for managing scope, resources, schedule, risks, issues, and change management. They will drive creative alternatives to project challenges, partner with others to drive standardization across the portfolio of projects and collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure project objectives are met.

N/A

Occasional travel to quarterly meetings and conferences is possible.

* Lead, plan, direct, and coordinate activities for complex work efforts to accomplish goals and objectives within the prescribed timeframe and budget.

* Establish overall project governance, communication with impacted stakeholders and project communication and change management plans.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
Stimulus Technologies – Broadband Division
  
  
**About Us**
Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We are a turnkey technology company providing Managed IT Services, VoIP, Cybersecurity, and high-speed Wireless Internet and fiber through Stimulus Broadband.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Technical Program Manager runs the network and systems programs for Stimulus Broadband outside the fiber build: integration of existing markets onto standard platforms, integration of acquired companies, and wireless network projects. The role owns schedule, cost, scope, risk and project gates for this portfolio and coordinates with the fiber deployment organization where they two depend on each other. The Technical Program Manager reports to the CTO.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the portfolio and master schedule for network and systems integration programs.
* Market network integration program: migrate each market onto the target architecture and standard platforms, including cutover planning, subscriber migration and retiring legacy systems.
* Run acquisition integration from diligence through cutover and decommissioning.
* Manage wireless projects (sector augments, backhaul upgrades, site remediation) from scope through delivery, using contractors and field crews.
* Track the NMS/OSS deployment roadmap by market and keep platform, network and operations sequenced.
* Own program budgets and forecasts with finance.
* Run project gates and coordinate release to production with Network Operations.
* Maintain the project's intake queue and prioritization.
* Hold vendors and contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
* Own the risk register and drive escalations to closure.
* Coordinate dependencies with the fiber build organization.
* Report status to the CTO, CEO, and finance.
* Travel to markets as business needs require.

Success Profile
  
  

* Organized leader with can do attitude and able to work across a wide variety of functions
* Holds vendors and internal teams to dates and scope.
* Systems thinking and technical enough to challenge engineers and contractors.
* Writes status an executive can act on quickly.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years in technical program management on network, systems or infrastructure programs, preferably at an ISP, carrier or MSP.
* Experience running migrations and cutovers on live networks with active subscribers.
* Scheduling, critical path, program controls, forecasting, and change control.
* Stage-gate governance and vendor and contractor management.
* Working knowledge of fixed wireless, IP networking, NMS/OSS/BSS platforms, and fiber access.
* ISP business knowledge: take rate, churn, cost per subscriber and payback.
* Preferred: acquisition integration at an ISP or carrier; NMS/OSS platform deployments; wireless capital programs; hands-on engineering background.
* Must reside in Nevada, California, Oregon, Missouri or New Mexico. Adjacent states may be considered for the right candidate.

Physical Requirements
  
  

* Extended periods working at a computer.
* Regular travel among markets for cutovers, project reviews and contractor oversight.
* Occasional lifting of equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.
* Site visits to data centers, tower sites and active project sites.

**Requirements**

* Stimulus Technologies conducts pre-employment and random background checks, along with drug, alcohol, and cannabis testing. Candidates must pass all required screenings.
* A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.

Alignment with Core Values
  
  
At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
* See a Need – Fill a Need – Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and acts without waiting to be asked.
* Elevate Others – Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
* Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
* Celebrate Success – Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

Title: Senior PMO Manager
Description:
**Job Overview:**

The
**Senior PMO Manager**
will establish and lead a fit-for-purpose Enterprise PMO that converts business demand into a transparent, prioritized and executable project portfolio. The role owns the operating model, governance, controls, tools and management information for Demand Management, Portfolio and Prioritization Management, Cost Management, Resource Management and project delivery assurance. Working across Albatha Group businesses, IT leadership, Finance, HR, Procurement and delivery partners, the role will provide decision-quality insight, strengthen accountability and optimize investment, capacity and benefits realization.

This is a hands-on leadership position for an experienced PMO practitioner who can design new processes from the ground up, embed adoption across diverse stakeholders, and progressively mature the PMO from project reporting to enterprise portfolio management.

**Key Accountabilities:**

PMO Setup, Operating Model and Governance

* Design and implement the Enterprise PMO charter, service catalogue, governance model, decision rights, RACI, policies, standards, stage gates and delivery lifecycle.
* Establish integrated PMO processes, templates, controls, calendars and forums covering idea intake through prioritization, approval, delivery, benefits tracking and closure.
* Create a pragmatic PMO maturity roadmap, baseline current capabilities and deliver prioritized improvements in 30, 60, 90 days and annual horizons.

Demand Management

* Create a single demand intake process and demand register for strategic initiatives, regulatory work, business requests, technology lifecycle needs and operational improvements.
* Define minimum data requirements including business problem, strategic alignment, sponsor, expected benefits, urgency, dependencies, high-level cost, capacity needs and risk.
* Introduce demand triage, qualification and routing with benefit targets, ensuring incomplete or low-value requests are challenged before entering the portfolio pipeline.
* Facilitate demand discovery with business and technology teams
* Monitor demand ageing, conversion, rejection and backlog health; provide transparent feedback to requestors

Portfolio and Prioritization Management

* Build and maintain a single source of truth for the project portfolio, including approved, proposed, paused, at risk and completed initiatives.
* evelop and administer a transparent scoring model using strategic alignment, value, risk/compliance, customer impact, urgency, feasibility, dependency and capacity criteria.
* Facilitate prioritization sessions; model scenarios and trade-offs within budget and resource constraints.
* Provide independent challenge and assurance at stage gates, ensuring continued investment is supported by evidence and agreed tolerances.

Cost and Investment Management

* Establish portfolio financial controls for business cases, annual planning, budget baselines, forecasts, actuals, commitments, accruals and estimate-at-completion.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement, project managers and vendors to reconcile project costs and improve the timeliness and accuracy of financial reporting.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

Help Scotiabank source the technologies shaping the future of banking.

As Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – covering business line software (e.g., Capital Markets & Wealth Systems) within Technology Sourcing – you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology domains.
