Title: Director of Rooms
Description:
**Company Description**
**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**
The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.
  
  
**About Raffles The Palm**
Opened in 2021 on the western crescent of Palm Jumeirah, the world’s largest man-made island and archipelago, this palatial beach resort, featuring 340 spacious rooms, suites and villas, is inspired by the stunning elegance of European palaces and embellished with handcrafted Italian furniture. Guests can enjoy panoramic views, a private beach, state-of-the-art entertainment and recreational facilities, including specialist boutiques, a VIP movie theatre, and signature and private restaurants complemented by exquisite banqueting and conference spaces.
  
  
More than a destination, Raffles the Palm Dubai embodies the spirit of a legendary brand, celebrated for its storied heritage since 1887 and its hallmark of intuitive, gracious service. At the palace, excellence is a craft, and every team member is a master in their field. Here, talent is not only recognized, it plays a vital role in shaping the next chapter of this extraordinary resort and its legacy within the brand.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director of Rooms and Residences leads the Rooms Division and the hotel's residences services, with overall accountability for service delivery, profitability, cost control, asset care and colleague engagement. The role ensures a consistent Raffles experience for hotel guests, individual residence owners and residents, while delivering residential services within the hotel's approved management and service agreements.
  
  
The scope includes Front Office, Concierge, Raffles Club Lounge, Royal Service, Housekeeping, Laundry, Transportation and residences services. The role is accountable for Rooms Division and residences service profitability, budget delivery and cost control, alongside guest and resident satisfaction, brand standards and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Housekeeping reporting line:**
The Director of Housekeeping reports directly to the Director of Rooms and Residences, who has full operational and financial oversight of Housekeeping and Laundry, while the Director of Housekeeping is responsible for the day-to-day delivery through the departmental teams.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**Rooms Division operations**

* Lead the departments within the division, conduct daily briefings and weekly management meetings, and maintain clear ownership of operational priorities and follow-up actions.
* Maintain complete knowledge of hotel and residence services, room types and layouts, rates, packages, promotions, occupancy, arrivals and departures, pickup, availability and scheduled group activities.
* Oversee departmental rosters and Manager on Duty schedules in line with staffing guidelines and labour forecasts, adjusting coverage to business demand.
* Coordinate Front Office, Housekeeping, Royal Service and related teams to deliver timely room readiness, accurate room status, smooth arrivals and departures, and effective handling of guest requests.
* Anticipate sell-out and overbooking situations, coordinate alternative accommodation when required, and ensure affected guests receive appropriate communication and follow-up under hotel policy.
* Review out-of-order and out-of-service rooms daily with Engineering and Housekeeping, track defects and work orders, and confirm completion dates and readiness before returning rooms to inventory.

**Housekeeping & Laundry**

* Set and enforce cleaning, presentation and inspection standards for guestrooms, suites, villas, hotel-managed residences and all assigned public and back-of-house areas, including washrooms and leisure areas.
* Conduct regular inspections with the Director of Housekeeping, review room and public-area audit results, and ensure corrective actions are completed and checked.
* Oversee daily cleaning, turndown, deep cleaning and periodic maintenance programmes, coordinating access and timing with Front Office, residences services and Engineering.
* Approve departmental staffing plans and monitor productivity, attendance, overtime and casual or outsourced labour against approved budgets and required service standards.
* Control linen, uniforms, guest supplies, cleaning chemicals and amenities through agreed stock levels, secure stores, accurate inventories, controlled issuance and regular consumption reviews.
* Oversee Laundry quality, turnaround times, equipment care and outsourced service performance; investigate losses, damage, excessive consumption and recurring service failures.
* Ensure safe cleaning practices, appropriate chemical handling, pest-control coordination, lost-property procedures and respect for guest and resident privacy and property.

**Service Quality And Guest Experience**

* Work closely with Guest Experience and Butler leadership to anticipate preferences, coordinate personalised service and resolve complaints promptly, with clear follow-up and corrective action.
* Develop and enforce SOPs, review guest feedback and TrustYou results, and lead action plans for LQA, Forbes service standards and other applicable quality audits.
* Tour the property regularly, act as a Raffles brand ambassador and introduce relevant best practices that improve service consistency and operational efficiency.

**Residences operations and resident relations**

* Lead the delivery of hotel-managed residences services within the agreed operating scope, ensuring that service commitments, responsibilities and escalation routes are documented and understood.
* Serve as the senior operational contact for individual residence owners and residents, maintain regular communication and manage expectations with discretion and professionalism.
* Coordinate resident onboarding, arrivals, planned absences, departures and move-in or move-out arrangements with relevant hotel teams and appointed property representatives.
* Maintain accurate records of authorised occupants, contact details, preferences, contracted services and access permissions, with appropriate confidentiality and controlled access to information.
* Oversee residence cleaning arrangements, service schedules, inspections and optional services; clearly communicate agreed inclusions, additional charges and access requirements.
* Ensure resident requests and complaints are logged, assigned and tracked through to closure, with response and resolution targets, updates and escalation for overdue or recurring issues.
* Coordinate maintenance and preventive works with Engineering, monitor progress and communicate disruption and completion arrangements to residents; escalate unresolved defects to the Hotel Manager.
* Work with Security and relevant teams on authorised access, contractor visits, key control, emergency arrangements and protection of resident privacy and belongings.
* Monitor residential service providers within the role's remit, review service quality and coordinate matters affecting agreed common areas with the appointed property-management representatives.
* Review residence service arrangements and propose operational improvements that protect service quality and profitability; ensure approved changes are communicated clearly and applied in line with the relevant service agreements.

**Financial management and asset care**

* Prepare annual operating expense budgets and monthly, quarterly and yearly expense forecasts for the Rooms Division and residences services, using approved business forecasts; monitor profitability, explain cost variances and implement corrective actions.
* Review departmental profitability, occupancy, payroll, cost per occupied room, residence service costs, accruals and operating expenses, including uniforms, linen, supplies and amenities.
* Align staffing, supplies and service delivery with approved occupancy and business forecasts, working with Finance and relevant departments to protect profitability and maintain service standards.
* Define and monitor the allocation of shared staff, supplies and service costs between hotel and residences activities with Finance, and ensure residence service charges are supported and recorded accurately.
* Coordinate billing and payment follow-up for approved residential services with Finance; investigate discrepancies and ensure concessions or changes to charges follow delegated approval limits.
* Prepare annual capital expenditure proposals, prioritise replacement and refurbishment needs, and coordinate preventive care and defect reporting to protect rooms, residences and divisional assets.
* Review outsourced service requirements, supplier performance and costs with Procurement and Finance, ensuring commitments remain within approved budgets and authority.
* Provide the Hotel Manager with a monthly report on Rooms Division and residences profitability, Housekeeping quality, operating expenditure, guest and resident feedback, outstanding issues and corrective actions.

**People leadership**

* Lead and develop departmental managers, including the Director of Housekeeping, through coaching, training, clear objectives and regular performance feedback.
* Oversee recruitment, induction and succession planning with People and Culture, ensuring sufficient management capability across hotel and residences operations.
* Conduct annual and semi-annual management performance reviews, address performance and disciplinary matters under hotel policy, and recognise strong service delivery.
* Build an engaged, accountable and collaborative multicultural team; provide development opportunities and prepare suitable colleagues for progression.
* Ensure teams understand the different needs of hotel guests and long-term residents, including discretion, continuity of service, cultural sensitivities and ownership of requests.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of luxury hotel experience in Rooms Division leadership, ideally within a resort or ultra-luxury brand, with a strong Front Office background.
* Proven experience overseeing housekeeping and laundry operations, including cleaning standards, staffing, productivity, inventories and cost control.
* Experience in branded residences, serviced residences or comparable owner and resident relations is strongly preferred.
* Ability to interpret operational service agreements, define service responsibilities and coordinate residential services with Finance, Engineering, Security and property representatives.
* Proven ability to lead large multicultural teams in a high-volume environment with empathy, presence and emotional intelligence.
* Strong understanding of luxury guest and resident expectations, personalised service, cultural sensitivities, confidentiality and service recovery.
* Strong financial and operational judgement, including expense budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, expense control and analysis of departmental profitability.
* Experience using property-management systems, preferably Opera Cloud or similar, and operational reporting tools.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Commitment to Raffles service values, anticipatory care and thoughtful personal touches that create lasting guest and resident relationships.

Additional Information
  
  
**Employee Benefits:**
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays,
**discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties**
, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.
  
  
**Our Values**
Respect:
  
  
We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.
  
  
Excellence:
  
  
We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.
  
  
Belonging:
  
  
We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.
  
  
Empowerment:
  
  
We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.
  
  
Integrity:
  
  
We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
Raffles is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.
  
  
**About the Application Process:**
At Raffles, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

Title: Head of AI & Agents
Description:
The Head of AI & Agents is responsible for leading the commercial growth and market development of Arabic AI and its agent-based solutions. Reporting to the COO, the role develops and executes the AI & Agents commercial strategy, including defining target markets, customer segments, value propositions, market positioning, and scalable routes to market, with accountability for revenue growth, new-customer acquisition, strategic market expansion, and the development and execution of effective go-to-market strategies across enterprise and government customers.

The role leads three complementary functions: Business Development, Partnerships, and Presales. It ensures that direct sales and partner-led opportunities are converted into qualified pipeline and revenue, while the Presales function translates customer needs into technically sound, secure, scalable, and commercially viable AI solutions. The Head establishes clear priorities, performance measures, and collaboration across these functions to strengthen the full commercial lifecycle from market identification and opportunity creation through solution design and deal closure.

Working closely with the COO, the Director of Commercial Shared Services, Product, Engineering, Delivery, and other stakeholders, the Head of AI & Agents ensures the AI commercial strategy is aligned with product capabilities, market demand, and delivery readiness, and that the business builds a repeatable, measurable, and sustainable AI revenue engine. The role drives the continuous optimization of go-to-market strategies to maximize market penetration and commercial growth.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**AI & Agents Commercial Strategy and Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy and operating plan for AI & Agents in alignment with the company’s overall strategy and the commercial priorities.

* Translate business objectives into revenue plans, target markets, priority industries, customer segments, go-to-market motions, and measurable performance targets.

* Define and oversee the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for AI & Agents, including market positioning, customer segmentation, value propositions, solution positioning, and the selection of appropriate market-entry and growth strategies.

* Identify and prioritize go-to-market opportunities across enterprise and government markets, determining the most effective approaches to market penetration, customer acquisition, and revenue expansion.

* Own the AI & Agents vertical’s agreed commercial outcomes, including new-business revenue, qualified pipeline, conversion, forecast accuracy, and partner contribution.

* Assess market trends, customer needs, competitor offerings, and emerging AI use cases to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.

* Provide the management with regular reporting on commercial performance, pipeline health, forecast, key opportunities, risks, and resource requirements.

**Business Development and Market Expansion**

* Lead the Business Development function in identifying, qualifying, developing, negotiating, and closing new enterprise and government opportunities for AI & Agents.

* Ensure target-account plans, prospecting priorities, sales strategies, and opportunity qualification are aligned with the AI & Agents go-to-market strategy.

* Ensure the effective execution of GTM strategies through coordinated market development, customer acquisition initiatives, and targeted commercial activities across priority segments and industries.

* Guide the Business Development Manager on strategic opportunities, complex sales cycles, executive engagement, and deal strategy.

* Promote value-based and consultative selling by connecting customer business challenges to relevant AI solutions, measurable outcomes, and a clear value proposition.

* Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders and support critical negotiations and high-value opportunities as required.

* Coordinate with the Director of Commercial Shared Services to ensure effective SDR support, bidding resources, and Sales Operations support for AI opportunities.

**Partnerships and Ecosystem-Led Revenue**

* Lead the development of a partner-led growth strategy that turns strategic relationships into qualified pipeline, co-selling activity, and closed revenue.

* Oversee the Partnership Lead’s engagement with hyperscalers, technology partners, systems integrators, consultancies, and other relevant ecosystem partners.

* Ensure partnership plans include clear commercial objectives, target accounts, joint go-to-market activities, opportunity ownership, and measurable outcomes.

* Review partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue contribution, conversion, and forecast accuracy, and take action to improve performance.

* Support strategic partner negotiations, joint account planning, co-selling initiatives, partner programs, and marketplace opportunities where they strengthen market access or accelerate growth.

* Ensure partner engagement complements direct business development and that opportunities are tracked consistently in the CRM with clear attribution.

**Presales, Solution Strategy and Commercial Readiness**

* Lead the Presales function to ensure customer requirements are translated into technically sound, secure, scalable, and commercially viable AI solutions.

* Work with the Presales Consulting Manager to align solution discovery, architecture, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, technical proposals, and solution validation with commercial priorities.

* Ensure proposed solutions address customer business needs and are aligned with product capabilities, technical standards, implementation feasibility, delivery capacity, and commercial objectives.

* Provide oversight of solution risks, assumptions, scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and customer success criteria before major proposals or commitments are submitted.

* Support executive-level customer discussions and strategic opportunities where senior commercial or technical alignment is required.

* Ensure a clear handover from Presales to Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams, including solution documentation, scope, assumptions, risks, and agreed success measures.

* Use customer and market feedback from presales engagements to inform product priorities, solution packaging, reusable assets, and future go-to-market opportunities.

**Pipeline, Forecasting and Commercial Governance**

* Establish a disciplined operating cadence for pipeline reviews, opportunity progression, revenue forecasting, partner performance reviews, and major-deal governance.

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of opportunities, activities, partner attribution, deal stages, forecasts, and commercial outcomes in Salesforce or other designated systems.

* Monitor pipeline coverage, win rates, deal cycle, conversion, average contract value, revenue contribution, and other relevant commercial KPIs.

* Review pricing, deal economics, commercial terms, and non-standard commitments within delegated authority, escalating material exceptions through the appropriate approval process.

* Work with the Director of Commercial Shared Services to maintain consistent reporting definitions, bid support, lead handovers, and sales-process discipline without duplicating ownership of shared functions.

* Use performance data and win/loss insights to refine go-to-market plans, improve forecast reliability, and strengthen commercial execution.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration and Customer Value**

* Ensure customer commitments, proposed timelines, technical scope, service levels, and implementation assumptions are validated with the relevant internal teams before being finalized.

* Build effective collaboration between Business Development, Partnerships, and Presales to ensure clear ownership and smooth progression of opportunities throughout the sales cycle.

* Collaborate with the Head of Services when customer opportunities span AI & Agents and Services, agreeing a coordinated client approach and clear commercial ownership.

**Leadership, Team Development and Continuous Improvement**

Title: Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
The Acceptance Solutions team is part of the Value-Added Services (VAS) organization and is responsible for enabling and growing acceptance products and services across the CEMEA region.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading Visa's acceptance localization strategy and execution across Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA. The role will drive the identification, prioritization, and delivery of localization requirements necessary to support domestic payment schemes, national payment infrastructure initiatives, local routing mandates, regulatory requirements, and market-specific acceptance needs.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the CEMEA subject matter expert for card-present acceptance localization and will work closely with regulators, national payment companies, financial institutions, acquirers, processors, merchants, and internal Visa stakeholders to ensure Visa's in-person acceptance capabilities support local market requirements and evolving payment ecosystem needs.
  
  
This role will partner extensively with Global Product teams, Core Processing and Network teams, Technology teams, Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, and Compliance organizations to assess market requirements, define product and processing enhancements, influence product roadmaps, and drive the delivery of localization initiatives across the acceptance ecosystem.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing regional localization strategies, conducting market and regulatory assessments, translating local requirements into actionable business and technical specifications, supporting client engagements, and ensuring successful deployment of localized acceptance capabilities across CEMEA markets.
  
  
This position would be ideal for a candidate with extensive experience in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance, payment processing, domestic payment schemes, regulatory programs, or in-person payments product management. The role is part of the hub team covering the CEMEA region and will report to the Acceptance Solutions Lead within the VAS organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-person acceptance localization across CEMEA, covering merchant acquiring, acceptance infrastructure, card-present payments, domestic payment schemes, and local routing initiatives.
* Lead Visa's regional strategy for localization of in-person acceptance capabilities to address regulatory requirements, domestic payment scheme mandates, and national payment infrastructure initiatives.
* Analyze and translate regulatory, market, and domestic scheme requirements into clearly documented business, operational, and technical requirements.
* Partner with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, and government stakeholders to understand evolving payment ecosystem requirements and represent Visa's acceptance capabilities.
* Work closely with Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Regional Product teams to assess the impact of local payment requirements and define Visa's response strategy.
* Collaborate with Global Product, Technology, Acceptance Solutions, and Core Processing teams to build business cases, prioritize market requirements, and drive product roadmap enhancements.
* Partner with VisaNet, network processing, and core processing teams to evaluate technical implications of localization initiatives and identify scalable implementation approaches.
* Drive end-to-end execution of localization initiatives including requirements gathering, impact assessments, stakeholder alignment, business case development, delivery tracking, testing, certification support, and market readiness activities.
* Support domestic payment scheme enablement initiatives, including co-badging programs, local routing, domestic acceptance mandates, and national payment infrastructure projects.
* Assess acquiring, processing, and acceptance ecosystem readiness to support market-specific payment requirements.
* Engage with acquirers, processors, payment service providers (PSPs), payment facilitators, terminal vendors, merchants, fintechs, and ecosystem participants to understand implementation challenges and support deployment readiness.
* Identify product gaps and regional customization requirements and work with global teams to prioritize and deliver solutions addressing local market needs.
* Develop market assessments, strategy recommendations, and executive-level updates to support regional and global decision-making.
* Be responsible for annual planning activities for localization initiatives, including KPI setting, strategic priorities, delivery objectives, and cross-functional alignment.
* Monitor progress of localization programs and provide regular updates to senior leadership on market readiness, implementation status, risks, and dependencies.
* Represent Visa at industry forums, regulatory discussions, market working groups, and client engagements related to payment acceptance, domestic schemes, and localization initiatives.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in payments, merchant acquiring, card-present acceptance, payment processing, fintech, or related industries.
* Deep expertise in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance ecosystems, and card-present payment processing.
* Proven experience working with financial institutions, acquirers, processors, payment service providers, merchants, fintechs, payment networks, or national payment organizations.
* Strong knowledge of card-present payments, including:

+ EMV chip acceptance
+ Contactless payments
+ NFC technologies
+ SoftPOS / Tap-to-Phone
+ Android POS
+ Unattended commerce
+ Transit acceptance
+ Mobile wallet acceptance
+ QR-based acceptance solutions

* Strong understanding of payment processing and transaction lifecycles, including authorization, clearing, settlement, routing, switching, and acquiring architectures.

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify future capability needs, technology opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.

Risk & Performance Solution Delivery

Data, Analytics & Reporting Enablement

Governance & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Ensure Risk and Performance technology solutions operate in accordance with IMCO policies, architecture standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.

* Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and service management activities across the portfolio.
* Support audits, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and control testing activities.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training materials, support procedures, and operational controls are maintained.

People Leadership
  
  

* Build and lead a high-performing team of business analysts, application specialists, technical leads, and technology professionals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support career growth and organizational capability development.
* Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business and technology goals.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 12+ years of progressive experience delivering and supporting investment technology solutions within asset management, investment management, or financial services environments.
* Demonstrated success leading technology teams supporting Risk, Performance, Analytics, or related investment functions.
* Strong understanding of portfolio risk management, performance measurement and attribution, benchmark management, investment reporting, and portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing technology roadmaps and delivering complex application and platform initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of investment data, analytical platforms, reporting solutions, and application integration patterns.
* Experience managing software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, service management, governance, and operational support practices.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with industry-leading Risk and Performance platforms such as MSCI RiskManager, BarraOne, Axioma, FactSet, Bloomberg PORT, Eagle Performance, or similar solutions is highly desirable.

Title: Data Strategy & Data Enabled Solutions - Senior Manager or Associate Director - Toronto
Description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759846

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

  

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

  

EY’s Canada Tax & Law Technology Group (CTTG) is seeking an experienced Associate Director / Senior Manager, Data Strategy & Data-Enabled Solutions to help define and scale our data strategy, capabilities, offerings, and solutions.

  

This is a strategic and hands-on role that will play a pivotal part in shaping how data is leveraged as a strategic asset across Tax & Law. The role will focus on identifying new opportunities, enabling data-driven insights and decision-making, developing new solutions and services, strengthening existing offerings, and enabling smarter and more scalable service delivery.

We are looking for a senior data professional who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. The successful candidate will be expected to help set direction while also working directly with data to explore opportunities, develop analyses, test hypotheses, prototype solutions, and evaluate new approaches and technologies. They will leverage CTTG development and delivery resources to help engineer, productionize, and scale solutions where needed.

  

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Partner with Tax & Law leadership to define and execute a data strategy that advances service delivery, managed services, growth, and new market offerings, including opportunities to connect data and insights across competencies and services.
* Identify, prioritize, and shape data-enabled opportunities, use cases, and solutions aligned with business priorities, client needs, and the long-term technology and platform strategy.
* Lead discovery with business teams to understand business problems, processes, available data, information gaps, and opportunities, and articulate the art of the possible through data.
* Work hands-on with data to explore opportunities, perform analysis, test hypotheses, identify patterns and insights, develop prototypes, and demonstrate potential solutions.
* Experiment with new data sources, data models, analytical approaches, tools, and technologies to quickly assess feasibility, validate ideas, and determine potential business value.
* Design and prototype end-to-end data-enabled solutions, including data extraction, preparation, transformation, integration, modeling, analytics, visualization, and consumption.
* Define data architectures and solution approaches that enable information to be securely, effectively, and consistently used and reused across solutions, services, and teams.
* Apply and leverage technologies such as Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Dataverse, Azure data services, Alteryx, APIs, ETL/ELT tools, and related data and analytics technologies.
* Work across structured and unstructured data sources and develop approaches for ingesting, connecting, transforming, and deriving value from disparate sources of information.
* Partner with developers, architects, and agile delivery teams to evolve successful prototypes and experiments into secure, scalable, supportable, and reusable solutions.
* Provide technical direction and hands-on support throughout solution development, helping teams address complex data, architecture, analytics, and integration challenges.
* Translate successful approaches into repeatable data assets, solutions, services, and market offerings that can be leveraged more broadly across Tax & Law.
* Collaborate with technology, risk, security, privacy, and enablement teams to ensure solutions align with EY standards, data governance, and compliance requirements.
* Help strengthen data capability and maturity across service line by establishing reusable approaches, sharing leading practices, and helping teams understand how data can be more effectively leveraged.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

The successful candidate will bring a strong background in data strategy, analytics, data architecture, and hands-on solution development, and will operate as a connector between business leadership, data and technology teams, and solution delivery. They’ll combine the mindset of a strategist, problem solver, and builder: someone who can identify where data can create value, determine how to solve the problem, prove what is possible, and work with a broader team to turn successful ideas into scalable solutions, services, and market offerings.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Demonstrated experience defining or contributing to data strategies, data architectures, analytics roadmaps, data products, or data-enabled service offerings.
* Experience taking ambiguous business opportunities or problems from discovery and exploration through prototyping, solution design, and implementation.
* Experience designing and delivering solutions involving data ingestion, extraction, transformation, integration, modeling, analysis, and visualization.
* Hands-on experience with data preparation, transformation, and integration technologies such as Alteryx or comparable ETL/ELT tools.
* Hands-on experience with data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience working with diverse data platforms, data models, and both structured and unstructured data sources.
* Experience working with APIs, integration patterns, and modern cloud-based data architectures.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, data product delivery, and agile methodologies.
* Experience gathering and translating business requirements and guiding solutions from concept and prototype through implementation and scale.
* Experience collaborating with developers, architects, and other technical specialists to productionize and scale solutions.
* Exposure to the Microsoft ecosystem, including Power Platform, Dataverse, and Azure data services, is highly desirable.

  

**What we look for**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field. An advanced degree is an asset.
* 8–12+ years of experience in data strategy, analytics, data engineering, applied data science, technology consulting, or related roles, with meaningful responsibility for delivering data-enabled solutions.

  

**What we offer**

  

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you to decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

* *Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry*
* *Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career*
* *The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you*

Title: Head of BFSI
Description:
**Who we are**  
  
ML arteka is one of the fastest-growing IT Services and Consulting companies in Canada and serves some of the most iconic brands, including Google, Loblaws, Staples, Telus, Bell, Rogers, CIBC, BMO, CMLS, Fossil, Fitbit and more.  
  
Over the last decade, we have achieved 100% client retention and earned more than 20 notable industry recognition. This reflects our reliability in delivering what we promise and the quality we bring to every engagement.  
  
Join our growth-driven culture and help us lead, innovate, and simplify. We are looking for a team members who embody our values:

* Empathetic - we listen, we understand, and are considerate of everyone
* Persevering - we don't give up on challenges or people and go all the way
* Inclusive - we value everyone and their perspectives
* Reliable - we deliver what we promise, and more
* Innovative - we make things better than they were yesterday

  

**The role**  
  
We are seeking a Head of BFSI to **originate and grow** our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business across Canada and the United States. This is a **consultative business development leadership** role designed for a senior professional who combines deep BFSI domain expertise with strong technology acumen and the ability to build trusted executive relationships.  
  
You will create a pipeline by engaging BFSI executives on their modernization agenda, shaping opportunities into structured offers (**POV/assessment MVP scale**), and converting those into multi-year programs. You will partner closely with Sales for commercial execution and with internal practice leaders (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) for solution depth and delivery confidence.  
  
This is not transactional selling. Revenue is generated through credibility, insight, and advisory-led origination—not volume outreach or RFP chasing.

  
**Why** **ML arteka****?**  
  
**Most senior BFSI leaders don’t lack ideas—they lack room to act.**

* Room to move faster than RFP cycles and internal red tape. Room to turn executive conversations into funded modernization programs. Room to own outcomes, not activity.

**At** **ML arteka****, this role is built for people who think:**

* “I can build more pipeline if I’m not boxed into bureaucracy.”
* “BFSI buyers need a modernization partner, not another vendor.”
* “I want accountability for conversion—assessment MVP scale—not just meetings.”
* “I want to build a durable BFSI portfolio, not manage accounts.”

**Originate, Don’t Just Network**

* This isn’t about collecting contacts. It’s about creating demand—shaping modernization triggers into structured offers and multi-year programs.

**Operate Like an Owner**

* You’ll have autonomy to build the BFSI growth motion: target accounts, executive coverage, positioning, and deal shaping—partnering with practices and Sales to make programs defensible and repeatable.

**Move Fast, Keep Rigor**

* BFSI modernization demands speed and discipline (risk, compliance, security, resilience). If slow decision cycles frustrate you, you’ll find this environment refreshing and demanding—in the right way.

**A Place for Builders**

* Not for narrow lanes or comfort-first roles. If you want to build a BFSI growth engine and leave a mark, ML arteka is the platform.

**Why This Role Exists**  
  
BFSI enterprises are under unprecedented pressure to modernize:

* Core platforms and legacy applications
* Data estates and analytics foundations
* Risk, compliance, and regulatory capabilities
* Cloud and infrastructure operating models
* AI adoption across fraud, risk, operations, and customer experience

Despite heavy investment, many initiatives stall due to lack of clarity, fragmented execution, and misalignment between business and technology.  
Our firm exists to help BFSI organizations modernize with clarity, control, and measurable outcomes. The Head of BFSI will translate this mission into a sustainable, repeatable **growth engine**.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**1) Consultative Origination & Pipeline Ownership**

* Own BFSI growth by building pipeline through **executive discovery** and problem-led conversations.
* Develop and maintain a **target account plan** (named accounts, buying centers, modernization triggers, stakeholder maps).
* Identify high-impact BFSI challenges and translate them into structured engagements:
  + POVs and executive workshops
  + Assessments and roadmaps
  + MVPs / pilots
  + Multi-year modernization programs
* Sponsor the progression of clients from **assessment MVP scale**, ensuring opportunities are capability-led and repeatable—not opportunistic.
* Act as executive sponsor on strategic deals and long-term programs; partner with Sales on pursuit orchestration and commercial closure.
* Maintain pipeline hygiene: stage quality, next steps, close plans, and predictable coverage.

**2) Executive Coverage & Relationship Development**

* Serve as the outward-facing BFSI leader and build trusted relationships with:
  + CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs
  + Heads of Risk, Compliance, Operations, Digital, and Data
* Engage clients as a thought partner and modernization advisor; convert executive alignment into funded programs.
* Represent the firm at BFSI events, conferences, and executive forums.
* Lead and contribute to BFSI thought leadership (POVs, whitepapers, panels, roundtables).

**3) Territory/Account Strategy & Growth Plays**

* Define and own the BFSI market strategy for your region/territory.
* Identify priority lines of business, such as:
  + Retail & Commercial Banking
  + Payments & Cards
  + Capital Markets
  + Wealth & Asset Management
  + Insurance
  + Risk, Compliance, and Financial Crime
* Develop BFSI-specific value propositions and use cases aligned to enterprise modernization priorities.
* Shape a BFSI-focused, capability-led GTM model in partnership with practice leaders and Sales.

**4) Deal Shaping (Assessment MVP Scale)**

* Lead discovery with BFSI clients; translate business and regulatory challenges into technology-enabled modernization programs.
* Sponsor and guide solution shaping across:
  + Modernization assessments and roadmaps
  + Data and AI readiness initiatives
  + Platform, cloud, and infrastructure transformation programs
* Partner closely with internal practices (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) to ensure solutions are outcome-driven, realistic, and defensible.
* Ensure pricing and estimation are disciplined; protect margin integrity by validating assumptions, scope, and delivery approach.

**5) Offering Influence & Differentiation**

* Influence the development of BFSI offerings and accelerators that improve repeatability, win-rate, and conversion to multi-year programs.
* Ensure solutions reflect BFSI expectations:
  + Regulatory rigor
  + Enterprise-scale complexity
  + Risk, governance, security, and resilience
* Stay current on BFSI modernization drivers, regulatory trends, and AI adoption challenges.

**6) Ecosystem & Partner Engagement**

* Leverage technology and platform partners selectively to accelerate credible wins.
* Participate in joint GTM and co-sell motions where they support BFSI growth goals.
* Maintain independence and objectivity—partner-aware, not partner-led.

**Measures of Success (What “Good” Looks Like)**

* Predictable BFSI pipeline sourced through executive discovery and modernization triggers
* Strong conversion from **POV/assessment MVP multi-year program**
* Growing average deal size and increased share of multi-year modernization engagements
* Deep executive coverage within priority accounts (multiple senior stakeholders)
* Clear differentiation from implementation-only firms through insight, repeatability, and defensible programs

  
**Who You Are**  
  
**Experience**

* 15+ years in Banking, Financial Services, and/or Insurance
* Proven record **originating** revenue through advisory relationships and consultative engagement
* Strong background in enterprise technology modernization (data, cloud, platforms, security, AI)
* Demonstrated ability to influence and sell to senior BFSI executives
* Track record of converting executive conversations into structured, funded programs

**Attributes (Non-Negotiable)**

* Hybrid consultant + technologist + commercial leader
* Naturally curious and deeply informed about BFSI challenges
* Comfortable owning growth without transactional selling
* Strong executive presence and storytelling ability
* Well-respected in the BFSI ecosystem
* Entrepreneurial mindset; comfortable with ambiguity
* Outward-facing personality—people enjoy engaging with and learning from you

**What You Won’t Be Doing**

* Not a transactional sales role focused on volume outreach
* Not primarily RFP-response driven
* Not a delivery management role (delivery execution is owned by practice and delivery leaders)

**Travel & Location**  
  
Based in Canada (or the United States). Willingness to travel for client engagements, industry events, and executive meetings.  
  
**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to build and own a BFSI growth engine through consultative origination
* Platform to establish your industry voice and thought leadership
* Strong alignment with AI-era enterprise modernization
* Entrepreneurial environment with executive influence
* Ability to shape offerings, solutions, and market narrative

  
**What to expect**  
  
Besides Competitive Salary and working for one of Canadas Best Managed and Top 50 Technology Companies, you should expect:

* Purposeful Work: autonomy, resources, and time you need to do what matters for our clients and most importantly - you
* Positive Environment: recognition coupled with a flexible environment that celebrates diversity, inclusivity and encourages everyone to achieve their best
* Growth & Development: opportunities to grow professionally and personally through mentorship, training, and development programs
* Transparency & Trust: direction, purpose, mission, and expectations are never a secret; you will always know where you stand as well as where you are going
* Exclusive Perks: discounts on shopping, the gym, insurance, mobile phone plans, not to mention an office smoothie bar and enough coffee to make you vibrate
* Meaningful Benefits: life happens. You will get health, dental, vision, disability, travel insurance, and much more all covered by us
* Unforgettable Events: team bonding, BBQs, office lunches (pizza, always pizza), gala dinners, and any other excuse to have fun

**Inclusion and equal opportunity employment**  
  
ML arteka is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status, or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodation during the application process is available upon request.

The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead is responsible for managing, processing, and analyzing utility infrastructure data collected in the field for electric utility programs. This role supports pole inventory, joint-use audits, and distribution system mapping initiatives by transforming field-collected data into accurate datasets used for engineering design, asset management, and utility planning.  
  
Working closely with field crews and project managers, the GIS Technician II reviews incoming data for accuracy, coordinates data collection requirements, and processes information within platforms such as Katapult Pro, ESRI Field Maps, GIS systems, and related software tools.  
  
This position plays a critical role in ensuring utility infrastructure data is accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with client standards.

* Coordinate with field crews responsible for collecting pole inventory and utility infrastructure data.
* Develop and distribute field data collection packages and project instructions.
* Provide ongoing support to field personnel regarding data collection requirements and standards.
* Track project progress and field data submission status.

  
**Data Processing & Analysis**

* Process field data within Katapult Pro workflows including pole modeling, attachment identification, and field verification review.
* Validate field photos and measurements to ensure pole loading analysis requirements are met.

  
**Pole Inventory & Joint-Use Analysis**

* Review pole inventory data to confirm attachment ownership and pole characteristics.
* Analyze joint-use attachment data including telecommunications and cable infrastructure.
* Ensure collected data meets utility and engineering requirements for pole loading analysis and design.

**Software & Data Management**

* Manage and process data within industry platforms including:
  + Katapult Pro
  + ESRI Field Maps
  + GIS systems
  + CAD or mapping software as required
* Maintain organized project data repositories and ensure proper version control.

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform quality checks on incoming field data including photo documentation, GPS data, and asset attributes.
* Identify discrepancies or missing data and coordinate corrections with field crews.
* Ensure deliverables meet internal QC standards and client specifications.

  
**Project Coordination**

* Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project schedules and deliverables are met.
* Provide technical support to field crews collecting pole inventory data.
* Review incoming field data daily to identify missing attributes, incorrect measurements, or documentation gaps.
* Coordinate data corrections and re-collection when necessary.

  
**Qualifications**

* 2+ years experience processing utility data, GIS datasets, or pole inventory/joint-use programs.
* Experience supporting electric utility infrastructure projects preferred.
* Experience working with pole inventory or joint-use datasets highly preferred.
* An educational background in Land Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field is preferred.
* In-depth knowledge of surveying principles, techniques, and procedures.
* Problem solving and organizational skills are necessary.
* Strong communication and leadership abilities.

  
The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead works in the office, providing technical support and leadership in surveying operations. This role involves data processing and collaboration with survey teams.

-----------------

* Must have any of the following certifications: CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GREM, OSCP certification
* Strong background or equivalent experience in four of the following: Security Threat and Event Analysis, Network Security Operations or Engineering, Reverse Engineering, Malware Analysis, Windows/Linux/OSX Forensics, Penetration Testing, Active Directory and Azure Administration.

Title: DFIR Lead
Description:

This role is crucial for leading and mentoring a Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) team, ensuring effective incident response and investigation practices within an organization. The primary goal is to secure the environment through proactive measures, coordinated incident responses, and ongoing team development to address security incidents efficiently.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead and mentor the DFIR team, managing daily tasks.
* Coordinate incident response activities during security incidents in unknown environments.
* Conduct in-depth forensic investigations to identify security breaches' root causes.
* Develop and maintain standard incident response plans and policies.
* Create custom incident response plans for specific client environments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, legal, management) for coordinated responses.

* Respond to technical assistance requests.
* Maintain awareness of the current threat landscape.
* Champion knowledge sharing and prepare technical documentation and reports.

* Certifications: CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GREM, OSCP.

Nice to Haves:
  
  

* Experience in penetration testing and cloud security (Azure Administration).

Other Details:
  
  

* Location: May involve travel during security incidents, including overseas.

Reason (Must Have):

Trust Score: Score: High
  
  
Evidence: The job description provides detailed responsibilities and essential skills with specific certifications, ensuring clarity for technical sourcing and candidate screening.

The job description provides good technical clarity for sourcing. Consider these potential recommendations to enhance the search:

Title: Senior Manager – Technology Transformation
Description:
**About the job**

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.

Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure & entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing & logistics, and science.

**For the Good of Tomorrow**

Dubai Holding Investment is looking to hire a
**Senior Manager – Technology Transformation**
role reporting to the Executive Director – Portfolio Operations and Intelligence. The role holder is responsible for identifying, developing and delivering technology, data and digital transformation initiatives across DHI, and for turning the technology transformation agenda into solutions that are deployed, adopted and deliver measurable value.

The role holder identifies and defines opportunities, builds the business case for each initiative, and leads delivery through internal technology functions and delivery partners. Initiatives are held to their intended outcomes, adoption and benefits, not go-live alone. This is a hands-on role. The role holder personally designs, builds and deploys data, analytics, automation and AI solutions, and coordinates multidisciplinary teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Transformation Strategy & Roadmap*

* Provide analysis and recommendations to help develop DHI’s technology, data and digital transformation agenda, for review by the Executive Director – Portfolio Operations and Intelligence.
* Develop and maintain roadmaps for assigned initiatives, sequencing activity by value, dependency, risk and readiness.
* Assess current technology and data capability within assigned business areas, and identify gaps and the capability needed.
* Track emerging technology, data and AI developments, and turn the relevant ones into practical use cases for DHI.
* Lead discovery and solution design with DHI departments, running workshops that define the opportunity, scope and intended outcome of each initiative.
* Define the master data and systems integration approach for DHI investment and portfolio data, establishing a single source of truth in line with Group architecture and data standards, for approval by the Executive Director.

*Investment Case & Value Quantification*

* Identify opportunities to improve revenue, productivity, customer experience, operational performance and decision-making through data, analytics, automation and AI.
* Develop business cases for assigned initiatives, quantifying benefit, cost, feasibility and risk.
* Define value hypotheses, success metrics, adoption targets and value realisation frameworks for each initiative.
* Prioritize initiatives on value, feasibility, risk and strategic alignment, and make recommendations to the Executive Director.
* Track and report benefits realised against the approved business case.

*Hands-On Technical Delivery*

* Design, develop, deploy and maintain data and analytical solutions, dashboards, automation solutions and AI-enabled products.
* Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes and data transformation workflows.
* Write and optimize SQL, Python and related analytical code.
* Develop prototypes, proofs of concept and minimum viable products to test feasibility before committing to full investment.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and continuously improve the performance, scalability and reliability of solutions.

*Data, Analytics, AI & Product Ownership*

* Own the lifecycle of data, analytics, automation and AI products, from concept through deployment and adoption.
* Define product vision, user requirements, roadmaps, backlogs and delivery priorities, based on the end-to-end needs of alternative asset management users, including investment professionals, portfolio managers, senior leadership and governance functions. Translate business challenges into technical requirements, user stories and solution designs.
* Develop management reporting, KPI frameworks and decision-support solutions that give leadership a reliable view of performance.
* Conduct exploratory, diagnostic and predictive analysis. Design and implement automation, machine learning, generative AI and advanced analytics use cases, assessing business value, data readiness, technical feasibility and associated risks.
* Drive user adoption, product enhancements and continuous improvement.

*Transformation Delivery*

* Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned transformation initiatives, managing scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Comply with Group Technology governance frameworks, architecture standards, stage gates and change controls. Prepare initiative submissions for the relevant governance forums.
* Ensure initiatives meet cybersecurity, data protection, privacy and AI governance requirements.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies and issues early. Resolve them within the initiative and escalate material matters to the Executive Director.
* Ensure solutions are designed for adoption, supportability and scale. Manage the transition to run, with ownership and the support model agreed.

*Vendor & Partner Management*

* Manage technology vendors, systems integrators and implementation partners on assigned initiatives day to day.
* Monitor partner delivery against contracted outcomes, quality and timelines, and escalate commercial or delivery issues to the Executive Director.
* Contribute market insight to vendor evaluation and solution selection.

*Stakeholder Engagement & Change Adoption*

* Build effective working relationships with DHI department leads, functional teams, architects, engineers and analysts to gather input and secure alignment.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions and solution design activities. Explain technical concepts in clear commercial terms for non-technical stakeholders.
* Plan and deliver change enablement and user adoption activities, so deployed capability is used and delivers value.
* Report progress, risks, recommendations, insights and realised value to senior stakeholders.

**Who we are looking for:**

* 6 – 8 years of experience in technology transformation, data product development, applied AI, technology consulting or data-enabled transformation.
* Demonstrated experience personally taking a problem through to a production-grade product.
* Demonstrated experience taking initiatives from business case through delivery, adoption and realised benefits.
* Proven experience working directly with senior business stakeholders, cross-functional technical teams and delivery partners.
* Experience in the GCC / Dubai market, and exposure to alternative asset management, principal investment or portfolio company environments preferred.

**Education / Professional Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or another relevant quantitative discipline.
* Advanced degree, such as an MBA, preferred.
* Relevant cloud, data platform, AI or programme management certifications advantageous.

**Technical Competencies:**

* Technology, data and digital transformation planning and roadmap development
* Business case development, value quantification and benefits realisation
* Data platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, Spark, Hive or Palantir Foundry
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, PL/SQL, Spark and similar languages
* Data modelling, design patterns and highly scalable, secure analytical solution design
* APIs, orchestration, scheduling and integration patterns across structured and unstructured data and common file formats
* Building and evaluating analytics, automation, machine learning and generative AI prototypes and products
* Data governance, metadata, lineage, master data, data quality, information security, privacy and responsible AI
* Programme and product delivery, including agile and hybrid methods
* Vendor and partner delivery management
* Change enablement, adoption and user engagement

**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.**

Title: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical
  
  
Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.
  
  
Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.
  
  
The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.
  
  
If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.
  
  
**Location:**
We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.

* Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
* Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.
* Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.

* Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
* Negotiate successful contracts.

* Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.

* Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
* Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
* Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

**Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring**

* Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
* Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you
  
  
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
  
  
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
  
  

* Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Parental Leave
* Employee Assistance Programme

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
