Title: Director of Information Technology
Description:
CarltonOne is a global B2B technology leader, and part of the Goldman Sachs portfolio, helping organizations around the world reward and inspire exceptional people. Our solutions empower employees to be more productive, sales teams to perform at their best, and customers to stay engaged and loyal.

Our platform powers the global engagement industry, enabling companies to deliver impactful employee recognition, customer loyalty, rewards, sales, and channel incentive programs. We partner with over
**450 clients**
,
**500 vendors**
, and serve
**14 million members**
across
**185 countries**
.

Beyond engagement, every CarltonOne solution drives our eco-action mission: funding tree planting to help restore the planet. To date, we’ve funded over
**21 million trees**
and are on track to plant millions more each year. Learn more at
carltonone.com
.

**About the Opportunity:**

CarltonOne is seeking a highly motivated Director, Information Technology to lead CarltonOne's global enterprise IT function, owning IT strategy, service management, governance, and employee technology experience.

This role is responsible for delivering a best-in-class employee technology experience across the organization, ensuring employees have the tools, systems, support, and infrastructure they need to be productive and successful. The Director, IT will lead internal IT support, service delivery, endpoint management, identity and access management, collaboration tools, workplace technology initiatives, and global hardware operations across CarltonOne's international workforce.

This is a strategic leadership role. The Director, IT is accountable for the outcomes of IT service delivery rather than working the support queue, leading through managers, team leads, and managed service partners who handle Level 1 and Level 2 support. The Director serves as the senior escalation point and leader during major IT and security incidents, and focuses on strengthening process, governance, and measurement to deliver an exceptional, proactive employee experience. The successful candidate will focus on improving service levels, modernizing IT processes, strengthening security practices, and scaling internal technology operations to support a growing global organization.

**Responsibilities:**

**IT Service Management & Incident Leadership**

* Own CarltonOne's global IT operating model, including service desk structure, tiered support (L1/L2/L3), escalation paths, and the balance of in-house and managed service provider (MSP) coverage.
* Hold the service desk and support partners accountable for timely, high-quality resolution of employee requests and issues, without personally working day-to-day L1/L2 tickets.
* Define and publish SLAs, experience level agreements (XLAs), and an IT performance scorecard covering CSAT, first-contact resolution, mean time to resolve, SLA attainment, backlog age, and reopen rates, reported monthly to executive leadership.
* Run a continuous improvement program driven by ticket trend analysis, employee feedback, and experience data, with the goal of reducing ticket volume per employee year over year.
* Ensure consistent delivery of IT services across all regions and time zones.
* Act as Major Incident Manager and senior escalation point for high-impact IT outages, leading coordinated response, stakeholder communications, and service restoration.
* Partner with Information Security to support the response to security incidents, including containment of affected accounts and devices, evidence preservation, and executive communication, in line with the incident response plan.
* Implement a problem management practice that uses root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to eliminate recurring issues, with tracked corrective actions.
* Establish change, release, and configuration management processes that reduce change-related incidents and protect service stability.
* Own Jira Service Management as the IT service management platform, driving workflow design, automation, SLA tracking, and reporting.
* Partner with SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams to align IT processes such as access, change, and incident management with production operations, and provide the internal tools and access they need.
* Own the IT service management (ITSM) platform roadmap, service catalogue, and knowledge base, aligned to ITIL 4 practices.

**Employee Technology Experience**

* Develop and enhance the overall employee technology experience across the organization.
* Ensure employees have access to reliable hardware, software, collaboration tools, and support resources regardless of location.
* Partner with business leaders to understand technology needs and improve workplace productivity.
* Evaluate and implement technologies that improve employee efficiency, collaboration, and engagement.
* Champion self-service support resources, knowledge management programs, and technology adoption initiatives.
* Shift IT from reactive to proactive by using monitoring, digital employee experience (DEX) tooling, and endpoint analytics to detect and resolve issues before employees are affected.
* Measure employee technology sentiment through regular surveys and an IT Net Promoter Score, and act on the results with visible follow-through.
* Promote a shift-left approach that moves common requests to self-service and automation, freeing the team for higher-value work.
* Create seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences through standardized technology processes.

**Global Hardware & Employee Technology Management**

* Own CarltonOne's global hardware procurement, deployment, lifecycle management, and asset governance strategy.
* Develop and manage scalable processes for onboarding and offboarding employees across Canada, the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other international locations.
* Partner with global vendors, distributors, and logistics providers to ensure timely delivery, replacement, retrieval, and support of employee equipment worldwide.
* Establish global standards for laptops, peripherals, mobile devices, and collaboration technology to provide a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee hardware inventory management, asset tracking, auditing, and recovery programs across all regions.
* Manage relationships with international hardware partners and service providers to optimize cost, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Develop regional technology deployment strategies that account for customs requirements, shipping timelines, local regulations, and business needs.
* Ensure all employee devices are properly configured, secured, encrypted, and compliant with company security standards prior to deployment.
* Partner with Information Security teams to maintain endpoint management, device compliance, and security controls globally.
* Lead technology refresh programs and lifecycle planning to ensure employees have access to modern and reliable equipment.
* Establish reporting and KPIs related to deployment timelines, inventory accuracy, hardware utilization, asset recovery, and employee satisfaction.

**IT Leadership & Talent**

* Build, lead, and develop a global IT organization, including people managers, team leads, and specialists, and manage MSP and outsourced support partners.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
* Foster a customer-first service culture focused on responsiveness, accountability, and problem resolution.
* Design staffing models, global coverage, escalation processes, and on-call rotations so that routine support across all time zones is delivered by the team and its partners.
* Promote knowledge sharing, process consistency, and operational excellence across the team.
* Build a high-performing IT organization capable of supporting a rapidly growing global workforce.

**Infrastructure & Workplace Technology**

* Oversee the management of employee technology including laptops, mobile devices, conference room systems, printers, and collaboration tools.
* Ensure reliable operation of corporate productivity platforms including Microsoft 365, communication platforms, and workplace technologies.
* Support office technology infrastructure across multiple global locations.
* Own software licensing and SaaS governance, including licence optimization, application rationalization, and shadow IT controls.
* Identify opportunities to modernize and standardize workplace technology solutions.

**Identity, Access Management & IT Security**

* Oversee user provisioning, deprovisioning, and identity and access management processes.
* Partner closely with Information Security teams to maintain secure access controls and endpoint security standards.
* Support security awareness initiatives and IT compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to IT policies, security best practices, and governance standards.
* Participate in internal and external audits related to IT operations and controls.
* Help strengthen the company's security posture through proactive management of employee technology and access controls.

**Vendor & Technology Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, service providers, telecommunications partners, and technology suppliers.
* Negotiate contracts, licensing agreements, and support arrangements.
* Evaluate technology investments and recommend solutions that align with business requirements and budgets.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure service commitments are achieved.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate vendors and improve operational efficiency.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Lead enterprise IT projects from planning through implementation and ongoing support.
* Support technology rollouts, infrastructure upgrades, collaboration platform enhancements, and automation initiatives.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Security, Operations, and Technology teams on cross-functional projects.
* Develop project plans, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive automation and process improvement initiatives that increase productivity and reduce manual effort.

**IT Strategy, Governance, Risk & Business Continuity**

* Develop and own a multi-year IT strategy and roadmap aligned to CarltonOne's business objectives and growth plans.
* Own the IT operating and capital budget, with clear reporting on spend, cost per employee, and return on technology investments, including the cost, utilization, and value of software, SaaS, and AI tools.
* Manage IT expenses through SAP Concur, ensuring policy compliance, accurate cost allocation, and timely financial reporting.
* Establish and maintain IT operational policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Chair IT governance forums, such as a change advisory board and a technology steering committee, to prioritize demand and investment.
* Ensure compliance with corporate requirements, security policies, and audit standards, including ownership of IT general controls (ITGCs) and implementation and continuous compliance with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, and remediation of findings.
* Maintain accurate documentation of systems, assets, processes, and support procedures.
* Own disaster recovery planning and regular testing for internal systems and employee technologies, and partner with the business on continuity planning.
* Maintain an IT risk register, report key risks to leadership, and own mitigation plans through to closure.

**Qualifications:**

* **10+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in IT leadership, with experience managing managers and/or managed service partners.**
* Experience leading internal IT operations, service desk, workplace technology, or enterprise support teams.
* Experience leading internal IT within a SaaS company, including supporting SaaS production, engineering, and DevOps teams with access management, tooling, change coordination, and incident collaboration.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and modern workplace technologies.
* Proven experience managing global hardware deployment and asset lifecycle programs.
* Experience supporting distributed workforces across multiple countries and time zones.
* Expert in ITIL 4 and IT service management (ITSM), with a proven record of designing, implementing, and maturing incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge management processes.
* Hands-on experience implementing and administering Jira Service Management, including workflows, service catalogue, SLAs, automation, and reporting.
* Proven experience implementing and improving controls aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Critical Security Controls, and SOC 2, including audit readiness, evidence collection, remediation of findings, and ongoing compliance.
* Proven track record leading major incident response and partnering with security teams on security incident response.
* Demonstrated use of data, KPIs, and experience metrics to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Proven experience owning and managing an IT budget, including forecasting, variance tracking, and reporting to leadership on the financial performance and return on investment of software, SaaS, and AI tool spend.
* Experience using SAP Concur for IT expense management, including expense policy, approvals, and spend reporting.
* Experience managing vendors, software licensing, and technology procurement.
* Proven experience leading IT projects and operational improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Strong customer service mindset with a focus on employee experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a global workforce across North America, South America, Europe, and APAC.
* Experience with IT governance and control frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, or ISO 20000.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, endpoint security, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting HRIS, Finance, and SaaS business applications.
* ITIL 4, Atlassian (Jira Service Management), Microsoft, CISSP, CISM, or related certifications.

**Additional Perks**

Here are some additional perks that we provide:

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Vacation plus personal days.
* Access to our employee benefits portal for exclusive discounts.
* Monthly company-wide events, celebrations, and team activities.
* Bravo reward points program for recognition and appreciation.
* Convenient office location close to public transit.

**How to Apply**

If this great opportunity looks rewarding to you, let’s connect. Our online application will give you the option to apply to this role directly.

The target hiring range for this position is $115,000 to $135,000 Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply. If we can make this easier through accommodation in the recruitment process, or if you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact us with the “Help” button in the application.

We will review applications, with priority given to those who have completed the assessment, and look forward to hearing from you.

Title: Senior Director
Description:
**Title:**
Senior Director, Fedcap Canada

**Company:**
Fedcap Canada

**Department:**
Program Services

**Location | Travel Requirements**
: On-site Ontario, Canada | Local, regional, and occasional international travel, including the United States and United Kingdom

**Supervisor:**
President, Fedcap Inc./Fedcap Canada

**Classification:**
Full-Time, Salaried

**Compensation Range:**
CAD $160,000–$185,000 annually

**About Fedcap**

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

Fedcap Canada plays an integral role in Ontario's Employment Services Transformation as a Service System Manager (SSM). Working in partnership with Service Providers, employers, government agencies, and community organizations, Fedcap Canada strengthens local service delivery, expands access to employment opportunities, and supports individuals facing barriers to sustainable employment. Our approach focuses on building local capacity, advancing best practices, and delivering measurable outcomes that strengthen communities across Ontario.

**Position Summary**

Reporting to the President of Fedcap Inc./Fedcap Canada, the Vice President provides strategic and operational oversight of Fedcap Canada's employment services operations. As the senior executive responsible for Service System Management across Ontario, this position ensures operational excellence, contractual performance, financial stewardship, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across multiple catchment areas.

The Vice President leads the development and execution of strategies that strengthen Service Provider capacity, improve participant outcomes, and drive consistent, high-quality service delivery. Working closely with Ministry partners, Service Providers, employers, and community stakeholders, this position advances system-wide performance, strategic partnerships, and achievement of contractual Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

As a member of the senior leadership team, the Vice President also supports organizational growth, business development, and expansion into new regions. This includes building a high-performing leadership team, ensuring operational readiness, managing organizational risk, and advancing Fedcap Canada's position as a leader in workforce development and employment services.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the senior operational executive for Fedcap Canada, exercising decision-making authority in partnership with the President of Fedcap Inc./Fedcap Canada.
* Develop and maintain executive relationships with the Ministry of Labour, Immigration, Training and Skills Development (MLITSD), the Ministry of Children, Community and Social Services (MCCSS), and other government partners to support contract performance and strategic priorities.
* Represent Fedcap Canada in discussions regarding employment services policy, system design, service delivery, and sector innovation.
* Cultivate partnerships with organizations serving Indigenous, Francophone, Black and racialized communities, persons with disabilities, newcomers, and other designated inclusion groups to strengthen equitable access and achieve contractual inclusion KPIs.
* Engage with adjacent ministries, including the Ministry of the Solicitor General, to support coordinated service delivery and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with senior leadership across The Fedcap Group and Fedcap Inc. to advance strategic planning, organizational growth, policy development, and workforce development initiatives nationally and internationally.
* Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and strategic issues requiring executive attention or intervention.

**Service System Management & Operational Excellence**

* Provide executive oversight of employment services operations across all assigned catchment areas, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with contractual obligations and organizational standards.
* Lead the implementation and transition of new catchment areas, overseeing start-up activities, operational readiness, organizational capacity, and alignment with Fedcap's operating model.
* Strengthen Service Provider capacity through performance management, coaching, knowledge sharing, and implementation of consistent best practices.
* Advance localism and market stewardship to ensure services are responsive to regional labour markets, community needs, and underserved populations.
* Monitor Service Provider performance, identify systemic barriers, and implement strategic interventions to improve outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Serve as a trusted executive advisor to Service Providers, promoting collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement while minimizing unnecessary administrative burden.
* Provide strategic direction for FedcapCARES, the organization's case management system, including identification of functionality needs, system enhancements, and operational priorities.
* Ensure service delivery practices, communications, and operations support Ontario's English and French language requirements.

**Contract Performance & Financial Stewardship**

* Maintain executive accountability for contractual performance, policy implementation, operational governance, financial management, and organizational sustainability.
* Oversee system-wide performance against contractual KPIs, including participant volumes, employment outcomes, retention measures, and inclusion targets.
* Ensure achievement of at least 85% of contractually established participant volumes through ongoing monthly performance monitoring and corrective action.
* Drive achievement of sustainable employment outcomes, including a minimum 38% point-in-time job entry rate and contractual employment retention targets at 30, 90, 180, and 365 days.
* Ensure 100% of participant intakes are completed within contractual timelines, including the established 30-day requirement.
* Ensure Service Providers achieve contractual inclusion targets through equitable access, targeted engagement, and effective service delivery.
* Provide executive oversight of budgeting, contract negotiations, operational expenditures, financial reporting, and fiscal controls.
* Review general ledger (GL) and profit and loss (P&L) reporting weekly to monitor financial performance, identify variances, and ensure sound fiscal stewardship.
* Use performance data, financial analysis, and operational reporting to guide decision-making, mitigate risk, and improve system-wide outcomes.

**Organizational Leadership & Growth**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team with clear objectives, accountability, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Foster a culture of transparency, engagement, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous improvement aligned with Fedcap's mission and values.
* Establish leadership priorities, execution plans, and performance expectations that strengthen organizational effectiveness and service delivery.
* Maintain expert knowledge of Ontario Employment Services Transformation, social assistance programs, workforce development policy, and evolving government priorities.
* Support business development opportunities, geographic expansion, and new service delivery models, ensuring operational scalability and organizational readiness.
* Promote effective cross-functional collaboration and strategic communication across Fedcap Canada and the broader Fedcap organization.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support organizational and operational priorities.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Graduate degree in business administration, public administration, workforce development, social services, supply chain management, contract management, or a related field.
* Minimum seven years of progressively responsible leadership experience, including management of large-scale operations, complex service delivery systems, or Service Provider networks.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex government-funded programs, contracts, budgets, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience overseeing performance-driven service delivery operations with accountability for contractual outcomes and financial performance.
* Experience developing, coaching, and leading geographically dispersed or remote teams.
* Experience working with government agencies, public policy, and workforce development systems strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of Ontario Employment Services Transformation and Service System Management preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong executive leadership, strategic planning, organizational management, and decision-making capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to translate organizational strategy into measurable operational and financial results.
* Strong understanding of contract management, performance accountability, government reporting, and financial stewardship.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage government officials, senior executives, and community stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead complex operations, manage competing priorities, and drive continuous improvement across multiple service delivery locations.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using data, technology platforms, and performance management tools to guide operational decisions.
* Ability to build collaborative, accountable relationships with Service Providers, subcontractors, employers, and government partners.
* Demonstrated commitment to equitable service delivery, accessibility, inclusion, and participant-centered outcomes.
* Ability to lead organizational change, strengthen leadership capacity, and foster a high-performing, mission-driven culture.

**Benefits**

Benefits and retirement programs are provided in accordance with applicable Fedcap Canada employee benefit plans and eligibility requirements.

**Equal Opportunity Employer & Recruitment Disclosure**

Fedcap Canada is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, respectful, and accessible workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment based on any ground protected under the Ontario Human Rights Code, including race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, and other applicable protected grounds.

In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code, Fedcap Canada welcomes applications from persons with disabilities and provides

accommodations upon request throughout the recruitment, assessment, and selection process. Applicants requiring accommodation, including accessible formats or interview-related support, are encouraged to inform their recruiter.

This posting is for an existing vacancy with Fedcap Canada. Artificial intelligence may be used to assist in screening and assessing applicant qualifications. All hiring decisions are made by individuals, not artificial intelligence.

Title: Technical Services Manager
Description:
**Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**Job Title:**
Technical Services Manager

**Location:**
Canada

**Travel expectations:**
80% travel

**Your Impact**

As a Technical Services Manager, you will be a vital team member responsible for leading the deployment of network, hardware, and software solutions for Axon's Fleet systems. This post-sale, customer-facing, front-line role requires efficiency in deployment, management of third-party installations, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience and continued support.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and coordinate Fleet installations, ensuring efficiency and a positive customer experience.
* Keep 3rd party installers and Axon customers updated on installation status through daily reports and stand-up meetings.
* Ensure regular and reliable attendance, demonstrating commitment to work responsibilities.
* Deploy hardware and software solutions in a dynamic environment with minimal assistance.
* Exhibit flexibility to undertake additional projects and adapt to evolving priorities.
* Provide guidance to customers on optimal hardware placement, tailoring solutions to enhance workflows and ensure compliant data collection.
* Develop accurate installation diagrams and thorough documentation for implemented solutions.
* Provide administrative support for vendor setup, clearances, tracking, and maintenance of work orders
* Engage with key technology decision-makers post-sale.
* Conduct training sessions for both technical and non-technical staff on the use of Axon Fleet and Interview solutions.
* Train customer technical and non-technical staff and 12V low-voltage sub-contractors on proper installation and use of Axon hardware and software components.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Technical Acumen:**

* Strong experience with IP networking and connected devices, including configuration and troubleshooting across Layer 2, TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless environments.
* Ability to quickly identify and resolve network connectivity issues involving routers, modems, gateways, access points, and edge devices.
* Solid understanding of core networking principles, including switching, routing, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, and physical layer infrastructure.
* Experience with remote and mobile networking technologies, such as Cradlepoint or similar solutions, is highly valued.
* Familiarity with data communications, WAN access methods, wireless technologies, and local network infrastructure in distributed or field-based environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across network-connected hardware and communications systems.
* Exposure to low-voltage / 12V electrical systems is an asset, including basic wiring, DC circuit fundamentals, relays, fuses, and power distribution.
* Familiarity with vehicle electrical or communication systems such as CAN bus, LIN bus, auxiliary battery systems, lighting, or siren integrations is considered a nice to have.
* Ability to read wiring diagrams and support equipment installation or fault isolation is beneficial.

**Other Qualifications:**

* Experience with law enforcement agencies is highly valued.
* Ability to work safely and skilfully with hand tools.
* Proven team leadership skills, supporting customers and third parties to achieve objectives.
* Previous experience in leading a team or contractors on multiple projects with successful outcomes.
* Exceptional communication skills, professionalism, and ability to work both within a team and independently.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Desire to work with a team or visit clients in person weekly. (Candidates must reside within reasonable proximity to a major airport.)
* French speaking is an asset but not required

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range: $74,250 CAD - $118,800 CAD

If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*

Title: Director of Care, Long-term Care
Description:
**Life at Kensington Health**

At Kensington Health, we are proud to have built a community where people can bring their full selves to work. As a not-for-profit, we believe in the work we do every day. It's what motivates us, inspires, and propels our bold vision forward: a better life for everyone.

Diversity is at the heart of who we are and at Kensington, we celebrate our differences, knowing that creating safe, inclusive, and equitable spaces in healthcare strengthens our bold vision: building a better life for everyone. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion efforts are guided by our DEI Strategy as we continuously strive to offer equal opportunities for all.

Our people are what make Kensington Health such a special place to work, learn, and grow and delivering exceptional health care to our community – and beyond – is what keeps people here for years. Interested in reimagining community-delivered care with us? Check out our open roles!

**Kensington Health Perks**

* Generous benefits package that includes employer-paid health plan and vacation.

* Free, confidential mental health and wellness support services through an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

* Located near the vibrant and diverse Kensington Market neighbourhood, boasting a 99 Walk Score & 97 Public Transit Score.

* An environment that supports and fosters healthy work-life balance.

**Job Overview**

Reporting to the Vice-President, Long-term Care, Community and Hospice, the Director of Care, Long-term Care (LTC), serves Kensington Health's LTC home (i.e., Kensington Gardens) to oversee the clinical operations and advance quality of care, safety, and the experience of the people we serve.

The role is pivotal to ensuring operational excellence by stewarding human, financial and material resources at Kensington Gardens. This role will be guided by the legislation and regulations governing LTC in Ontario, the organization's policies and procedures and best practices for nursing and personal care.

As a key member of the strategic and operational leadership team, the Director of Care, Long-term Care, will lead a team of Associate Directors of Care; After-hours Managers; and other support service team members to deliver on daily care and services for the people who live at Kensington Gardens.

**Responsibilities**

**Human Resources:**

* Directs and supports processes related to recruitment, retention and performance management of team members.

* Directs and supports the staffing and payroll team for the LTC home to ensure timely and accurate processing of payroll, including approval of payroll bi-weekly.

* Supports continuous learning and professional development among leaders, nursing and personal care attendants through education, coaching, and mentorship.

* Fosters productive relationships with the union(s) including participation in labour management meetings.

* Fosters a workplace free of violence and harassment and promotes workplace safety by leading the team to take action when concerns are brought forth or observed.

* Demonstrates a commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion by championing initiatives that promote equity, diversity and inclusion.

**Financial and Material Management:**

* Provides advice and input into annual operating and capital budgets for LTC home; monitors financial results monthly; and takes action to address any opportunities.

* Directs and supports team members to ensure clinical equipment and supplies are well-maintained, inventoried and there are sufficient supplies and equipment at the point of care and service.

* Acts as the key operational contact with contracted service providers and ensures that service delivery expectations are met (e.g. pharmacy, oxygen therapy, dental, foot care, etc.).

* Oversees for the High-Intensity Needs funding and associated program.

* Leads procurement of minor and major capital equipment items for the LTC home and works in collaboration with the procurement team to execute on approved capital plan.

**Clinical Operations:**

* Oversees clinical operations with a focus on the care and services provided by the interprofessional team.

* Ensures that the Associate Directors of Care and scheduling coordinators staff the home consistently and in keeping with the approved staffing model and budget.

* Liaises with colleagues on the admissions, transfers and discharges of people living at Kensington Gardens, including the review of applications as indicated.

* Provides direction and advice on the interprofessional care planning process as needed including ensuring that care plans are up to date and accurate.

* Engages with attendant and consulting physicians and nurse practitioners as needed in relation to care issues.

* Provides oversight and direction to the ADOCs to ensure that documentation in the health record meets professional and organizational standards for nurses and personal care attendants.

* Collaborates with the Director, Professional Practice and Infection Prevention and Control, their team members and the ADOCs to facilitate skill and competency development among team members.

**Quality, Safety and Experience:**

* Provides strategic leadership to Kensington Health to advance the care, safety and experience of the people served.

* Fosters a service excellence culture through role modeling and coaching.

* Oversees and supports the resolution of inquiries from the people who live in the LTC home and their loved ones, including following the complaints escalations policy and procedure and fulfilling any notification and disclosure obligations.

* Supports the achievement of quality improvement goals and objectives (e.g. annual quality improvement plans) for the LTC home including providing guidance, advice and censuring the team executes on plan and on time.

* Promotes a just safety culture through reporting, safety incident reviews and ensuring any system and process learnings are implemented.

* Collaborates with the Medical Director, Long-Term Care, to resolve issues related to quality of care, experience and safety.

* Promotes person-centred approaches to care through role modeling and fostering of relationships with the chairs of the Residents' and Family Councils.

**Other:**

* Chairs and/or participates in committees and engagement forums as required by the organization.

* Participates in strategic initiatives that advance the organization's strategic priorities.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to lead complex change in a dynamic environment.

* Patience, flexibility, and exceptional interpersonal skills.

* Proven negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

* Strong critical thinking ability to make decisions and ability to articulate rationale for decisions.

* Ability to demonstrates composure under pressure while meeting meet multiple and competing deadlines.

* Ability to establish effective working relationships.

* Demonstrates high level of initiative, self-direction.

* proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, Point Click Care, and other information systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years of formal leadership roles in healthcare operations, preferably Long-Term Care.

* Experience with influencing and resolving conflict.

* Demonstrated leadership in implementing initiatives related to safety and quality improvement.

* Proven track record of success implementation of change initiatives, projects and partnerships.

* In depth experience related to clinical assessment, planning and interventions related to the care of people with complex needs, in particular those living in a long-term care setting.

* Knowledge of infection prevention and control principles and practices.

**Required Professional Designation/Certificate:**

* Bachelor's degree in nursing required.

* Master's degree preferred (e.g., Health Administration, Nursing, Leadership).

* Active member in good standing with the College of Nurses of Ontario.

* Membership with the Registered Nurses Association of Ontario preferred.

* Certificate in Gentle Persuasive Approaches, Non-Violent Crisis Intervention and/or change management preferred**.**

*Kensington Health is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from equity seeking groups. Kensington Health is committed to providing reasonable accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation for disability during any stage of the recruitment process, please indicate this in your cover letter.*

Title: Director of IT Operations
Industry: Construction, Software Development, and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description:
**Description**
Keeper Security is hiring a Director of IT Operations to lead our global enterprise IT function. This role will oversee IT infrastructure, end-user support, identity lifecycle management, IT service management, business continuity, vendor relationships and IT operations for Keeper’s distributed workforce. This is a 100% remote position, with the opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro area.
  
  
Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help build the systems and processes that enable our global workforce to work securely and efficiently.
  
  
**About Keeper**
Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.
  
  
**About The Job**
This role will lead the strategy, operations and continuous improvement of Keeper’s corporate IT environment. The ideal candidate is an experienced IT leader who combines strong operational discipline with a customer-focused mindset and the ability to build scalable systems for a growing, distributed workforce.
  
  
The Director of IT Operations will be responsible for developing a multi-year IT roadmap, leading the IT Operations team, managing the IT operating budget and ensuring that employees have secure and reliable access to the tools and systems they need to be successful.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise IT roadmap aligned with Keeper’s growth and business strategy
* Operate with a “customer zero” mindset, ensuring Keeper’s internal IT environment reflects and validates our product philosophy
* Lead global IT operations supporting a distributed, multi-site workforce and DevOps organization
* Build, develop and lead the IT Operations team, including staffing, performance management and succession planning
* Own the IT operating budget, forecasting, cost optimization, licensing and SaaS spend
* Oversee endpoint management, collaboration systems, enterprise applications and virtual desktop environments
* Ensure secure and frictionless access to corporate systems, SaaS platforms and development environments in partnership with Network and Security Operations
* Govern SaaS application onboarding, ownership, access permissions, integrations and decommissioning
* Maintain accurate configuration management, asset inventory and full hardware and software asset lifecycle management
* Establish and manage a multi-tiered IT support environment for a global employee population
* Own the IT service management framework, including incident, request, problem and change management processes
* Establish measurable service-level agreements and operational KPIs, with regular executive reporting
* Oversee internal IT requests, end-user systems, asset management and daily IT operations
* Own on-call coverage, escalation paths and after-hours support for critical IT services
* Develop and maintain IT support documentation, knowledge base resources, procedures, playbooks and operational plans
* Own the workforce identity lifecycle, including provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access assignment and identity governance
* Enforce token-based authentication and single sign-on across Keeper’s corporate systems
* Ensure user access changes are processed according to approved policies and maintained in auditable records

Title: Head of Customer Success & Professional Services
Description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.
  
  
****The Opportunity****
As a Head of Customer Success & Professional Services for the US, you will lead and grow our US post-sales team. You will take over an established team of 3 field engineers, develop them further and grow the team as our US business expands. You will own the delivery of our robotic fleet deployments across North America, from contract signature to operational autonomy and long-term value.
  
  
This is a player-coach role in a growth phase. You will lead key customer projects yourself and work on site with customers, while strengthening the processes, tools and standards that let the team scale. The role is highly cross-functional: you will work closely with Sales, Business Value Consultants, Product and Engineering to align customer value, delivery and product feedback. You will be the senior representative of ANYbotics’ delivery organization in the region and the trusted partner for customer stakeholders from site operators to the C-suite.
  
  
****The Market & Our Technology****
ANYbotics brings robotics into industrial environments where safety, uptime and operational reliability matter most. Our customers are large asset operators and service providers using our solution for autonomous inspection and monitoring across sectors including metals, cement, power & utilities, oil & gas and chemicals.
  
  
Our offering combines the robot platform, inspection payloads, charging systems, autonomy and software into a complete inspection solution. We have proven both the technology and the customer value through long-term deployments and are now focused on scaling our products and platform globally.
  
  
**Your Contributions**

* Team leadership & growth: Lead and develop the existing US team of customer success & field services, and grow it in line with business demand. Recruit and onboard new team members, and foster a high-performance team culture.
* Field engineering operations: Own deployment, commissioning, maintenance and support operations in the US. Plan and allocate field capacity across parallel projects, ensure high utilization and quality of execution.
* Fleet roll-out & program management: Own the US project portfolio. Lead strategic multi-site roll-outs personally where needed, and ensure all projects have clear plans, scope, budget, milestones and governance with the customer.
* Value realization & performance management: Ensure every customer has a value realization plan with defined use cases, success criteria and KPIs. Run or oversee Quarterly Performance Reviews and make the value delivered visible to customer leadership.
* Stakeholder & escalation management: Act as senior point of contact for key US accounts and as the escalation point for operational and customer issues. Drive adoption and change management within customer organizations.
* Processes & scalability: Strengthen and standardize the processes, playbooks, reporting and tooling needed to scale delivery in the US, aligned with our global Customer Success organization in Switzerland.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Sales on expansion opportunities and pre-sales feasibility, with Support on case resolution, and with Product and R&D to feed customer and field insights back into the product.

**Your Profile**

* Experience: 5+ years in customer success, field service or technical project delivery, ideally in robotics, industrial automation or complex technical systems in industrial environments.
* Leadership: 3+ years of people management, ideally leading distributed field teams. Experience growing and scaling an existing team is a strong plus.
* Project & Customer Success background: Proven track record of leading multi-site, multi-stakeholder deployments and taking ownership of customer outcomes and value realization.
* Stakeholder management: Confident with senior stakeholders and skilled at driving adoption in industrial environments such as oil and gas, chemicals or utilities.
* Technical depth: Hands-on technical understanding of robotic or automated systems, able to lead troubleshooting and support your engineers in the field.
* Data-driven: You manage your team and customers with KPIs and use data to build a clear business value story.
* Education: Degree in Engineering or a related technical field
* Travel & Location: Based in the US with authorization to work in the US. Willing to travel up to 50%, mainly within North America, and comfortable working directly in customer environments.
* Mindset: Hands-on and accountable leader who develops people and scales teams, able to operate in a fast-growing company and a distributed setup with headquarters in Switzerland.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

**Fleet Engineering & Maintenance Operations**

* Coordinate and provide technical guidance for fleet-wide New Energy Bus engineering and maintenance activities to ensure vehicle safety, reliability, availability, and compliance with approved operational standards.
* Review fleet performance audit reports, maintenance records, and technical data to identify recurring failures, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement, recommending appropriate engineering and maintenance standards.
* Monitor the technical condition and maintenance performance of New Energy Bus systems, including air-conditioning, braking, drivetrain, electrical and electronic systems, steering and suspension systems, and other critical vehicle components.
* Analyze complex technical and operational issues affecting New Energy Bus performance and provide appropriate technical recommendations and solutions in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities and ensure identified technical issues are followed up and resolved within required timeframes.

* Supervise and coordinate the activities of the New Energy Electrical Engineering team, ensuring effective work allocation, technical support, performance monitoring, and alignment with business and operational requirements.
* Review and analyze technical data, engineering reports, and performance information submitted by the Electrical Engineering team to ensure accuracy, completeness, and appropriate technical follow-up.
* Monitor OEM performance against agreed technical requirements, identify areas of non-compliance, and coordinate appropriate follow-up actions to ensure timely resolution of technical deficiencies.
* Coordinate with OEMs, manufacturers, vendors, and technical service providers to address engineering issues, review technical recommendations, and ensure effective delivery of required technical services.
* Maintain effective working relationships with internal departments and external stakeholders to facilitate technical coordination, information sharing, and resolution of New Energy Bus engineering issues.

* Identify and recommend engineering improvement initiatives, technology applications, and maintenance solutions to enhance New Energy Bus reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate engineering studies and technical assessments in collaboration with relevant specialists and external service providers to address fleet performance issues and improve engineering practices.
* Apply relevant data analysis and statistical techniques to monitor asset condition, identify failure trends, and support the optimization of maintenance strategies.

* Monitor employee performance, identify competency and development requirements, and support appropriate training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Title: Head of Operations (Support & Onboarding), Avalara Micro and Emerging Business
Description:
What You'll Do
  
  
For a small business owner, getting set up for sales or lodging tax can be the most stressful part of using our product — and the moment they decide whether to trust us. Avalara builds the software that makes tax compliance automatic. We've built a dedicated business to serve the smallest and fastest-growing of these customers, and we're looking for the leader who will make their experience effortless from the first day.
  
  
As Head of Operations, you'll own onboarding, go-live and customer support for a portfolio that includes DAVO (automated sales tax for small businesses, set up through their point-of-sale system) and MyLodgeTax (lodging tax registration and filing for short-term rental hosts), along with the registration operations that get customers compliant in the first place.
  
  
This isn't a role about growing a support team in line with customer growth. It's about building an operation where most customers never need to contact us — because onboarding just works, problems are caught early, and the manual work is automated away. You'll lead the teams that serve customers today and work directly with Product and Engineering to make each of those teams more scalable every quarter.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
Own the customer's first 90 days. Lead onboarding and go-live for every customer, from signup to their first successful filing. Define what a great activation looks like, measure it, and remove the friction that slows customers down or sends them to support.
  
  
Run support that gets better, not just bigger. Lead the support teams for DAVO and MyLodgeTax, and build out MyLodgeTax support as the portfolio grows. Set service standards, staffing models and quality measures, and treat every recurring contact as a problem to eliminate rather than a ticket to close.
  
  
Automate registration operations. Lead the team that handles tax registrations for MyLodgeTax customers today, and partner with Product and Engineering to automate that work, so the team can focus on the exceptions that really need a person.
  
  
Turn customer friction into product fixes. Build the feedback loop between operations and the product team: which issues drive contacts, which onboarding steps lose customers, and which fixes would pay back fastest. Bring data, not anecdotes, to roadmap conversations.
  
  
Work across Avalara's shared services. Partner with Avalara's filing, payments and notices teams, which this business relies on rather than rebuilding, so the customer experience is seamless end to end.
  
  
Build the team and the operating rhythm. Hire, lead and develop managers and frontline teams. Set clear goals and decision rights, and run the cadence of operating reviews, dashboards and service metrics that keeps the operation sharp.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
What you'll bring
  
  

* 10+ years in customer operations, support, onboarding or implementation, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, compliance or SMB technology
* 5+ years leading teams, including managers of frontline teams
* A track record of reducing support contacts per customer and improving activation through automation, self-service and product changes, not just headcount
* Experience scaling onboarding and support for high-volume, self-serve or SMB customers
* Strong operational analytics: contact drivers, time to activate, first-contact resolution, CSAT, cost to serve and capacity planning
* Experience working closely with Product and Engineering to prioritize and ship fixes for customer friction
* Clear, direct communication with executives and the ability to lead across a matrixed company

Bonus points
  
  

* You know tax, accounting, payments, POS, hospitality or short-term rentals
* You've run registration, filing or other regulated, deadline-driven operations
* You've used AI to scale operations: support deflection, triage, agent assist or workflow automation
* You've worked with partner-led or embedded products where onboarding runs through a third-party platform
* You're fluent in tools like Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Gainsight, Snowflake or Tableau

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

**How you get paid**

Base: $80,000 to $90,000 a year, based on what you bring. Plus 7.5% of net profit, every quarter, uncapped.

Here is how it works in plain words: at the end of each quarter, we take what the company made after all expenses. You get 7.5% of that. There is no ceiling. If the company has a great quarter, you have a great quarter. If the company makes nothing, the bonus is nothing. Your upside is tied to the same thing ours is.

That means every foot we bore, every crew day, every invoice that gets paid on time, and every truck that does not sit broken is money in your pocket. You will care about those things the way an owner does, because you are paid like one.

**Safety is part of the bonus**

At Nova, a safety incident is an injury, a utility strike, a vehicle accident or a near miss. Every one gets reported the same day, and every one gets a written root cause within 48 hours so it does not happen twice.

Safety is tied to your pay in two ways. First, what an incident costs comes out of the profit: repairs, damage claims, deductibles and fines are all deducted from net profit before your 7.5% is figured. Strike a line or wreck a truck and you feel it the same way we do. Second, you have to do the safety work to get paid the bonus. For a quarter’s share to be paid, the basics have to be done: a signed job safety analysis (JSA) on every site, every day; the weekly toolbox talk held and signed; and every incident and near miss reported on time with its root cause written.

We want near misses reported. A high number means people are talking, and that is a good sign. No one is ever penalized for reporting. Hiding an incident is grounds for termination, no matter who you are.

**What you will actually do**

* Run the field. Crews, schedules, equipment, materials, jobs.
* Be on site. Every day you are needed, not just when something goes wrong.
* Keep every job on time, on budget and billed.
* Turn the daily reports, photos and paperwork into invoices that get paid.
* Make the hard calls on the spot when a crew or customer needs an answer.
* Build the system as we grow. Today that means running the field and tightening how we work. As we add crews, the team grows under you.
* Talk to customers, inspectors and utility owners like a professional.
* Find where we are losing money and stop it.
* Be the day-to-day safety authority on every site: make sure the daily JSA is signed before ground is broken, run the weekly toolbox talk, investigate every incident and near miss, and fix what caused it.

**Who this is for**

* You have run crews, projects or a business, and you have a record of results.
* You have worked in underground utility, fiber, civil or construction, or you learn fast and have run something hard before.
* You are comfortable in the field, and you do not think you are above it.
* You want a real share of the profit, not just a paycheck.
* You are accountable. You say what you will do, then do it.
* You would rather stop a job than put a person at risk.
* You live in Georgia now.

**Who this is not for**

* Someone who wants to manage from a laptop.
* Someone who wants a high salary with no risk and no effort.
* Someone who needs a long ramp before they are useful.
* Someone who is not willing to get dirty.
* Someone who cuts corners on safety to hit a number, or who would hide an incident to protect a bonus.

**Requirements**

* Currently live in Georgia
* Valid driver’s license and a clean record behind the wheel
* Able to pass a background check
* Authorized to work in the U.S. (we use E-Verify)
* Able to work in the field in all weather

Apply here on Indeed. In your application, tell us in a few lines about the biggest thing you have run and what the result was. We read every one.

Title: Program Manager, Flexible Capacity Planning, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Last mile demand changes by the hour, the day and the season, and our delivery capacity needs to flex with it. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to design how our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) network flexes to meet demand, from 15-minute Quick Commerce to Core delivery.  
  
As Program Manager, Flexible Capacity, you will own flexible capacity models from first idea to launch and scale: part-time and flexible delivery associate models, shift design and rostering. You will start in our fastest services and take what works into Core delivery, adapting each model to the labour rules, partner base and market of each country. You will own the problem, the model, the economics, the compliance, the launch and the results.  
  
You don't need to be an expert in every area on day one. You do need to know how to take a programme from a blank page to measurable results, and how to build mechanisms that keep working after you move on.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the roadmap: define the problem, set the baseline and build the business case for flexible capacity models across fast delivery services and Core delivery.
* Design the model: work with DSP partners and station teams on shift patterns, rostering, part-time and flexible delivery associate models, and the incentives that make them work.
* Build the economics: model cost to serve, utilisation and DSP partner profitability with Finance, so cost comes down rather than moving elsewhere.
* Make it compliant: turn labour and transport rules in each country into model design, SOPs and partner guidance, working with Legal and People Experience.
* Pilot, then scale: run pilots with clear success metrics and guardrails, decide what to scale, change or stop, and adapt each model by country.
* Tech and mechanisms: write business requirements with Tech and Product teams for scheduling and capacity tools, and set up the reporting around them.
* Lead change: check operational readiness, manage risks and approvals, and build communication plans across stations and DSPs.
* Report and write: own programme metrics, contribute to business reviews and annual planning, and write clear, data-backed documents for senior leaders.

  
A day in the life  
You start by checking how capacity matched demand yesterday: where routes went unstaffed, where associates sat idle and what it cost. Mid-morning, you're with a DSP owner and a station manager testing a new shift pattern and what it means for their team and their margin. After lunch, you're with Finance on the business case for taking a part-time model into Core delivery, and with Legal checking it works under local labour rules. You finish by writing the update for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
Amazon's last mile network in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey runs on Delivery Service Partners (DSPs): local businesses whose delivery associates bring orders to our customers. Our team sets the direction for DSP across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Turkey and South Africa: where we grow, how capacity is planned, how partners are paid and how the network is designed. We work where operations meets strategy, with station and dark store teams, DSP partners, Finance, Tech, Legal and senior leaders in the region and worldwide. We value clear writing, sound data and people who own their outcomes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Title: Operations Manager DMCC
Description:
**About the Job**

OCS Services DMCC is looking for an experienced
**Operations Manager**
to lead multidisciplinary offshore projects and operations across multiple geographies. The role will oversee project execution, operational performance, commercial management, business development, and client relationships, ensuring the safe, timely, and profitable delivery of projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in offshore construction, asset integrity, steel repair, structural fabrication, piping, coating, inspection, and maintenance services, along with proven capabilities in project leadership, bid and tender management, cost control, and business growth.

**About OCS Services**

OCS Services is a seasoned player in the oil and gas industry, delivering world-class services across offshore and onshore operations. As a joint venture between Planet Energy and BW Offshore, we specialize in Operations & Maintenance, Asset Integrity Management, and Integrated Crew Management. With global operations spanning Singapore, India, UAE, Brazil, Côte d’Ivoire, and Nigeria, we are strategically positioned to support energy production safely, sustainably, and reliably. Our expertise, cutting-edge technology, and commitment to sustainability enable us to drive excellence in complex energy projects around the world.

At OCS we’re guided by four core values that define everything we do – trust, driven, care and innovation.

**What you will do**

* Lead the safe, timely, and profitable execution of AIMS projects in line with contractual requirements.
* Oversee Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Crew Coordinators across multiple projects and geographical locations.
* Manage project planning, manpower, resources, schedules, budgets, vendors, and logistics.
* Monitor project performance, productivity, quality, costs, and timelines, implementing corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with company QHSE requirements, applicable regulations, certifications, and statutory obligations.
* Manage project budgets, margins, cash flow, cost control, contract administration, variations, claims, and commercial risks.
* Drive business growth by identifying new clients, markets, and service opportunities.
* Lead and support techno-commercial proposals, bid and tender preparation, estimation, and submissions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, vendors, and industry stakeholders.
* Lead, develop, and retain competent project and operational teams, promoting accountability and continuous improvement.
* Manage vendor evaluation, negotiations, procurement competitiveness, and supplier performance.
* Establish effective project reporting systems and provide regular business and operational performance updates to management.
* Conduct project and site visits as required, providing hands-on operational support across project locations.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Structural, Marine, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in oil & gas, offshore construction, shipyards, or asset integrity services.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary offshore projects involving steel repair, structural fabrication, piping, coating, inspection, and/or E&I works.
* Experience working with offshore platforms, FPSOs, rigs, and marine vessels.
* Strong experience in project estimation, techno-commercial proposals, bids and tenders, and contract execution.
* Demonstrated expertise in project and operations management, commercial performance, cost control, and profitability.
* Strong client relationship management, business development, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience managing project teams, subcontractors, vendors, and client interfaces.
* Good knowledge of offshore fabrication, construction, maintenance practices, and HSE compliance.
* Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to travel extensively across project locations.

**Preferred:**
Project Management certification and experience in detailed engineering, offshore fabrication/construction, shipyards, FPSOs, rigs, or oil & gas platforms.

**What you can expect**

* An opportunity to work with a global organisation in the oil & gas industry.
* A leadership role overseeing multidisciplinary offshore projects across multiple geographies.
* Exposure to diverse technical, operational, commercial, and business development activities.
* The opportunity to build strong client relationships and contribute to sustainable business growth.
* A professional environment that values trust, accountability, care, and innovation.

**Join Us**

If you have a strong background in offshore operations, asset integrity, project execution, and commercial management, and are ready to take on a leadership role in a dynamic global environment, we would love to hear from you.

Join OCS Services DMCC and contribute to delivering safe, reliable, and commercially successful offshore projects.

Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment.

**Education And Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

* Experience in a luxury hotel environment is highly valued.
* Familiarity with Forbes standards is an advantage.

* Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.
* Analyzes service issues and identifies trends.
* Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.
* Works with hotel management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.

**Managing Revenue Goals**

* Monitors hotel operations sales performance against budget.
* Reviews reports and financial statements to determine hotel operations performance against budget.
* Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
* Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holding team accountable for results.

**Leading Operations and Department Teams**

* Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the hotel leadership teams.
* Develops systems to enable employees to understand guest satisfaction results.
* Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

**Managing The Guest Experience**

* Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
* Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
* Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
* Creates an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities**

* Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.
* Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
* Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in Operations (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings).
* Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.
* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.
* Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
* Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
* Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
