Title: AIR FREIGHT PRICING AND OPERATIONS MANAGER
Description:
Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager

**Company:** Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Department:** Air Freight Operations & Pricing  
**Position Level:** Senior Management  
**Reports To:** Directors & Management

Job Overview

Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC is seeking a **highly experienced, commercially driven, and result-oriented Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager** to take complete ownership of the company's air freight operations, pricing, airline relationships, and business development opportunities.

We are looking for a strong leader with extensive knowledge of international air freight, transshipment operations, airline pricing, and CMC (Cargo Mega Terminal) facilities and their potential business opportunities.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently managing the entire operations and pricing team, maintaining strong airline relationships, maximizing enquiry conversions, ensuring operational excellence, and taking full accountability for departmental performance.

**This is an ownership-driven leadership position, not merely an operational supervisory role.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Complete Operations Management & Accountability**

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day performance of the Air Freight Operations and Pricing Department.
* Lead, supervise, train, and guide the entire operations and pricing team.
* Ensure every customer enquiry is properly reviewed, priced, followed up, and converted wherever commercially feasible.
* Take complete accountability for all enquiries, quotations, bookings, shipment execution, and operational escalations.
* Establish clear responsibilities, productivity standards, and performance expectations for each team member.
* Ensure timely shipment execution, accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with all stakeholders.
* Independently resolve operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

**2. Airline Relationships & Pricing Management**

* Maintain excellent working relationships with major airlines, GSAs, cargo terminals, and handling agents.
* Negotiate competitive freight rates, special rates, allotments, and commercial arrangements.
* Possess strong knowledge of airline networks, routing options, capacity availability, and international cargo regulations.
* Develop effective pricing strategies to improve both conversion rates and gross profitability.
* Build direct relationships with airline decision-makers to secure commercially advantageous opportunities.
* Continuously monitor market rates, competitor pricing, and airline developments.

**3. Transshipment & CMC Business Development**

* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of international cargo transshipment operations through Dubai and other major hubs.
* Identify and develop business opportunities involving CMC facilities, cargo consolidation, transit cargo, and cross-border freight movements.
* Develop commercially viable solutions for cargo movements through Dubai, including documentation, handling, routing, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish relationships with international freight forwarding agents and overseas business partners.
* Identify new trade lanes, airline partnerships, and transshipment business opportunities.
* Present practical business development proposals to management, including revenue potential, expected margins, operational requirements, and implementation plans.

**4. Enquiry Management & 95% Conversion Target**

* Drive the department toward a **target of 95% conversion of qualified, commercially viable enquiries**.
* Ensure 100% of enquiries are recorded, assigned, monitored, and followed up.
* Implement a structured quotation and follow-up system to minimize lost business.
* Analyze unsuccessful quotations and identify the reasons for lost business.
* Ensure quotations are competitive, accurate, profitable, and delivered within established turnaround times.
* Work closely with the Sales Department to convert enquiries into confirmed shipments.
* Take ownership of improving enquiry quality, quotation efficiency, customer retention, and shipment volumes.

**5. Weekly Management Reporting**

Submit a detailed weekly performance report to management covering:

* Total enquiries received, quotations submitted, and shipments confirmed.
* Enquiry conversion percentage and comparison against the 95% target.
* Total sales revenue and gross profit generated.
* Shipment volumes, chargeable weight, and major trade lanes.
* Lost enquiries, reasons for non-conversion, and corrective actions.
* Airline rate developments and negotiated commercial benefits.
* Individual team performance, productivity, and accountability.
* Operational issues, shipment delays, and resolutions.
* New business opportunities, particularly in transshipment and CMC operations.

**6. Leadership & Professional Representation**

* Represent the company professionally in meetings with airlines, customers, international agents, and business partners.
* Maintain excellent personal presentation, professional grooming, communication, and business etiquette.
* Demonstrate confidence, strong negotiation capabilities, commercial awareness, and sound decision-making.
* Conduct regular departmental performance meetings and ensure effective team coordination.
* Develop employees through training, mentoring, and practical operational guidance.
* Demonstrate leadership through ownership, discipline, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Act as the primary escalation point for air freight operational and pricing matters.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **8–10 years of relevant experience** in air freight forwarding, operations, and pricing, preferably within the UAE market.
* At least 3–5 years in a managerial or senior leadership position.
* Established professional relationships with airlines, GSAs, and air cargo handling agents in the UAE.
* Strong expertise in transshipment operations, Dubai air cargo facilities, CMC-related opportunities, and cargo handling procedures.
* Excellent knowledge of import, export, transit cargo, customs procedures, AWB documentation, and airline regulations.

The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. * You will lead technical security programs from planning through delivery, aligning Information Security, IT, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Product partners on scope, milestones, ownership, and outcomes.
* You will partner with security leads to translate priorities and risk assessments into executable roadmaps, balancing risk reduction with engineering capacity and business needs.
* You will engage in architecture reviews and threat modeling discussions, ask questions that clarify technical tradeoffs, and translate security requirements into concrete engineering deliverables.
* You will manage dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments across teams, resolve blockers, and escalate decisions early with clear options and recommendations.
* You will coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities and security findings, helping teams meet agreed service levels and establish sustainable plans for complex or long-term issues.
* You will establish practical planning, review, and decision-making processes that clarify accountability and improve execution as security programs scale.

### **What we look for**

Title: Senior Manager - Fund Client Services and Support Lead
Description:
Neuberger is seeking a Senior Manager to lead Funds Client Services & Support, the team that stands behind our funds for the broker-dealers, wirehouses, RIAs, and retirement platforms that distribute them, and for direct retail accounts.
  
  
You will lead the Retail desk, which includes our call center, and the Intermediary desk. You will also govern the external transfer agent and NSCC processing that support our 40 Act funds, and you will provide a white-glove experience to our key distribution partners. As Transfer Agency lead on new fund launches and ETF conversions, you will help shape the fund lifecycle.
  
  
This role suits a hands-on, relationship-driven leader with deep mutual fund operations and transfer agency experience, sound judgment under pressure, and a practical interest in using automation and AI to work more efficiently.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Lead Client and Intermediary Servicing

* Deliver a white-glove service model for our largest broker-dealer and distribution platform relationships, with a service approach suited to retirement platforms.

* Draft and coordinate client communications, and contribute to Board reporting.
* Support the US Intermediary Sales team in distributing our offshore funds.

* Monitor large cash flows that may affect investor concentration.
* Support operations for closed-end funds.
* Manage industry reporting obligations, including ICI surveys.

Shape the Fund Lifecycle

* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Reporting, Marketing, RFP, and Portfolio Management to meet deadlines and deliver a consistent client experience.

Lead People and Drive Improvement

* Act as a day-to-day coordination point across teams, using data insights and AI-enabled automation to improve processes, reduce manual effort, and shorten turnaround times.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* Required within 6 months of hire, if not already held: Series 66, or both Series 63 and Series 65.

* 10+ years of experience in mutual fund operations or client servicing, including managing teams and supporting 40 Act funds.

* Working knowledge of broker-dealer operations and intermediary servicing, including omnibus and direct account structures, share class exchanges, and clearing of fund activity.
* Extensive knowledge of the NSCC Fund/Serv platform including the networking of accounts and the oversight of the Mutual Fund Profile.
* Familiarity with the requirements of fund prospectuses and Statements of Additional Information, and with retirement account servicing such as required minimum distributions and account transfers.

* Experience governing a third-party transfer agent or similar service provider. This includes setting and monitoring service levels, validating vendor reporting, investigating discrepancies, and escalating issues to resolution.
* Ability to assess operational risk and conduct vendor health checks, with sound judgment on when to escalate.
* Strong attention to detail and a control-minded approach, particularly when monitoring large cash flows and ensuring fund compliance.

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to draft clear client communications and Board-level reporting.

People Leadership
  
  

* Experience leading, coaching, and developing client service teams, including managers of desks or functions.
* Ability to set clear expectations, build accountability, and sustain high performance in a service environment.

* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including working with large datasets, identifying trends, and presenting insights clearly to senior audiences.
* Ability to turn operational data into insights that support process improvement and business growth.
* Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.
* Coordinate pre-certification activities: lab selection, test plan development, sample preparation, and firmware readiness in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**What We Offer**
**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

Title: BMW Program Manager
Description:
**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Client Partnership & Programme Governance**

* Act as direct support to the BMW ME Training Manager in planning, executing and controlling the Training Centre, its activities and resources.
* Act as GP Strategies' primary point of contact and escalation for BMW on the training programme.
* Develop and maintain programme and project plans, including milestones, owners, deliverables, budget, implementation timing and approval gateways, with a plan for each new learning initiative.
* Lead the start-up phase of new projects, including problem definition, concept development and vendor selection.
* Identify training and coaching opportunities that support BMW ME's business objectives, using requirements obtained from the market or the BMW Regional Office (RO). Evaluate the training strategy against changing market and importer needs, and recommend new learning and development initiatives to BMW.
* Lead the development of training and coaching programmes, with Trainer input, for BMW approval.
* Set up meetings, supported by the Training Co-ordinator, with the people responsible for each new project and for approving the proposed solution.
* Ensure each new programme is delivered on time, within budget and to BMW standards, including reporting and participant feedback.
* Set up and own the training materials repository, together with the Training Co-ordinator, tracking all existing material under version control so that there is a clean, current record of every update, replacement and enhancement; ensure materials developed for new programmes are provided to BMW and retained in the repository.
* Using the repository as the starting point for material reviews and overhauls, revisit existing training programmes so that they reflect the current product range and BMW's updated training methods; table update plans with BMW where needed, and execute them once approved.
* Receive the Sales & Product Trainers' proposals for improving sales training materials and methodologies, and decide which to take forward as part of programme reviews and overhauls.
* Review and approve the annual training plan and training calendar prepared by the Training Co-ordinator before submission to BMW.
* Support the training needs analysis.
* Support quarterly adjustments to the training plan.
* Support the planning of Focus Training and coaching.
* Manage programme risks, issues and changes, and communicate their impact on scope, timelines, resources and cost.
* Maintain programme documentation, decisions and action logs.
* Maintain a formal improvement tracker of all proposals tabled with BMW, together with BMW's responses.
* Record and track all new projects delivered by or via GP, and all value-added services.
* Lead GP's participation in audits, programme reviews and BMW governance activities.

**Client Meetings & Reporting**

* Run the weekly operations meeting with the team, covering priorities, delivery status and actions.
* Chair the monthly client meeting with BMW, covering performance, KPIs, SLA results and the forward plan.
* Lead the quarterly account meeting with BMW, including review of annual volumetrics, capacity assumptions and demand trends.
* Review all reports and the monthly KPI scoreboard before they are sent to BMW.
* Own and sign off the monthly SLA report, and chair the monthly joint review of the SLA exception register with BMW.
* Keep BMW and the BMW RO informed of successes and noteworthy stories, and maintain a success log with evidence.

**Financial Control**

* Prepare annual budget inputs, including training volumes, trainer mix and costs, for the Senior Director, who sets rates and agrees the budget with BMW.
* Control all programme financials against the approved budget, including spend, variance and BMW over- or under-spend, and escalate commercial risks.
* Prepare the monthly forward forecast of revenue, vendor cost and training volumes.
* Control GP revenue recovery: sign off monthly BMW invoicing so that all billable activity is recovered, and reconcile SLA credit deductions.
* Reconcile vendor costs against BMW invoicing every month.
* Support the maintenance of the training tracker and the monthly billing data.
* Liaise with GP Finance and the Senior Director on billing, forecasting and commercial matters.

**Service Quality, KPIs & SLA Compliance**

* Set, monitor and control KPIs for the entire team; act on deviations and identify improvement opportunities.
* Define, maintain and monitor service delivery quality standards for the Training Centre, and lead continuous-improvement reviews.
* Receive and review the Training Administrator's reports on the Operating Standards Manual and the adoption of agreed processes across the team, and act on any gaps.
* Submit Deviation Requests to BMW by the 14-day fill-rate measurement date.
* Submit Legitimate Cause claims with supporting evidence within the contractual timelines.
* Direct the Training Administrator's support in preparing Deviation Requests and Legitimate Cause claims.
* Dispute SLA results with evidence within 5 business days of notification.
* Issue Service Rectification Plans and corrective and preventive action plans when Non-Compliance Events occur.
* Hold accountability for the compliance register of vendor agreements, work permits, licences and sub-supplier documents maintained by the Training Administrator.

**Product Launches, Conferences & Events**

* Own all product launches, conferences and events end to end, as decision-maker and custodian of quality, budget, BMW CI and brand standards, approvals and execution, liaising with BMW so that decisions reflect its requirements.
* Review and approve launch event concepts developed by the Training Co-ordinator, together with BMW.
* Lead the briefing for each launch or event, and feed approved concepts and decisions through to the team and external event suppliers.
* Support the team in the operational delivery of launches and events, as briefed.

**Vendor Oversight**

* Approve training vendors and programmes together with BMW and the BMW regional office.
* Produce a briefing document for supplier tender, or for a selected supplier to GP, setting out the programme requirement, key success factors, budget and timing, and appoint the supplier.
* Hold an annual review with each supplier, including written feedback from importers, participants and BMW where possible.

**People & Resource Management**

* Lead the BMW ME team to achieve its KPIs and SLA obligations.
* Manage the performance of direct reports, including objectives, quarterly conversations, reviews and performance improvement plans.
* Manage time sheets and approve leave and sickness for all Training Centre staff, and handle team escalations.
* Act as the escalation point for internal operational matters handled day to day by the Training Co-ordinator.
* Manage grievances and employee issues together with GP Strategies management.
* Manage the performance of employed and vendor trainers against SLA quality and conduct requirements.
* Sit in on training regularly to ensure employed and vendor trainers maintain training standards consistently, and give them feedback.
* Recruit staff, including CV review, interviews and scoring.
* Maintain a recruitment pipeline and back-up resource plan, and fill replacement or additional roles within 3 months.
* Replace trainers within 5 business days when required by BMW, or put interim mitigation in place.
* Support trainer capacity planning and allocation.
* Onboard and certify new or replacement trainers.
* Support trainer calibration, train-the-trainer and professional development.
* Seek opportunities to reward and recognise the team and vendor trainers.

**Ad Hoc Duties**

* Undertake additional duties associated with the successful delivery of the BMW ME training programme, as reasonably required by the Senior Director.

**Key Performance Measures**

The Programme / Project Manager is measured on the performance of the programme as a whole, including the SLA requirements in the BMW contract addendum effective 1 January 2027:

* Course fill-rate of at least 95% (minimum 8 participants where applicable) and delivery of the agreed annual training volume.
* Participant satisfaction of at least 90% per course, per trainer and as a monthly average.
* Complete course content readiness before every delivery.
* Recruitment and replacement within contractual timelines.
* Full local, legal and financial compliance, with no Material Breach events.
* Programme financial performance against budget and forecast, including full revenue recovery.
* Minimal SLA service credits, with Rectification Plans and claims submitted on time.

**Professional Competence**

No day is the same, so it is important that you can prioritise, manage your time successfully, and work both proactively and reactively.

* Strong programme and project management capability across multiple workstreams, markets and stakeholders.
* Proven financial control: budgets, forecasting, revenue recovery, cost-to-invoice reconciliation and commercial risk management.
* Experience managing to contractual SLAs and KPIs, including evidence-based claims and corrective action planning.
* Strong governance, risk and issue management.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, measurable programme plans.
* Confident management of senior client stakeholders, including leading formal client and account meetings.
* People leadership: performance management, recruitment and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to interpret training data and KPI reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Working knowledge of TMSi or another learning management system is advantageous.

**Personal Competence**

* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for results.
* Professional and confident with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High emotional intelligence and cultural awareness across diverse markets.
* Commercially minded, with strong attention to detail.
* Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Calm and decisive under pressure; manages competing priorities effectively.
* Builds trust and credibility with the client, the team and vendors.
* Positive, collaborative and solutions-focused.

Title: Senior Manager, Digital Health & Technology (Healthcare Sector Exp) 50013026
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Manager of Digital Health & Technology leads the definition, prioritisation and delivery readiness of QHC's healthcare digital, data and technology requirements. The role translates clinical, operational and corporate priorities into clear technology requirements, delivery roadmaps, information flows and reporting needs, while coordinating with QIC / QTech on solution design, architecture alignment, implementation planning and service readiness.
  
  
In a healthcare startup, technology is a critical enabler of clinical operations, reporting, integration and patient experience. The role supports prioritization of the systems required across Sports Medicine, Citywide Healthcare and IHN, and tracks technology dependencies, delivery risks and readiness requirements. Specifically, within Sport Medicine / Performance , technology is core infrastructure rather than a support afterthought: electronic health records, clinical and athlete-monitoring platforms, analytics and cybersecurity must be specified, procured, deployed and integrated to enable safe clinical delivery and evidence-based performance health.
  
  
The role works closely with clinical, operations, finance and enabling teams to translate business and clinical needs into healthcare technology and data requirements, coordinating with function owners and QTech to ensure solutions are aligned with healthcare requirements and that data is usable for decision-making. The role also supports technology quality assurance, readiness and compliance with relevant healthcare-specific technology and data requirements.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Digital Health Strategy & Technology Requirements
* Implement approved QHC Digital Blueprint and define QHC's health technology requirements and digital roadmap across clinical, operational and enabling domains, aligned with the organization's startup priorities and target operating model
* Translate clinical and business needs into technology specifications, architecture principles and a prioritized delivery plan
* Advise leadership on build-versus-leverage decisions across the QIC / QTech and partner ecosystem
* Coordinate with QTech and relevant function owners on interoperability and integration requirements across clinical, operational and administrative systems
* Data Management, Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Define QHC's healthcare data requirements, information flows, data ownership and reporting needs across functions
* Define and coordinate analytics and reporting requirements that support data-driven clinical, operational and leadership decision-making
* Track data availability, quality, ownership and reporting gaps, coordinating with function owners to ensure healthcare data is usable for decision-making
* Support reporting and data needs across the organization as capability matures
* QTech / QIC SLA & Vendor Service Delivery
* Define, establish and manage service-level agreements with QIC / QTech and technology partners, ensuring strong, accountable service delivery to QHC
* Monitor vendor and partner performance against SLAs and drive remediation where service falls short
* Act as the primary QHC coordination point with QTech and relevant technology stakeholders on healthcare-specific technology requirements and delivery priorities
* Cybersecurity, Data Privacy & Governance
* In coordination with QIC, embed cybersecurity, data privacy and information-governance controls across all platforms and data flows from the outset
* In coordination with QIC, ensure compliance with Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulations and applicable international standards
* In coordination with QIC, establish access controls, audit trails and incident-response readiness for health and personal data
* Deployment, Integration & Readiness
* Oversee deployment and integration readiness for all technology, ensuring systems are tested, secure and operational ahead of go-live milestones
* Coordinate healthcare-specific testing and readiness activities with QTech and relevant clinical and operational teams
* Track technology readiness against the enterprise activation roadmap
* Innovation & Digital Enablement
* Identify and introduce digital health innovations — telehealth, remote athlete monitoring, wearables and AI-assisted tools — aligned with partner best practice
* Pilot and scale digital solutions that enhance clinical quality, athlete outcomes and operational efficiency

**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master's degree and recognized certifications (e.g. health informatics, cybersecurity, TOGAF, ITIL, or vendor platform certifications

Working knowledge of Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulatory frameworks, and of interoperability and integration across clinical and administrative systems.

Title: Corporate Project Manager
Description:
**Votorantim Cement North America**

**Job Description**

  

**SUMMARY/JOB SCOPE:**

We are seeking a results-driven Corporate Project Manager to manage capital projects within our cement operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for assigned projects through the full project lifecycle, from conceptual development and engineering through procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, and final turnover to Operations.

The ideal candidate will have a solid technical foundation, preferably in mechanical engineering, combined with practical experience in project and construction management within an industrial environment. The role requires the ability to translate operational and business needs into practical project solutions and to effectively coordinate engineering partners, equipment suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

This position requires effective project coordination, sound technical judgment, construction management experience, and the ability to work independently with guidance from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, as needed. The successful candidate must be comfortable making timely decisions within established authority, taking ownership of assigned projects, and maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, schedule, and cost.

The CapEx team supports the operating businesses by delivering projects safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to ongoing operations.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage assigned capital projects through the full project lifecycle, from initial concept and feasibility through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover to Operations.
* Work with Operations and other stakeholders to define project requirements, evaluate alternatives, develop practical solutions, and establish project scope, budget, schedule, and execution strategy.
* Manage internal and external engineering resources through conceptual, preliminary, and final engineering, including layouts, technical specifications, equipment requirements, constructability reviews, and design coordination.
* Develop and manage project execution plans, schedules, budgets, cost controls, forecasts, contingencies, change management, construction sequencing, and project risk, with input on contracting strategy from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, and Procurement.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, monitor key milestones and critical path activities, and implement mitigation or recovery plans when required.
* Develop technical documentation for equipment and construction procurement, including equipment data sheets, technical specifications, scopes of work, RFPs, and tender packages.
* Coordinate technical evaluations with engineering and Operations and support the selection and procurement of mechanical and process equipment, contractors, consultants, and other project services.
* Manage tendering and contract award activities in collaboration with Procurement, including bidder clarifications, scope alignment, technical evaluations, and recommendations for award.
* Manage construction activities for assigned projects following contract award, coordinating contractors, consultants, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure safe and effective project execution.
* Champion a strong safety culture throughout project development and execution, ensuring safety is incorporated into design, planning, contractor selection, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Ensure compliance with applicable health and safety, environmental, regulatory, permitting, engineering, and company requirements.
* Take ownership of project issues, evaluate alternatives, and make timely decisions within established authority, seeking technical or management input and escalating matters when appropriate.
* Proactively manage project performance and risks related to safety, cost, schedule, quality, constructability, procurement, and operational integration, and provide clear reporting to management on project status and key decisions.
* Coordinate commissioning, startup, training, documentation, and turnover to ensure projects are successfully transitioned to Operations, and maintain complete and accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  

**AUTHORITY/DECISION MAKING:**

The Corporate Project Manager manages assigned projects within established company policies, project governance, approved budgets, and delegated authority, with guidance from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, as needed. The position is responsible for day-to-day project decisions related to engineering, procurement, contractor management, construction execution, schedule, cost, and project priorities. The successful candidate is expected to resolve routine project issues and bring forward recommendations on matters requiring leadership or stakeholder approval, including significant changes to scope, budget, schedule, or risk.

  

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Corporate Project Manager coordinates and provides day-to-day project direction to multidisciplinary teams, including internal resources, engineering consultants, contractors, equipment suppliers, and other project partners. The role works with functional leaders to align resources, clarify responsibilities, and support delivery of assigned projects.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

**Education/Experience Requirements:**

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* Experience managing capital projects in heavy industrial, manufacturing, cement, mining, aggregates, materials handling, or similar environments.
* Practical experience across project lifecycle phases, including project development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Experience with industrial construction, contractor coordination, equipment procurement, cost control, scheduling, and project execution.

**Job Knowledge:**

* Working knowledge of industrial project development and construction practices.
* Knowledge of mechanical and process equipment, industrial facilities, and general construction methods.
* Working knowledge of project controls, including budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, change management, and risk management.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, contracts, and construction documents.
* Understanding of contractor and equipment procurement processes.

**Language Skills:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, specifications, contracts, and governmental regulations. Ability to prepare clear reports, business correspondence, scopes of work, and project documentation, and to communicate effectively with employees, contractors, suppliers, consultants, and management.

**Computer Skills:**

* Proficiency with standard Microsoft Office applications and project management/scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.
* Experience with project controls, document management, and construction management systems.
* Experience with Procore is considered an asset.

**Soft Skills:**

* Effective project leadership, coordination, and communication skills.
* High degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to work independently within established priorities and authority, and to recognize when guidance or escalation is needed.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with Operations, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and senior management.
  

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**

**Travel Requirement:**

Regular travel is an important part of the role and will include visits to company facilities and the company’s head offices in Toronto. Travel frequency will vary depending on project needs and will typically consist of short-duration trips scheduled around key project activities.

The role is not intended to require extended assignments away from the employee’s home location. Travel will generally support project development, construction activities, meetings, commissioning, and other project needs rather than prolonged stays of several weeks or months.

**Physical Demands:**

When visiting project or construction sites, the employee may be required to walk through active industrial environments and use appropriate personal protective equipment.

**Work Environment:**

This position is primarily performed in an office or remote-work environment. The role also includes periodic travel to company facilities and active project or construction sites.

Site visits may involve exposure to typical industrial and construction conditions, including noise, dust, outdoor weather conditions, moving equipment, and areas requiring personal protective equipment.

  

**NOTE:**

This position description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Employees may be required to perform any other job-related instructions as requested by their supervisor.

Liberty Tire annually transforms more than 210 million tires into raw materials for smart, sustainable products that improve our environment and people’s lives. **Job Summary:**

The Shipping & Receiving Manager is a hands-on leadership role responsible for overseeing and managing the day-to-day operations of inventory control, receiving, and shipping. * Oversee the management of shipping and receiving paperwork and documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
* Ensure on-time production and delivery by managing resources and coordinating with logistics teams.
* Conduct quality audits and resolve any issues related to shipping and receiving processes.
* Analyze operational performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to increase efficiency.
* Advise operations teams daily of any shortages or potential delays that may impact production or delivery.
* Collaborate with other department managers and staff to ensure production and shipping needs are met effectively across all teams.

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Minimum of 2-4 years of prior management experience in a shipping, receiving, or inventory control environment.
* Strong knowledge and experience in shipping, receiving, and inventory control processes.
* Ability to interpret and manage domestic and international shipping documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities effectively.
* Knowledge of 5S principles and the ability to apply them to maintain an organized, safe, and efficient work environment.
* Ability to develop, track, and present performance metrics to senior management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word, Outlook) and ability to learn new technologies.

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Title: Senior Vice President, Global Services
Description:
****Responsibilities****
The
**Senior Vice President, Global Services**
owns the end-to-end delivery of Octave implementation, deployment, and migration services worldwide. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role is accountable for the global portfolio of customer programs, from initial deployments to enterprise cloud consolidations and legacy migrations.
  
  
This role makes services a growth engine, not just a delivery function. You will lead regional delivery, project management, deployment engineering, solution architecture, training, and cutover teams across Americas, EMIA, and APAC while building one global delivery system. The outcome is shorter time-to-value, repeatable deployments, productized services, improved margin and predictability, and greater go-live confidence.
  
  
**Transform and Accelerate Global Services Execution**

* Build one global delivery system. Replace regional variation with a consistent global methodology for project governance, portfolio health, forecasting, risk, and escalation management.
* Stand up a global PMO and center of excellence. Create global delivery and technical implementation capabilities with flexible resourcing and follow-the-sun coverage.
* Shift the operating culture. Move from bespoke customer requirements toward a software-implementation mindset: configure rather than customize, and address product gaps through the roadmap rather than services hours.
* Align services to the revenue motion. Connect Services with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success through services attach, migration offers, clean handoffs, and consistent scoping and estimating.
* Hire, train, and shift talent globally. Bring in modern SaaS delivery expertise, re-skill tenured talent, develop regional successors, and reshape roles for the future operating model.
* Tighten the R&D-to-Services loop. Turn implementation friction into prioritized roadmap input and roadmap delivery into faster, cleaner, more repeatable deployments.

****What You'll Own****

* Global services P&L, utilization and portfolio performance. Own worldwide services revenue, margin, utilization, backlog, forecasting, services attach, conversion, and on-time/on-budget delivery.
* Mission-critical go-lives, worldwide. Own global playbooks, governance, escalation paths, follow-the-sun support, and executive intervention for at-risk deployments.
* Global cloud migration program. Lead migration of Octave's installed base to the cloud, including commercial offers, technical execution, customer change management, data residency, and migration tooling.
* Services transformation. Move from bespoke work toward productized offerings for deployments, cloud transitions, consolidations, and AI enablement, supported by reusable accelerators and reference architectures.
* Partner and delivery ecosystem. Expand and govern the global SI and reseller network with consistent certification, quality standards, and joint-delivery models.
* Regulatory and compliance-aware delivery. Meet applicable security, GDPR, data-sovereignty, and country-specific requirements without fragmenting the global operating model.
* Customer outcomes. Partner with Customer Success, Support, and Product to improve time-to-value, post-go-live stabilization, and customer reference-ability.
* Team. Lead and develop a global organization spanning delivery, program management, architecture, engineering, migration, training, and field readiness, with 1,000+ FTEs plus contractor, nearshore/offshore, and partner capacity.

****Education / Qualifications****

* A senior global services executive with 20+ years of enterprise software delivery experience, including at least 8 years leading services organizations at VP/SVP scale and direct accountability for a $100M+ multi-region services P&L. You have led services teams across at least two of the three major regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and understand what it takes to run one global operating model across different labor markets, procurement cultures, and regulatory environments.
* You've done this in a mission-critical, regulated, or 24/7-operations software category — public safety, healthcare, utilities, manufacturing quality, industrial asset management, financial services trading systems, air traffic, defense — somewhere downtime is not an option and customers are operationally dependent on your software the moment it goes live.
* You've led a services transformation at global scale, not just managed delivery. You've taken a custom-project organization and moved it meaningfully toward productized, repeatable, partner-leveraged delivery across multiple regions, and you can speak to the specific levers you pulled and the numbers that moved.
* You've owned a cloud migration program at scale — moving an installed base of on-prem customers to SaaS or managed cloud across multiple countries — and you understand the commercial, technical, change-management, and data-sovereignty mechanics of doing that without breaking customer trust.
* You know how to operate inside a revenue organization. You've partnered tightly with Sales and Channel on attach, packaging, and pricing of services; you treat the forecast as a shared commitment; and you can hold the line on delivery quality and margin while still moving at the speed the revenue engine demands.
* You lead in the field, globally. Customers on every continent expect to meet the executive who is accountable for their deployment. You're comfortable on-site at 2 a.m. during a cutover, in an executive briefing the next week, and in a board review the week after — and you build regional leaders who can carry that presence when you're not in the room.
* You make decisions with incomplete information, hold a clear line on quality and commitments across time zones and cultures, and have a track record of building global organizations people want to stay at.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience delivering mission-critical operational software (dispatch, quality management, EAM/APM, or comparable categories)
* Background as a customer-side operations or technology executive who later moved vendor-side
* Experience with Hexagon-heritage platforms or comparable enterprise software ecosystems
* Experience integrating an AI-assisted offering into an established services motion
* Experience operating in-country delivery entities, works-council environments, and public-sector or regulated-industry procurement outside North America
* Additional languages beyond English

****About Octave****
Octave builds mission-critical software for organizations the world depends on — public safety agencies, quality and compliance-driven manufacturers, and asset-intensive industrial operators across energy, utilities, and infrastructure. Our products sit at the heart of our customers' operations: when they go live, downtime is not an option, and customers are operationally dependent on our software from day one.
  
  
Following Octave's spin-off from Hexagon, we are accelerating a global shift to cloud-delivered, AI-enabled solutions. Our installed base of on-premises customers — across dozens of countries, regulatory regimes, and industry standards — needs a confident, well-orchestrated path forward, and new customers on every continent expect faster, more predictable deployments than these industries have historically experienced. This role exists to make that true everywhere Octave operates.
  
  
**Why work for Octave?**
Octave is the rare combination of category-leading products, a customer base that genuinely matters, and a company at an inflection point — fresh out of a spin-off, with the mandate and the runway to modernize how mission-critical software is delivered worldwide. Sitting inside the revenue organization, this seat connects delivery excellence directly to growth. The next few years are when the services model for these industries gets rewritten globally, and the person in this seat gets to do the rewriting — on every continent Octave serves.
  
  
**Everyone is welcome**
At Octave, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Here, everyone is welcome. As an inclusive workplace, we don't discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all.

Title: Sr. Site Lead- Sr. Project Manager

Full-time
  
  
**Description**
BNP Associates, Inc., a global leader in air transportation consulting and engineering, has an immediate need for a Senior Project Manager / Site Support Lead to serve as the primary client-facing leader for BNP's baggage handling systems (BHS) program at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ).

You will act as the primary liaison and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the client and contractors, lead the on-site support team, and given the pace and demands of this account, remain willing to personally step into tactical, hands-on tasks alongside your team rather than delegate exclusively.

* Serve as the primary liaison and BHS Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the client and contractors, maintaining a polished, expert presence at all times.
* Lead and manage the on-site support team (including field/project engineering staff) for surveys, inspections, installations, functional assessments, and testing.

* Maintain project budgets and schedules to ensure timely, cost-effective completion.
* Review and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs); supervise punch list resolution and provide start-up assistance.
* Review functional assessments, technical reports, specifications, and drawing packages prepared by Project Engineers, and provide feedback to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Conduct and analyze system simulations for performance evaluation.
* Mentor and support Project Engineers and Designers, including managing workload and coverage across the site support team.
* Proactively manage the client relationship and expectations given the account's high-touch, service-intensive nature.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent field experience).
* 10+ years of project management experience, preferably within baggage handling systems (BHS), aviation, or large-scale airport infrastructure.
* Demonstrated leadership and team-building experience managing site support or field engineering teams.
* Exceptional client rapport, communication, and executive presence, this account requires a consistently polished, expert-level representative.
* Experience managing project logistics, timelines, and budgets.
* Demonstrated willingness and ability to perform tactical, hands-on tasks personally when the situation requires it, not solely delegate to junior staff.
* Based in, or able to relocate to, the Greater Toronto Area, with regular on-site presence at YYZ.
* Ability to pass criminal background checks and obtain/maintain airport security credentials (RAIC).

* Civil or electrical engineering backgrounds, or other educational backgrounds with relevant knowledge/experience, will also be considered.
* Previous experience in conceptual and spatial coordination work with large-scale hub airports.
* PMP certification.

**Education**

* Advanced Engineering degree or equivalent field experience.
* PMP certification preferred but not required.

**Working Conditions**

* On-site support at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ); client offices adjacent to the airport campus.
* Some remote work is possible when direct site activities are not required, though frequent on-site presence is expected given client expectations.
* Standard 40-hour work week with occasional additional time required to meet deadlines.

We are an equal opportunity employer. BNP offers an excellent benefits package and competitive salaries, along with professional advancement opportunities.

* Mobilize executive sponsors, thought leaders, and cross-functional experts to bring the full value of Enable to Lighthouse customers.

1685 Tech Avenue, Mississauga, Ontario, L4W 0A7

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

**Why this role is important?**

We are hiring a
**Director, Central Assist - Central Pharmacy Services**
(CPS)
**18 Month Contract**
to support the enterprise-wide retail pharmacy network in transforming pharmacy workflow through centralized support.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Customer Success and Innovation at CPS, the Director, Central Assist Operations is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational performance, and national oversight of multiple Central Assist teams within Central Pharmacy Services (CPS). The role provides end-to-end accountability for the delivery of centralized, non-production and cognitive pharmacy services, ensuring operational excellence, financial performance, regulatory compliance, and a consistent, high-quality experience for pharmacies and patients. The Director is accountable for achieving defined financial commitments, including EBIT savings targets, through operational efficiencies, productivity optimization, and the successful expansion of Central Assist programs across the country. As a key member of the CPS leadership team, the Director drives operational strategy, builds scalable processes, and ensures service quality and performance standards are maintained as programs grow nationally.

Nature and Scope

* The Director, Central Assist Operations provides strategic direction and leadership across multiple operational teams and programs nationally. The position requires a high degree of independent decision-making, financial accountability, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex operations in a rapidly expanding business environment.
* The Director is responsible for translating CPS strategic priorities into operational plans, optimizing resource utilization, developing high-performing leadership teams, and ensuring sustainable business performance.
* The role has significant accountability for delivering measurable financial benefits, maintaining regulatory and quality standards, and successfully scaling Central Assist operations while minimizing operational risk and maintaining exceptional service to pharmacies and patients.

**Job Description**

What You’ll Do

**1. National Operations Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Provide overall strategic direction and operational oversight for multiple Central Assist teams across the country.
* Develop and execute national operational strategies aligned with CPS and broader organizational objectives.
* Establish standardized operating models, performance expectations, and governance structures to ensure consistency across teams and programs.
* Lead operational planning, resource allocation, capacity management, and workforce optimization to support current operations and future growth.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including productivity, service levels, operational efficiency, and quality performance.
* Provide leadership and direction to operational managers and team leaders, ensuring accountability for business results and operational excellence.

**2. Financial Accountability & EBIT Savings Delivery**

* Own and deliver financial commitments associated with Central Assist operations, including targeted EBIT savings and productivity improvements.
* Develop and execute operational efficiency initiatives that generate measurable financial value for the organization.
* Partner with Finance and CPS leadership to establish financial targets, monitor performance, and identify opportunities to optimize operating costs.
* Ensure effective management of operational resources, staffing models, and capacity to maximize productivity and financial performance.
* Identify financial and operational risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure commitments are achieved.

**3. Program Expansion & Operational Scalability**

* Lead the operational strategy and execution of Central Assist program expansion across the national pharmacy network.
* Develop scalable operational frameworks, processes, and staffing models to support the successful implementation of new programs.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness, resource planning, and seamless program implementation.
* Ensure expansion initiatives are delivered while maintaining established quality, productivity, and service standards.
* Identify opportunities to expand centralized pharmacy services and increase value delivered to pharmacies, patients, and the organization.

**4. Quality Assurance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain consistent quality management frameworks across all Central Assist operations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable pharmacy regulations, professional standards, and organizational policies and procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, workflow optimization, productivity, and customer experience.
* Leverage operational data, performance metrics, and quality indicators to identify opportunities and drive strategic improvements.
* Establish appropriate risk management and escalation processes to proactively address operational challenges.
* Ensure service quality and patient safety remain priorities throughout operational growth and program expansion.

**5. People Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

**About this Opportunity**

The IT Manager supports the day-to-day operations of technology infrastructure, systems, and support at FBCCS, ensuring that staff across both locations have the reliable tools they need to fulfill the Food Bank’s mission of ending hunger. Reporting to the VP of Operations and Programs, this role manages vendor relationships and IT security tasks assigned by the VP and helps drive continuous improvement in how technology enables program delivery and operational effectiveness. The IT Manager collaborates across departments to support execution of the technology strategy set by the VP of Operations and Programs, serving as the lead of our managed service provider (MSP) and technology vendor relationships and as the user-facing contact for our technology, software, and training.

**Essential Duties**

* Lead technology vendor relationships, including the managed service provider (MSP), and implement the technology strategy set by the VP of Operations and Programs. This covers computers, printers, software, connectivity, phones, door access, cameras and other security systems.

* Serve as the primary MSP point of contact. Coordinate support tickets and escalations, monitor service level agreement (SLA) performance and review recurring issues in regular check-ins. Keep the VP of Operations and Programs informed of performance and concerns.

* Administer delegation-of-authority thresholds set by the VP for routine IT purchasing and change approvals across departments. Escalate decisions above the threshold to the VP of Operations and Programs.

* Administer IT vendor contracts and support the IT budget. Use MSP inventory and lifecycle reports to forecast needs and buy ahead of organizational requirements.

* Own the day-to-day staff experience of Food Bank technology, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, workstations, phones, printers and line-of-business applications. Work with the MSP and vendors to keep these systems reliable, secure, available and optimized.

* Serve as technical administrator for enterprise applications, including Ceres (Navision) and Salesforce. Manage user provisioning and access, integrations, system performance, change management and platform support. Coordinate with vendors (including Wye and Salesforce partners) and with the MSP on security, hosting and backups.

* Lead the business side of infrastructure projects assigned by the VP of Operations and Programs, such as the SharePoint and Intune migrations to a cloud-only environment, the Privileged Access Management rollout and the network hardware refresh. Coordinate scope, timelines and department impact with MSP engineers.

* Oversee cybersecurity controls with the MSP, including identity management, multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, network security, backups, disaster recovery and incident response. Support security audits and investigations, and review MSP security, backup and disaster recovery reports.

* Monitor IT infrastructure performance using MSP dashboards and reports. Evaluate proposals for feasibility and recommend process improvements and new or updated hardware and software.

* Deploy and maintain technology policies, standards and protocols, including SaaS acceptable use, and support the Data and AI Governance Lead’s AI acceptable-use policy.

* Partner with the Data and AI Governance Lead so enterprise systems support data quality, governance, reporting, compliance and responsible AI use. Provision, secure and budget approved AI tools, and monitor for unapproved AI and SaaS use.

* Coordinate technology training with the MSP, vendors and the Data and AI Governance Lead. This includes new-hire onboarding, refresher training, security awareness, new tool rollouts, and approved AI tools and policy. Salesforce training stays with the Data Committee.

* Translate technical initiatives and MSP recommendations into business terms for the executive team and Board, and help the VP of Operations and Programs with technology communications to Feeding America.

* Attend department and organization-wide meetings, trainings, and team-building events.

* Operate Food Bank vehicles as needed.

* May need to work occasional evenings or weekend days for projects, programs, and events.

**Skills and Qualifications**

**Required**

* Three or more years of experience in an IT management environment, systems or network administration, or a supervisory IT role; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

* Experience in analysis, implementation, and evaluation of IT systems and their specifications; experience supporting or assisting with an information technology budget.

Mace is providing project management consultancy services on a major mixed-use development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

As Associate Project Director, you will provide senior project management leadership and control across the full project lifecycle, from concept and pre-contract stages through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.

The successful candidate will bring strong front-end, design, and development experience alongside proven construction delivery capability.

You will work closely with the development and design functions, providing project management oversight, structure, and control during the critical early stages of the programme before leading the project through procurement and post-contract delivery.

**You'll be responsible for:**
  
• Overseeing the end-to-end project management and delivery of major new-build residential assets from concept design through pre-contract, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  
• Establishing robust project governance, controls, reporting, and decision-making processes from the early design stages.
  
• Taking ownership of the overall project programme, with particular focus on establishing, controlling and maintaining the design programme.
  
• Providing early project management oversight across the development and design functions, ensuring development objectives are translated into clear and deliverable project requirements.
  
• Coordinating with the PMC design managers and architect, design consultants, specialist consultants and wider multidisciplinary project team to ensure design deliverables are achieved against key milestones.
  
• Challenging design progress, identifying programme risks and driving consultants and stakeholders toward timely decisions and resolution.
  
• Managing the integration of design, approvals, procurement and construction programmes to maintain a clear route to delivery. This is consistent with the Mace SPM responsibility for producing and integrating design and authorities programmes with procurement and delivery programmes.
  
• Supporting and coordinating the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support the required commercial launch dates.
  
• Supervising the fast-track delivery of the sales center, managing interfaces between design, procurement, approvals and construction to achieve an accelerated programme and then the delivery of several high-end residential apartment buildings.
  
• Developing and maintaining the project execution plan, master programme, risk register, governance structure and project reporting requirements.
  
• Managing procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, programme and project risk.
  
• Transitioning the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintaining continuity of project leadership throughout delivery.
  
• Managing consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against programme, cost, quality and contractual requirements.
  
• Monitoring project performance, identifying emerging risks and implementing recovery or mitigation measures where required.
  
• Providing clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on programme, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions and delivery status.
  
• Maintaining stakeholder relationships and creating strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement and construction teams.
  
• Maintaining strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved.

**You’ll need to have:**
  
• Relevant project management and construction industry experience, with significant experience in senior project leadership positions.
  
• Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project.
  
• Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover.
  
• Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programmes and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones.
  
• Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement and physical delivery.
  
• Proven ability to manage and coordinate with architects, designers, engineering consultants, cost consultants, contractors and specialist stakeholders within complex project environments.
  
• Strong programme management skills with experience identifying programme risk, challenging consultant performance and implementing recovery strategies.

The position requires a high degree of independent decision-making, financial accountability, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex operations in a rapidly expanding business environment.
* The Director is responsible for translating CPS strategic priorities into operational plans, optimizing resource utilization, developing high-performing leadership teams, and ensuring sustainable business performance.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.
  
  
Compensation Range: CA$95K - CA$120K
