Title: Director of IT
Description:
Success starts at Community College of Philadelphia. Innovators and difference makers work at Community College of Philadelphia. Diversity thrives at Community College of Philadelphia. We are a college that is committed to promoting a work environment that attracts and retains talented and diverse faculty and staff. We challenge each other and ourselves to achieve at the highest level while contributing to the mission of the College and the betterment of Philadelphia. We value and support an intellectually dynamic community to prepare our students for global citizenship. Join us and become a part of a community that has long been and will continue to be generators of generational chance in this city and beyond.
  
  
Community College of Philadelphia is an open-admission, associate-degree-granting institution which provides access to higher education for all who may benefit. Its programs of study in the liberal arts and sciences, career technologies, and basic academic skills provide a coherent foundation for college transfer, employment and lifelong learning. The College serves Philadelphia by preparing its students to be informed and concerned citizens, active participants in the cultural life of the city, and enabled to meet the changing needs of business, industry and the professions. To help address broad economic, cultural and political concerns in the city and beyond, the College draws together students from a wide range of ages and backgrounds and seeks to provide the programs and support they need to achieve their goals.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, Information Technology Support, provides strategic and operational leadership for the planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of the College's technology infrastructure, support services, telecommunications and enterprise technology operations. In partnership with the Associate Vice President of Information Technology Services and other College leaders, the Director advances institutional goals through effective technology planning, cybersecurity governance, compliance, business continuity, vendor management and the implementation of innovative technology services and solutions. The Director leads and develops technical support staff, manages operational and capital resources, and promotes culture of collaboration, accountability, and exceptional customer service. By aligning technology services with the College's academic and administrative priorities, the Director ensures secure, reliable, and cost effective technology solutions that support student success, employee productivity, institutional effectiveness.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Responsible for providing day-to-day planning, management, and administration of the College's Information Technology Support solutions; this includes research and development of proposed campus solutions, technical delivery, contract compliance, and effective resource management.
* Monitor and support institutional cybersecurity initiatives including risk management, vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, access management, security awareness training, incident response and business continuity coordination efforts, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Provide strategic oversight of cloud-based technologies, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and software-as-a-service solutions to ensure security, reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve IT service management processes, service level objectives, operational metrics, and customer experience initiatives utilizing industry best practices.
* Collaborate with institutional leadership to support compliance with applicable federal, state, and industry requirements including FERPA, GLBA, ADA accessibility standards, cybersecurity regulations, and College policies.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators, operational dashboards, and service metrics t measure effectiveness, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.
* Evaluate emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, and digital service innovations for their potential to improve institutional effectiveness, enhance IT services, and reduce operational costs.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, and College management, develop and review all RFPs for the procurement of hardware and software for technology initiatives College-wide; assist in implementing the initiatives contained in the Technology Plan specific to the Technical Support Services area to enhance institutional effectiveness and cost efficiencies.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS assists in developing and administering ITS division processes and procedures, and disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Provide leadership, coordination, planning, and integrative management of the College-wide voice and data communications systems, telecommunications administration and support, and network/database administration; ensure that the voice and data infrastructure meets reliability and availability standards as stated in the College’s Technology Plan.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, review, recommend, and implement policies, standards, and guidelines within the area of responsibility including classroom technology delivery and support.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop, review and monitor contracts, consultants and relationships with Technical Support Services related vendors within the ITS division.
* Manage projects assigned by AVP of ITS by providing advice, guidance and problem-solving; coordinate with division managers, and direct and monitor the work of project teams to ensure project deliverables and timelines are met.
* Direct operations for Technical Support Services by executing production tasks according to a documented schedule that meets or exceeds customer expectations.
* Convey technology options and solution recommendations to AVP of ITS in support of ITS planning and development.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS and the Director of ERP, develop customer service initiatives based upon analysis of end user feedback data. Make recommendations for continuous improvement.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop and manage operating and capital budget related to Technical Support services to support goals, functions, programs, and services.
* Coordinate with the College purchasing department on technology procurements; oversee lease replacement and maintenance schedules for asset management; monitor contracts, consultants, and relationships with vendors as related to Technical Support services.
* Provide strategic leadership, coaching, mentoring, accountability, and professional development opportunities for assigned staff while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, customer service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational effectiveness.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, participate in the selection, evaluation and discipline of subordinate staff; establish and assign staff workload and projects, develop and monitor performance standards, conduct training and evaluate performance.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, monitor new technologies and assess their potential for solving College-wide initiatives and/or delivery of new services.
* Deliver quality customer services to both internal and external constituents in a professional, helpful, and courteous manner.
* Participate in college-wide committees as directed by the AVP of ITS.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum seven (7) years of progressively responsible information technology leadership experience.
* Minimum five (5) years of supervisory or management experience leading technical teams.
* Experience in higher education, public sector, or similarly complex organizations preferred.
* Experience managing enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity programs, technology support, ITSM services, and vendor relationships preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience in creating and monitoring formal project plans required.
* Required skills and certifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, CCNA or equivalent
* The ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment is required.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment in evaluating situations and making assessments for required decisions.
* Strong orientation to planning, customer service, assertive decision-making, and reconciling conflicting needs is required.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to manage a full scope of services in a unionized environment are required.
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with issues that affect operations, policy, funding, and budgets in a mid-to-large organization is required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, test, implement, and document complex solutions for assigned clients and/or systems is required.
* Ability to maintain sensitivity, understanding, and respect for a diverse academic environment, inclusive of students, faculty, and staff of varying social, economic, cultural, ideological, and ethnic backgrounds is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Relevant professional certifications in cybersecurity, governance, project management, IT service management, collaboration technologies, cloud communications, infrastructure, networking, and enterprise architecture are highly preferred. Examples include CISSP, CISM, CGEIT, CRISC, PMP, CAPM, Agile, ITIL, Microsoft Teams Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, and CCNP Enterprise.
  
  
If you are required to submit references in your application, please provide your current supervisor and two previous supervisor's contact information.

Title: Deputy Director of Communications
Description:
**About the Organization:**

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation (OCABR) is a state agency within the Executive Office of Economic Development and is responsible for protecting consumers through advocacy and education. The Office of Consumer Affairs works to ensure that the businesses our agencies regulate treat all Massachusetts consumers fairly. The Division of Banks ("DOB"), Division of Insurance ("DOI"), Division of Occupational Licensure ("DOL"), Division of Standards ("DOS"), and Department of Telecommunications and Cable ("DTC") all fall under the OCABR umbrella and help us to fulfill our critical mission of building better businesses and smarter consumers.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to creating and sustaining a work culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and mutually respectful to all its employees regardless of race, color, age, creed, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran or disability status. We strive to reflect diversity in all facets and levels of our agency. The Office or Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation values inclusiveness and diversity within their employee and management teams. Within our community we strive to create and maintain working and learning environments that are inclusive, equitable, and welcoming.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel respected, valued, and empowered to maximize their skills and talents to serve our citizens.

**About the Role:**

The Deputy Director of Communications serves in a senior strategic communications and policy advisory capacity within the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation, providing leadership in the formulation, development, evaluation, and implementation of agency-wide communications policies, strategic initiatives, and organizational priorities across OCABR and its five component agencies. Working in close collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and agency leadership, the Deputy Director exercises substantial independent judgment and participates meaningfully in executive-level policy development and strategic decision-making to advance the mission and priorities of OCABR, the Executive Office, and the Governor's Office.

The Deputy Director participates substantially in the development and evaluation of agency policies, strategic goals, and major program initiatives, providing substantive analysis and recommendations that inform executive leadership decisions. The position independently evaluates proposed policies and initiatives, identifies communications implications, public engagement considerations, and potential policy concerns, and recommends modifications that support agency objectives and organizational priorities. The Deputy Director represents the communications function in executive-level policy discussions and serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on matters involving public policy, regulatory initiatives, consumer protection, licensing programs, legislative developments, and other issues affecting OCABR and its component agencies.

The Deputy Director develops and directs comprehensive communications strategies and initiatives, including media relations, digital communications, agency websites, social media, public information campaigns, executive messaging, visual communications, and performance evaluation. The position exercises independent judgment in establishing communications priorities, developing messaging strategies, and advising executive leadership on sensitive or high-profile matters. Responsibilities include directing the development and review of official agency communications, executive briefings, policy statements, speeches, talking points, press releases, consumer alerts, public guidance, and educational materials to ensure consistency with agency policies, strategic objectives, and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

The position manages and coordinates communications efforts including the OCABR and agency websites, social media accounts, media inquiries, press outreach, educational content, videos, event presentations, and executive briefing materials.

The Deputy Director assists with the annual communications plan, supports leadership and agencies with consumer alerts, guidance, and policy briefs, and helps manage all internal and public communications related to policies, regulations, legislative matters, legal issues, consumer protection and licensing programs, visual communication, and branding.

The Deputy Director provides strategic oversight of media relations activities and coordinates responses to complex or sensitive press inquiries and public records requests in consultation with OCABR leadership, legal counsel, and designated records custodians. The position evaluates communications risks, recommends appropriate agency responses, and advises executive leadership on matters affecting public messaging and agency policy. In coordination with legal counsel and appropriate program personnel, the Deputy Director reviews sensitive information and provides recommendations concerning disclosure considerations and potential redactions, consistent with applicable public records laws and agency procedures.

The Deputy Director develops and directs strategic public engagement and outreach initiatives in collaboration with the Community Outreach Supervisor, Director of Communications, and agency leadership. The position participates in establishing outreach priorities, developing stakeholder engagement strategies, and directing communications activities associated with executive events, public forums, webinars, and other agency initiatives. The Deputy Director advises executive leadership on opportunities to advance agency policy objectives through public engagement and evaluates the effectiveness of outreach strategies to recommend improvements to agency-wide communications and engagement priorities.

The Deputy Director, working with Community Outreach Supervisor, additionally advises on community outreach planning and execution and the preparation of all materials used in community outreach activities; the Deputy Director will regularly attend community outreach events and coordinate participation of agencies comprising the Office.

The Deputy Director serves as the designated acting representative for the Director of Communications when assigned, assuming delegated strategic, operational, and decision-making responsibilities necessary to maintain continuity of the communications function. The position provides direction and oversight to communications co-ops and interns, including assigning work, establishing priorities, monitoring performance, and coordinating daily activities, consistent with delegated supervisory authority. In carrying out these responsibilities, the Deputy Director routinely handles sensitive, privileged, or otherwise protected information and exercises discretion in safeguarding such materials in accordance with applicable laws and agency policies.

The Deputy Director performs other related duties as assigned, consistent with the position's responsibilities and delegated authority.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Communications and Agency-Wide Policy Development:** Develop, establish, and direct agency-wide strategic communications policies, priorities, and initiatives for the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation. Exercise substantial independent judgment and decision-making authority in formulating communications strategies, determining messaging priorities, and establishing standards governing media relations, social media, website content and improvements, visual communications, and performance analytics. Direct the development and implementation of major communications initiatives to advance OCABR's mission, ensure consistency with agency policy objectives, and maintain compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on communications policy, emerging issues, reputational considerations, and public engagement priorities.
* **Executive Policy Development and Strategic Communications:** Participate substantially in the formulation, development, and establishment of agency-wide policies, strategic goals, and organizational objectives in collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, and Deputy Undersecretary, ensuring alignment with the priorities and policy directives of the Executive Office and Governor's Office. Exercise independent judgment in evaluating policy initiatives, advising executive leadership on strategic communications considerations, and developing agency-wide communications strategies that advance established policy objectives. Direct and oversee the development of executive communications, including policy statements, speeches, remarks, talking points, video scripts, public outreach plans, press releases, and other official communications, ensuring consistency with agency priorities and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Represent the communications function in executive-level, programmatic, and legal policy discussions, providing substantive recommendations that influence agency policy development, implementation strategies, and public communications priorities.
* **Strategic Media Relations, Public Records, and Executive Advisory Responsibilities:** Develop, establish, and direct strategic media relations initiatives, policies, and protocols in coordination with OCABR executive leadership, agency leadership, and legal counsel. Exercise substantial independent judgment in evaluating and managing high-profile, sensitive, and complex media inquiries, determining appropriate communications strategies, and advising executive leadership on matters affecting agency policy, public messaging, and reputational considerations. Oversee the coordination and preparation of official media responses and public records requests (PRRs) originating from media organizations, collaborating with legal counsel and relevant program areas to ensure compliance with applicable public records laws, confidentiality requirements, and agency policies. Evaluate sensitive records and recommend appropriate disclosure and redaction considerations in consultation with legal counsel and designated records custodians. Establish media engagement priorities, direct proactive and responsive press activities, monitor emerging media issues, and provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership regarding communications risks, policy implications, and agency responses.
* **Strategic Public Engagement, Executive Events, and Outreach Policy:** Develop, establish, and direct strategic agency-wide public engagement, outreach, and executive event initiatives in collaboration with the Director of Communications, Community Outreach Supervisor, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and Commissioners. Exercise substantial independent judgment in establishing event priorities, developing strategic outreach objectives, and determining communications approaches that advance OCABR's policy goals and organizational mission. Advise executive leadership on public engagement strategies, emerging policy issues, and opportunities to strengthen stakeholder relationships and advance agency initiatives. Direct the planning, development, and execution of high-profile in-person and virtual events, including executive briefings, public forums, webinars, and stakeholder engagement activities. Oversee the preparation of policy research, executive briefing materials, event messaging, promotional strategies, and logistical coordination to ensure alignment with agency-wide policy priorities. Collaborate with executive leadership and program administrators to evaluate outreach effectiveness and recommend strategic adjustments to agency engagement policies and priorities.
* **Agency Policy Formulation, Strategic Analysis, and Executive Decision Support:** Participate substantially in the formulation, evaluation, and development of agency-wide policies, strategic initiatives, and major programs, exercising independent judgment and providing substantive recommendations that influence executive-level policy decisions. Serve as a strategic communications advisor to OCABR executive leadership, contributing to the development and refinement of agency policies, organizational priorities, and major program initiatives to ensure alignment with the agency's mission and the policy objectives of the Executive Office and Governor's Office. Independently evaluate proposed policies, programs, and strategic initiatives; identify communications implications, potential policy concerns, and opportunities for improvement; and recommend substantive modifications that advance agency objectives and inform executive decision-making. Participate in high-level policy and strategic planning discussions, providing expert analysis and recommendations that contribute to the establishment and implementation of agency-wide priorities. Direct the development, review, and refinement of policy briefs, executive communications, public statements, and related materials to ensure consistency with established policy objectives, statutory and regulatory requirements, and executive priorities.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Outstanding writing and editing skills.
* Strong attention to detail.

Title: Collections Manager
Description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

### **Position Summary**

Harness is seeking a Collections Manager to own accounts receivable and cash collections for our fast-growing SaaS business, as part of the Revenue Accounting team. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who drives cash in, reduces days sales outstanding, and builds the collections infrastructure to scale with the business.

The ideal candidate is an operator who works independently, maintains audit-ready processes, and acts as the go-to expert and escalation point for collections across Finance, Sales, Legal, and DealOps. You will partner closely with the billing team to keep invoicing accurate, but your focus is the full collections lifecycle: from credit review through cash application, dispute resolution, and reporting.

### **About the role**

**Collections & AR Lifecycle Management**

* End-to-end ownership: Own the AR aging cycle across the customer base; monitor outstanding balances, prioritize outreach, and drive timely collection of past-due accounts.
* Strategic collections: Develop tailored collection strategies for key and high-risk accounts, including executive-level escalations and payment plan negotiations.
* Forecasting: Partner with Finance to forecast cash receipts and flag collection risk, reserves, and write-off candidates ahead of period close.
* Escalation and mentorship: Serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for collections; coach team members on best practices and set outreach cadences and standards.

**Cash Application & Reconciliation**

* Manage the end-to-end cash application process, ensuring timely and accurate posting of bank deposits, wire transfers, ACH, and credit card payments to the subledger.
* Reconcile unapplied cash and clear exceptions, working with Treasury and Accounting to keep the AR subledger tied to the general ledger.

**Credit Risk Assessment**

* Perform credit reviews for new customers and establish and monitor credit limits to mitigate financial risk.
* Identify accounts with deteriorating payment behavior and recommend holds, terms changes, or other risk actions.

**Dispute & Deduction Management**

* Resolve payment disputes, credit memos, and refund requests within defined SLAs.
* Partner with Legal and DealOps on complex contract interpretations, and with Sales on customer relationship strategy for sensitive accounts.
* Track root causes of disputes and feed them back to billing and sales operations to prevent repeat issues.

**Metrics & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain AR dashboards that track KPIs including DSO, collection effectiveness index, past-due percentage, aging trends, and unapplied cash.
* Provide regular reporting and insights on collections performance to Revenue Accounting and Finance leadership.

**Billing Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with the billing team to resolve invoice errors, contract mismatches, and amendments that delay payment; escalate systemic billing issues with the right context and urgency.
* Build strong partnerships with DealOps, Sales, Legal, IT, and Finance, and communicate clearly with leadership on collections risk and cash performance.
* Maintain working knowledge of NetSuite and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows as they relate to invoicing, payment terms, and customer records.

**Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze collections and cash application workflows to find bottlenecks, and implement scalable, automated solutions that reduce manual effort.
* Lead initiatives with IT and Sales Operations to streamline the quote-to-cash process, including dunning, payment reminders, and customer self-service payment options.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all collections, cash application, and credit tasks, and keep them current as processes evolve.

**Month-End Close & Compliance**

* Complete all collections and AR tasks on schedule, including journal entries for adjustments, reserves, and write-offs, and support flux analysis on AR balances.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and support external audit requests, including PBC samples and process walkthroughs.
* Ensure collections practices comply with ASC 606, SOX controls, and internal credit and revenue recognition policies.

### **About You**

* 5–7 years of collections, accounts receivable, or revenue accounting experience in a high-growth SaaS or software company, with a proven record of reducing DSO and past-due balances.
* Experience owning collections strategy for enterprise B2B accounts, including negotiating with customer finance and procurement teams and handling executive escalations.
* Strong working experience with NetSuite (AR, cash application, and customer records) and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows.
* Advanced Excel/Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and managing large data sets for reconciliation and aging analysis.
* Demonstrated experience identifying process gaps and implementing workflow improvements or automation.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills; comfortable engaging with Sales, Legal, and Finance leadership.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and guide or mentor others.

**Preferred**

* Experience with usage-based or consumption billing models.
* Exposure to a SOX controls environment and internal audit processes at publicly traded companies.
* Experience with credit risk assessment and credit limit management for B2B customers.
* Experience with collections automation or AR tools and building AR dashboards.

### **Work Location**

* Remote within the U.S. Occasional travel could be required.

### **What you will have at Harness**

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Flexible work schedule
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave

* Hands-on experience running stablecoin, virtual asset, digital payments or similar cross-border flows, including on/off-ramp, custody and settlement
* A proven record of building operational processes, controls and reconciliation frameworks from scratch in a startup or scale-up
* UAE experience, with working knowledge of VARA's Rulebooks (Company, Compliance and Risk Management, Technology and Information) and CBUAE requirements
* Experience managing banking, custody, liquidity and payout partners and negotiating operational SLAs
* A strong operational understanding of AML/CFT, KYB and sanctions screening
* Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or a related field

***Desirable:***

* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline
* Experience supporting a VARA or comparable virtual asset licensing application

* Competitive, tax-free executive package (details on application)
* Executive-level role reporting directly to the CEO, with Board visibility
* The chance to shape the business from the ground up at founding-team stage
* Based in Abu Dhabi, UAE

Title: Senior Project Manager / Project Director – Supervision
Description:

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

Title: Problem Manager (ITIL, ServiceNow, Root Cause Analysis)
Description:

You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Problem Manager (ITIL, ServiceNow, Root Cause Analysis)**
**About the Role:**
Conduent is seeking an experienced
**Problem Manager**
to lead enterprise-wide
**Problem Management**
,
**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**
, and
**Incident Prevention**
initiatives across a complex technology environment.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on IT operations professional with expertise in
**ITIL Problem Management**
,
**Incident Management**
,
**ServiceNow**
, and
**service reliability improvement**
. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, network, application, and operations teams to identify recurring issues, drive permanent corrective actions, and reduce repeat incidents.
  
  
Success in this role means delivering stronger RCAs, improving remediation execution, enhancing operational governance, reducing incident recurrence, and helping the organization build a proactive, data-driven Problem Management function.
  
  
**Key Skills:**
Problem Management, ITIL, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 5 Whys, ServiceNow, Remediation Action Plans (RAP), Service Reliability, IT Operations, Continuous Improvement, Executive Communication, Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, Azure, Windows, Linux, Network Operations, Automation, AI-Assisted Workflows
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
**Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Facilitate timely 5 Whys Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions for Priority 1 (P1) incidents and recurring Priority 2 (P2) incidents.
* Review system logs, monitoring tools, dashboards, and change records to establish incident timelines and identify contributing factors.
* Utilize AI-assisted tools to accelerate incident investigations, timeline generation, RCA documentation, and knowledge capture.
* Document accurate root causes and corrective actions within ServiceNow Problem Management records.
* Ensure RCA deliverables are factual, blameless, technically accurate, and suitable for leadership and client-facing communications.

**Drive Problem Management & Remediation**

* Lead the end-to-end Problem Management lifecycle from investigation through closure.
* Partner with technical teams to develop effective Remediation Action Plans (RAPs).
* Ensure remediation efforts include both corrective and preventive actions with clear ownership and target dates.
* Track remediation progress, escalate risks, and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments.
* Validate that implemented solutions address root causes and prevent future recurrence.
* Measure and report improvements in service reliability, operational risk, and incident recurrence.

**Analyze Trends & Improve Service Reliability**

* Identify recurring patterns across infrastructure, cloud, application, and network incidents.
* Drive proactive problem identification and long-term service improvements.
* Recommend monitoring enhancements, automation opportunities, and architectural improvements.
* Incident recurrence rate
* MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution)
* Action-item closure rate
* Chronic risk themes
* Problem backlog health

**Track key operational metrics including:**
**Governance, Reporting & Executive Communication**

* Facilitate weekly Problem Review meetings.
* Maintain executive dashboards and Problem Management reporting.
* Deliver concise, executive-ready summaries and status updates.
* Produce high-quality RCA reports for customers and senior leadership.
* Continuously improve governance processes, operational standards, runbooks, and reporting practices.
* Champion automation and AI-enabled workflows that improve operational efficiency and insight generation.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in IT Operations, Problem Management, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Incident Management, and operational governance.
* Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 5 Whys investigations, and post-incident reviews.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or comparable IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms.
* Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Experience creating executive-level communications, dashboards, and operational reporting.

**Technical Knowledge:**
We're seeking broad technical understanding across enterprise technology environments, including:
  
  
**Infrastructure**

* Windows and Linux platforms
* VMware and Hyper-V virtualization
* Performance troubleshooting (CPU, memory, storage, and I/O)

**Storage**

* SAN and NAS environments
* Storage performance, redundancy, and resiliency concepts

**Networking**

* Routing, switching, VLANs, DNS
* Firewalls, load balancing, and packet flow analysis
* Network latency and packet-loss interpretation

**Cloud Technologies**

* AWS and Microsoft Azure
* Cloud networking, compute, identity, and storage services
* Cloud architecture and failure-mode analysis

**Application & Platform Technologies**

* APIs, microservices, and distributed systems
* CI/CD and deployment pipeline fundamentals
* Understanding of how application defects, configuration drift, and dependencies create operational incidents

You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in every domain. You need the ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and guide teams toward permanent solutions.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with operational analytics, trend analysis, and KPI reporting.
* Exposure to automation, AI-enabled operational workflows, or AIOps practices.
* Experience working with executive stakeholders and client-facing incident communications.

**Why Join Conduent**

* Make a measurable impact on enterprise service reliability.
* Reduce repeat incidents through proactive Problem Management.
* Work across infrastructure, cloud, network, and application domains.
* Influence strategic operational improvements at scale.
* Help shape the future of Conduent's Problem Management function through governance, automation, metrics, and continuous improvement.

Title: Vice President, Operations & Client Delivery
Description:
**About us**

Physicians Revenue Group, Inc. and its family of commonly held companies serve physician and dental

practices across the United States. Our business units provide medical billing and revenue cycle

management, dental revenue cycle management, value-based care programs, digital marketing agency

services, healthcare cybersecurity, and healthcare technology, supported by teams in the United States

and abroad.

**About the role**

This role leads service delivery and client success across our family of companies, which provide revenue

cycle management, dental revenue cycle, and value-based care services to physician and dental

practices nationwide, delivered by onshore and offshore teams.

You will bring delivery and client success together under one standard: every client gets consistent

service, every leader runs to a scorecard, and every team knows what good looks like. This role is for a

healthcare operator who has led directors, held them accountable, and grown client retention at scale.

**Core responsibilities**

**I. Enterprise operations leadership**

* Lead the directors responsible for revenue cycle, dental, and value-based care operations, and the  offshore delivery leadership supporting them.
* Set one operating standard across business units: decision rights, escalation paths, scorecards, and review cadence.
* Coach, develop, and hold directors accountable; address underperformance promptly and fairly.

**II. Client delivery and retention**

* Own client retention and satisfaction outcomes across business units.
* Ensure account transitions, manager changes, and onboarding happen without service disruption.
* Run quarterly client performance reviews on verified data.

**III. Offshore and hybrid delivery**

* Align onshore client success with offshore delivery teams on staffing, quality, productivity, and escalation.
* Set service levels and quality standards that apply equally to onshore and offshore teams.

**IV. Quality, compliance, and controls**

* Partner with the compliance function so delivery meets payer and regulatory requirements, and act on audit findings promptly.
* Ensure documented SOPs, version control, and training are in place for every service line.

**V. Commercial partnership**

* Work alongside the commercial teams as the operational and technical leader, joining client presentations and high-level client discussions where needed.
* Partner with sales and business development on scoping, pricing inputs, and implementation readiness.

**VI. Growth and new service lines**

* Build delivery models for new DSO and MSO services and support new client implementations.

**VII. Financial performance**

* Own delivery cost, margin, and productivity targets for each business unit.
* Use operating data to set staffing plans and improve unit economics.

**90-day priorities**

* **Day 1-30:**
  Meet directors, key clients, and offshore leadership. Review scorecards, retention data, and open issues.
* **Day 31-60:**
  Implement one operating cadence and director scorecards across business units. Address the highest-risk client accounts.
* **Day 61-90:**
  Deliver a 12-month operations plan covering retention, quality, offshore alignment, margin, and new service line readiness.

**12-month success metrics**

* Client retention at or above target in every business unit.
* Every director on a scorecard, reviewed monthly, with clear actions on underperformance.
* Delivery margin and productivity targets met.
* Audit findings closed on time with verification.
* Delivery model in place for new DSO and MSO services.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 12+ years in healthcare operations, including at least 5 years leading directors or multi-site
* operations.
* Operations and client delivery experience in a services organization.
* Revenue cycle management experience in a services or outsourcing organization.
* Experience leading offshore or hybrid delivery teams.
* Track record of improving client retention and operating margin.
* Bachelor’s degree.

**Preferred**

* Client success leadership experience, especially in healthcare. Highly preferred, though strong,
* transferable operations and client delivery experience will also be considered.
* Value-based care, care management, or dental revenue cycle experience.
* Experience with DSO or MSO operations.
* MBA or MHA.

**Performance framework**

* Quarterly review against retention, quality and compliance, margin, and leadership development.
* Bonus tied to quality, retention, and margin KPIs, not to billing volume.

**Career growth path**

This role is the senior operating leader for service delivery and is positioned for expanded executive

responsibility as the organization scales.

As part of our leadership team, this role may support initiatives across other business units as the

organization grows.

**Job Information**

Time Type: Full time, non-exempt

Location: On-site (Downers Grove, IL)

Compensation: $165,000 - 185,000 + up to 15% annual bonus

Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and professional

development support.

NS&S uses a call center/contact center structure to engage with external clients and Financial Centers all over the country. NS&S is committed to continuous improvement of their processes and skill development for their employees.
  
  
The NS&S Team is seeking an experienced and motivated individual to join our high performing team as an Operations Manager.
  
  
This job is responsible for leading a segment or a small operations unit for a site, region, or product line within the bank's internal operations. Key responsibilities include identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex problems, ensuring compliance with policies, and developing and implementing new processes to improve operating efficiency and ensure accuracy of workflow. Job expectations include overseeing day-to-day activities of employees, including executing transactions and managing the budget, expenses, forecasting, and reporting.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Forecasts and manages staffing levels and capacities, provides effective coaching, and shares constructive feedback to drive Operational Excellence
* Applies knowledge of the end-to-end processes and ensures adherence to bank and regulatory policy and procedures when making decisions that impact various operations and product lines
* Develops and analyzes procedures to enhance unit and/or product-related activities and oversees budget and expense management, reporting, and forecasting for designated areas
* Evaluates efficiencies and identifies areas of improvement and growth to the overall process, identifying data, metrics, and key performance indicators to measure process effectiveness
* Aligns bank priorities and strategies to employee metrics and goals and strives to recognize, encourage, and improve team performance to support an inclusive work environment

**As a member of an NS&S site leadership team, an Operations Team Manager**

* Enables and empowers 11+ employees to deliver on the Client Care Pillars easily and efficiently via case management
* Maintains a full understanding of the team's performance. Understanding the performance of each person, using long- and short-term analysis of key performance indicators, observations, and anecdotal information
* Identifies positive and negative patterns driving the performance
* Coaches the team and individuals to sustain positive patterns and mitigate negative patterns to improve or sustain performance
* Sustains a process excellence culture to maintain consistent and iterative improvements in all aspects of the operation and employee experience
* Actively participates in routines and practices to accurately assess key performance indicators and executes on actions needed to improve and maintain the health of the operation and the employee experience
* Executes long and short-term strategic plans to drive improvements in client care, efficiency, employee engagement and growth
* Makes sound judgements based on data to balance risks with rewards, maintain control discipline, and respond to change
* Engages in ongoing personal education to maintain a current working knowledge of the market, technology that would benefit the operation, best practices in employee engagement, and updated skill set

**Managerial Responsibilities:**

* Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Creates an inclusive team where members are treated fairly and respectfully.
* Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates and expects process knowledge, data driven decisions, simplicity and continuous improvement.
* Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Delivers clear and concise messages that motivate, convey the “why" and connects contributions to business results.
* Risk Manager: Leads and encourages the identification, escalation and resolution of potential risks.
* People Manager & Coach: Knows and develops team members through coaching and feedback.
* Financial Steward: Manages expenses and demonstrates an owner's mindset.
* Enterprise Talent Leader: Recruits, on-boards and develops talent, and supports talent mobility for career growth.
* Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results through effective team management, structure, and routines.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 1+ years of experience as Manager, Assistant Manager or Proficiency Coach in a contact center or relevant work experience.
* Advanced/Expert MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint
* Extremely organized/excellent time management skills with ability to manage and prioritize competing priorities
* Ability to think strategically across the organization to identify opportunities to improve overall performance efficiency

Title: System Director of Technology Operations and Governance
Description:
Pay Range:$75.26 - $105.59 The System Director, Technology Operations & Governance provides enterprise leadership and operational accountability for technology operations, service delivery, information security operations, technology project and portfolio performance, vendor management, service management, major incident coordination, and continuous improvement. The position ensures technology services are reliable, secure, responsive, financially responsible, and aligned with organizational priorities and the needs of clinical, operational, and administrative stakeholders.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the System Director leads a multidisciplinary portfolio that includes Help Desk leadership and support personnel, Information Security Operations leadership and staff, and IT Vendor Management staff. The position establishes operating standards, governance practices, performance measures, escalation paths, decision rights, and accountability across these functions.
  
  
Serves as the CIO's designated operational leader and strategic partner for enterprise technology governance, service delivery, information security operations, portfolio performance, and vendor management activities. As a senior member of the Information Technology leadership team, the position translates strategy into disciplined execution, supports executive decision-making, and provides leadership continuity for day-to-day technology operations.
  
  
SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.
  
  
Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.
  
  
**Key Essential Functions And Accountabilities Of The Job**
**Strategy, Executive Leadership, and CIO Partnership**

* Serve as the CIO's designated operational leader and strategic partner for enterprise technology governance, service delivery, information security operations, portfolio performance, and vendor management activities.
* Translate organizational and IT strategy into operating plans, priorities, resource requirements, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Advise the CIO and executive leadership on operational performance, information security priorities, portfolio health, vendor exposure, service capacity, and investment priorities.
* Prepare executive briefings, governance materials, business cases, risk summaries, budget recommendations, and decision requests.
* Represent Information Technology in enterprise governance forums and act on behalf of the CIO for assigned operational matters.

**Enterprise Technology Operations and Service Delivery**

* Lead enterprise technology operations and assigned service-delivery functions across all organizational locations and supported users.
* Establish IT service-management standards, operating procedures, service ownership, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
* Oversee major incident coordination, executive escalation, service restoration, root-cause review, corrective actions, and communications.
* Ensure operational readiness for implementations, upgrades, major changes, and transitions from project delivery into sustainable support.
* Maintain dashboards addressing demand, capacity, service levels, recurring issues, risks, customer experience, and improvement priorities.

**IT Service Desk and End-User Support**

* Lead Help Desk and assigned end-user support functions, ensuring timely, effective, courteous, and consistent service.
* Establish and monitor service-level expectations, customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, backlog health, response time, resolution time, and escalation quality.
* Improve intake, triage, assignment, knowledge management, self-service, automation, communications, and request-fulfillment workflows.
* Use performance data and customer feedback to drive problem management, training, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.

**Information Security Operations**

* Provide leadership and administrative oversight for assigned Information Security Operations personnel and security operations capabilities.
* Coordinate security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access operations, security tooling, regulatory readiness, operational risk management, and performance reporting.
* Ensure information security risks, audit findings, security incidents, compliance gaps, and remediation commitments have accountable owners, target dates, documented status, and escalation.
* Provide clear, risk-based reporting to executives and governance bodies regarding security operations performance, threat activity, incident response, vulnerability exposure, regulatory readiness, remediation, and resource needs.
* Ensure information security requirements are incorporated into projects, procurements, vendor reviews, architecture decisions, operational changes, clinical workflows, and service transitions.

**IT Project and Portfolio Governance**

* Establish portfolio intake requirements for technology, evaluation, prioritization, sequencing, governance, resource planning, risk management, status reporting, change control, and closure practices.
* Ensure projects have defined sponsorship, scope, outcomes, timelines, budgets, dependencies, operational owners, readiness criteria, and benefit measures.
* Review portfolio health and intervene when technology projects face material schedule, budget, scope, resource, vendor, adoption, or operational-readiness risk.
* Coordinate technology portfolio priorities with the PMO to align with organizational strategy, regulatory commitments, operational capacity, technical roadmaps, information security requirements, and funding.

**IT Vendor, Contract, and Third-Party Governance**

* Lead governance for strategic, high-risk, and operationally significant technology vendors.
* Establish accountable ownership, performance standards, service-review cadence, scorecards, escalation processes, and corrective-action expectations.
* Coordinate technology contract planning, renewals, amendments, statements of work, licensing, support agreements, service levels, and vendor obligations.
* Monitor vendor cost, utilization, performance, support quality, regulatory posture, contractual compliance, lifecycle risk, concentration risk, and value realization.
* Maintain forward visibility into renewals, notice periods, price changes, licensing exposure, implementation commitments, and vendor dependencies.

**Financial, Workforce, and Resource Management**

* Develop and manage assigned operating and capital budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, consulting resources, and contract expenditures.
* Align staffing, vendor capacity, and project resources with demand, organizational priorities, risk, and operational commitments.
* Develop workforce plans, succession considerations, role clarity, cross-training, professional-development priorities, and recruitment strategies.
* Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable directors, managers, professional staff, consultants, and vendor resources.

**Governance, Performance, and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish an integrated operating rhythm for service performance, information security operations, project delivery, vendor performance, budget, workforce capacity, and improvement initiatives.
* Define measurable goals and key performance indicators; use data to guide decisions and hold leaders and partners accountable.
* Ensure policies, procedures, standards, playbooks, service documentation, knowledge articles, dependency records, and escalation information are current and usable.
* Promote transparent prioritization, consistent decision-making, operational discipline, documentation, and follow-through.

**Other Functions**

* Other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Provides direct leadership to the Information Security Operations leader and the IT Service Senior Manager, and may directly supervise managers, leads, or individual contributors responsible for IT Vendor Management.
* Provides matrixed leadership across technology teams during major incidents, enterprise projects, service transitions, vendor escalations, and material risk response.
* Accountable for workforce planning, performance management, coaching, development, succession planning, and appropriate staffing for assigned functions.

**Additional Details**
**Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
* An equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience may be considered in accordance with organizational requirements.

Title: Vice President of Operations
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Vice President of Operations** for our family owned and operated company. The VP of Ops will directly supervise our five process-focused operations managers and report to the CEO. In partnership with the CEO, CFO, and CRO, the VP of Ops will think strategically to develop dependable day-to-day executable procedures to drive our business forward. A successful candidate will enjoy building and developing cross functional teams, work in concert with all departments to ensure an exceptional customer experience, and collaborate with all leaders to achieve company goals. Mentoring the leadership and management abilities of all team members, particularly the Operations Managers, will be a focus to ensure everyone is performing to their potential.

Boswell Oil Company is a dynamic growth-oriented distributor of lubricants and fuels to wholesale, retail, and commercial end user markets throughout Georgia and surrounding states. Our nearly 100 year old company is headquartered in Athens, Georgia with additional facilities in Thomson, Waycross, Albany, and Moultrie. Our Purpose is that we exist to enrich lives by empowering our team to partner with customers, delivering guidance, service, and solutions that drive meaningful outcomes. We achieve that through our seven core values of Accountability, Relationship Driven, Ownership, Teamwork, Trust, Resourceful & Creative, and Commitment. Providing extraordinary service to our customers is a priority for every department and team member.  
  
Basing out of our Athens location, regular travel to each location is expected to to support local leaders, stay connected to day-to-day operations, and reinforce consistent service standards.

Compensation will be commensurate with experience. Boswell Oil Company offers a competitive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, 401k with matching, other ancillary insurance options, paid time off, and paid holidays. This is a full time, salaried exempt position.

Previous experience in logistics and transportation is very desirable for a candidate to be excel, and previous experience in the petroleum industry is strongly preferred.

Cultivate a customer service-oriented culture and a strong commitment to teamwork across the Operations Division, ensuring that every team member consistently demonstrates Boswell Oil Company values. * Build and maintain positive relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders to ensure an exceptional customer experience.
* Review, analyze, and evaluate business procedures, particularly related to operational functioning.
* Improve customer service and satisfaction through policy and procedural changes.

* Drive accountability, collaboration, and effective execution among operations, sales, customer service, and support services to produce smoother workflows.
* Measure productivity by analyzing performance data, financial data, and activity reports.
* Coordinate with other support departments such as human resources, finance, and sales to ensure successful operations.

Title: Security Manager
Description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Security Manager will lead the development, implementation and management of Generac’s security program across the enterprise. This role develops program countermeasures for the protection of personnel, resources, and material across the organization. The position champions access control, surveillance, physical security, active shooter prevention, and travel risk management policies, training, and program deployment. The security manager works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the organization and leads the pursuit of zero security incidents. This role is also responsible for ensuring that processes are conducted in conformance with all applicable federal, state and local laws while maximizing the use of industry best practices.

**Security Risk Assessment & Mitigation**

* Directs the initiation of proactive facility security assessments and physical security surveys at assigned sites.
* Implements the procedures to obtain, maintain, secure, analyze, account for, and provide information from assessment reports.
* Participates in exercises to test emergency plans and the response capabilities of the emergency response systems.
* Lead the coordination and planning of emergency procedures with neighboring EMS and law enforcement agencies
* Acts as regional champion for implementation of security risk reduction controls.
* Implement policies, procedures and programs related to emergency management planning, training, and exercise efforts.

**Security Management & Consultation**

* Develops, plans, organizes, and directs the activities of on-site uniformed guards and ensures their actions are in alignment with all contractual obligations and comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
* Provides regional security leadership to their assigned sites and establishes the regions security action plans.
* Implements and manages the adherence to applicable policies, procedures, standards, training, and methods for identifying and protecting Generac personnel, intellectual property, trade secrets, facilities, operations, brand, reputation and other materials from unauthorized disclosure, misuse, theft, assault, vandalism, product tampering, espionage, sabotage, or loss.
* Implements employee security training programs, coordinates, and develops security awareness communication plans, and ensures the availability of all program reference materials, work instructions, post-orders, and response procedures.
* Manages the regional strategic security planning efforts and coordination of the security function at assigned sites to insure alignment with the organization’s overall business objectives.
* Manages complex security improvement programs across the region.
* Develops the regional security plans and maintains close relationships with high-level law enforcement, intelligence, and private sector counterparts.
* Provides security leadership and direction to the professional, technical and support staff within their assigned region.
* Implements the standards for measuring and communicating the efficiency and effectiveness of the security programs in their assigned region.
* Serves on senior level intra and inter-corporate committees and working groups and acts as the regional champion for the Drive to Zero program

**Security Technologies**

* Recommends and coordinates the acquisition, installation or replacement of equipment designed to increase efficiency of security operations at facilities
* Reviews security project designs and conducts onsite progress assessments to insure design specifications meet the security needs.
* Proactively engages with IT resources during design and installation of all security technologies.
* Project manages all system installations, IT integrations, systems programing, testing, and commissioning to ensure completed systems are fit for purpose and functioning as designed.
* Manages the overall life cycle of all security technology systems within their region and coordinates preventative maintenance and service requests with approved vendors to minimize systems downtime.
* Routinely audits and tracks systems performance and data quality.
* Oversees personnel responsible for using electronic and physical security systems, evaluates their performance, audits their activity, and develops process and procedures to minimize risks created by improper use.

**Security Incident Reporting & Investigations**

* Serve as the principal investigator for security incidents, disturbances, or reported discrepancies in assigned region.
* Responsible for overall planning, organizing, and conducting of all security related investigations.
* Partners with regional HR to ensure all incidents of workplace violence are properly reported investigated, threat assessed and documented.
* Guide the collaborative development and implementation of all identified post termination security enhancements at assigned sites.
* Interprets all relevant data and applies appropriate laws, orders, rules, and regulations pertaining to investigations.
* Evaluates and applies in-depth knowledge to establish standards of investigative efforts required, scope and depth of fact finding needed, proper use of investigative techniques and conclusions of investigations
* Implements procedures to obtain, maintain, secure, analyze, file and account for investigative reports to appropriate officials

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Thorough working knowledge of corporate security concepts and best practice.
* Proven knowledge of security operations and industry standards;
* Demonstrated ability to influence management, teams and individuals across multiple functions within the organization;
* Excellent working knowledge of risk assessment and analysis tools;
* Proven track record of successfully managing shifting deadlines and priorities in a fast-paced environment;
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and ability to train/present to an executive level audience

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a leadership capacity;
* 5 years of progressive strategic Security experience.
* 3 years of implementation experience with security related programs
Willingness to travel locally up to 30% of the time  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* CCTV, Badge Access, Building Management System
* Act as SAP Super User within functional area as assigned.
* Serve as the Document and Data Management Systems Administrator
* Experience working with private sector/universities or other organizations with global travel expertise.
* CHPP, CPP, PSP or equivalent certification
* Previous experience with meeting FTZ or CTPAT Security requirements
* Experience in de-escalation techniques
* Thorough working knowledge of security concepts, practices and procedures.
Proven knowledge of security operations and standards;
